6 —1thog ma 'i mchid slong ba/ — spyirno mdzod dge zhes pa ni/ gung thangari rbastarno pa'i sgron me'i rnam thar du/ khri srong giso rmardzob pa'arme phyagi medzod dga' ye shes dar rgyas bod kyi kha 'dzin du sgreng yurme bre rmangags pa dge slong gi cha byade du yod 4pas mdzod deger grag sa zheso da nga / mkhas dbang dmu dge bsam gta ṅge cadabyangs can dga' rbe'i blo grose dpal bza nga pos mdzad pa'i lo rgyus kun ga sal me long du/ mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyi skabs su/ rus dga' rigs su gtogo sa 4tsho pa / bod blon chen po ye she sa dar rgyas zer ba khrul bsdu ru mdo —smad du bta nga / de sa sa 'dir chu bo chen po gsum 'bab cing /rtsa chu shin tu bzang bas/ sa stong du bskyur mi bra/ sa 'dir gzhi bzung byas/ de'i bu rgyud che ba dga' stag thul can dang / chung ba dga' spyang thul can gnyi sa yin/ stag thul can gyi bu rgyud lesna bla ma dge 'dun zer ba byung / des dporna rgya nag sogs su 'gro — 1 —
thog ma'i mchid slong ba/'ong skabs phyag mdzod byas pas/ phyag mdzod dge 'dun nam mdzod pa dge 'dun zhes ming byung / de'i bu rgyud ru sde sa khul bcas la mdzod dge zhes ming thogs pa dang / mdo smad chos 'byung du gsungs pa dag phyogs mtshungs su song bas mdzod dge zhes pa'i ming rtsod med du chags/ des na mdzod dge shog bcu gnyis kyi gtso gras gling ba zhes pa'ang rje dmu dge bsam gtan rin po che'i dpyad rtsom phyogs sgrig tu/ blon po dga' ye shes dar rgyas kyis 'brog sde chags pa yin mod/ hor gling 'khrugs nas gling gis dbang bsgyur bas/ mdzod dge gling dkar stod kyi sa cha zhes pa'i ming chags/ gling gi sde lhag ngo ma zhig yod pa'i sde ba la gling ba zhes ming ma 'gyur bar yod ces gsungs pas kyang gling ba zhes pa'i ming chags pa'i bka' drin gyis ldong yon tan rgya mtsho dang byang rig kho sogs rang sa'i lo rgyus smra ba'i mkhan po dag la mthun rkyen zad mi shes pa zhig bskrun pa mngon gsal lo/ /spyir lo rgyus zhes pa ni skye dngos yod do cog gi byung 'phel dang grub lugs te rang byung lo rgyus dang spyi tshogs lo rgyus sogs mi rabs nas mi rabs bar gtam gyi phreng bar bstar ba dag bar ma — 2 —
chad par them byang dngos su spel ba la bya'o/ / des na ldong yon gi tan rgya mtsho dang byang rig kho gnyis kyis rnam dpyod kyi nying bcud gcig tu bsdus te mdzad pa si khron mdzod dge gling ba dgon grong gi lo rgyus zhes pa ni/ lo rgyus yig cha dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar sogs khungs btsun dang / ngag rgyun gyi gtam gsan du 'os shing tshul mthun du mthong ba dag la gzhi bcol/ lo rgyus dngos gtso smra ba'i lta ba bzung thog mdzod dge gling ba'i chags rabs sogs grong gi lo rgyus dang / dgon pa 'dzin bdag gnang mkhan nam phyag 'debs mdzad po rje tshul khrims rin chen gyi sku phreng na rim dang bcas gdan rabs dang po bka' chen blo bzang dbang phyug nas bcu ba je blo bzang sbyin pa'i bar dang rten dang brten pa bzhengs tshul/ de dag gi sbyin bdag sogs ma lus pa yi ge'i lam du spel ba ha cang bzang bas/ brag dgon pa'i mdo smad chos ca 'byung tshun chod du chos srid gnyis kyi brjod don 'dus pa'i lo rgyus ge kyi gzhung zhig byung ba ni mdo smad du 'di'o zhes bgrangs kyang nongs ma mchis snyam/ de'ang gling ba ma yin pa'i mdzod dge spyi dang /bla chen dang mkhas dbang mi nyung ba'i mdzad rnam zhib 'jug byed pa — 3 —

lge/ / na ma ཿsa da swa 〉〉 / brgyad ldan chu gtsang ni rañja na dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'gram ngogs su/ /byang chub shing drung lo drug bya dkas mkha' khyab ting 'dzin snyoms pa29 sbyo/ṭa / / —bdud bzhi'i dgra tshogs rtsad nas drungs phyungs zab gsal gnyis med bde chen gyis/ / thuṭa kyi bum bzang leṭa par gtams mdzad bu ram shing ba srid na (snyeshākhu/ / rgyal kun gsang gsum me tog ma rnying mtshan dpe'i dpal rdzoṭa 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /'dab brgyad snying gi gur khang la zhuṭa nang gi mun tshoṭa bcoms dang celhan/ /ye shes zla gzhon gsar ba'i bzhin ldan 'jo sgeg dbyangs kyi rgyal mo mchog/— — 1 —
bad ga mgri na 'o ma'i chu ga te ra la rtsen za ba rgyas chos kyi klu long sa shi ga / 9 ru ji la rtso / 4 — — — 4 dī ma tha' bral la ma ba za nga ji bzhi na 'byed pa la/ — /tshad ma'i lung gi sa bsngag sa mdzad klu sgru ba soṭa / / 9snra/ shā/ paX gh+nā ldadī rnyiX dī paX snaX dī mi /ra // / — — ji —— rgyal ba sta na lung rtog sa rin jichen da nga bo'i nor/ / —— — ▶▶ ci ga nye ra du ga ta da pa'i 'od srung la sog sa da nga / / ji ji ge —— —ga sang byinan 95 ca/— /nyi de nyi da mtshe(na ga zitshoṭa pal/ / —— hūm̐ — — — ga rig 'dzin grub da bang brgyad cu'i tshog sa la gus/ / 4brtse chen tha ba sa 'phrul 'od zhag sa da ka ra bo yis/ /bsil ldan 4khor yug zlum por bzung da nga ldan / / — — chos srid chu gte ra spel ba'i 'phrin las ca na/ / — — —thu ba pa sa lung brnyesaltong btsan sga ma po rgyal/ / 4 spya risnyi nga stob sa da gu 'gyur ca nga she sa rtsal ldan la/ /lhag ba sam lcag gi sa nye ra ba skul 'pha ga sa yul na sa/ /dri bral mdo sngag sa gzhung lug sa 'bum gyi ga zi / / — 7 —
ljongs 'dir spro mkhas lo baṇa bka' drin dran/ /rgyal bstan gangs ri la 'gying gzhung lugs 'bum sde'i lus stobase rdzogs/ /ca lung riṭa gad rgyang sa gcig gis rgol ngan stong gi klad pa shā 'gemajis/4 /mdo sngags 'gal med ring luṭa phyogs kyi tha gru yangs por spel/ /'ja jim mgon blo bzang grags pa bslu med ga ta na gyi skyabs su rnyed/ /mdo sngags bstan pa'i kho lag phyogs su rgyas/ /gzhan phan 'phrin las grib bsil rab tu snum / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'bras bu g.yud za ba'i/ /paṇa chen sku 'phreng rim byon rgyal gyur cig/dge ldan lugs bzang pad+ma'i dga' tshal che/ /mkhyen dpyod snang ba dkar bos rgyas drags pas/ /'jam dpal da byadas risoṭa garab 'byams rgyal sras kun/ / dgyes dgur bzhad pa'i grag sa pya bla na mtho / /— 3 —
thugs bskyed chu 'dzin kun las rab mtho dman pa'i 'gro la gcig tu brtse/ /tshad ma'i gsung gis skal bzang dga' bskyed phyir rgol spobs pa'i rgyu ba 'ching / /tshul khripas rin chen srog las gces 'dzin rnam gsum sbyin pa'i las la dpa'/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i snying bor bzhengs pa khyab bdag bla mas shis pa stsol/ /ji lta ji snyed 'khor 'das shes bya'i nor/ /mkhyen dpyod gzhal med khang bzang la bsdus pas/dge ldan gser khri rgyu skar bkram pa'i khrod/ /cig nga rnab chos 'phel snyan pa tshangs pas sgrog/lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma'i rgya mtsho dug gsum rlung nag drag pos bskyoms shing bstan 'dzin phal cher gzims khri rjes ma'i mdzad par brtson/ /— 4 —
me tog mda' can mthu dang dpung btsan log rtogs gnam lcags dgu rtseg 'phangs ste mngon sum tshad grub chos la bsnyon pa'i than skad 'byin/ /bsod nams chu gter las kyis bskams pas sdug bsngal gcong rong zab mor lhung ste mya ngan 'o dod brag car 'khor ba'i nyam thag 'gro/ /sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul thabs kyis 'dren mkhas rje btsun skrul bzung da ma chos rgya mtsho'i sku tshe rab brtan mdzad 'phrin zla ba 'phel gyur cig/ dam chos rin chen gter bral bas mtha' 'dir/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dpung ba brtan po yis / /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs mdzad pa'i/ /gdan rabs rim byon bka' drin lhag par dran/ /bde gsang 'jigs mdzad dpal ldan dus 'khor che/ /rnam snang mngon byang ar+ya tā re sogs/rab 'byams yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs kyis/ /mchog thun dngos grub zab mo'i gru char snyil/ /
bdud dpung bye ba'i brag ri gzhil lo zhes/ /thub pa'i spyan sngar dam bca'i mthu btsan pa'i/ /phyag drug mgon dang las gshin dmag zor rgyal/ /'phrin las —rnam bzhi bsgrub la ma g.yel zhig/ 7dmar ser gur kum gsar pa'i mdangs chags khrims gtsang li shi'i dri bsung 'dzin/ /chos brgyad gzengs ring tsher mas stong —zhing zhi dul pad+mo ldem ldem g.yo/ /rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i chu dzing dwangs mor bsam sgom sgrub pas bag yangs rtsen/ /sngon med gsang sngags 'dus sde'i dga' tshal mdzod dge'i gling dkar stod na lham/ / casde 'di'i byung ba ngo mtshar gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /rnam dpyod ral klong nags ma'i stod nas 'beb/ /brjod bya rjod byed rmad byung ro bcud la/ /rol 'dod che rnams spro dgas 'jug par rigs/ /sgro btags byu ru'i rgyan cha —dang / /— 6 —
phyogs lhung bcos ma'i zur mig med/ /tshorang bzhin drang brjod smin legs mar/ /gzur gnas blo ldan su yang dgyes/ / de yang ji skad du / dpal ldan zhi ba lha chen pos/ 66'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig bu/ / bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ / bstan pa rnyed dang bkur ste dang / / bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig/ 〉ces gsungs pa ltar/khams gsum gyis bsdus pa'i lus can yongs cakyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi sdug kun sel zhing phan pa dang bde dge ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gzhi gcig bu ni/ rnam 'dren stobs bcu mnga' ba stong gi dbus na pad+ma dkar bo ltar bsngags pa'i grags pa sa gsum gyi khyon yangs por khyab pa/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skye 'gro yongs kyi ma 'dres pa'i mdza' bshes chen po ston pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mnyam med shākya'i rgyal bo de nyid kyi gser sbyang btso ma lta bu'i bstan pa rin po che nyag gcig lags shing / de la phyi rol mu stegs pa'i bstan pa gang gis kyang bsgrun du med pa rgyu skar khrod na nyi zla ltar ches khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ phyi rol mu stegs pa dag gis/ las gsog — 7 —
pa dang 'bras bu myong ba'i rten du rtag bdag smra ba dang / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la rgyu med pa dang zag bcas kyi bde pa tsam la mthar thug gi pade bar rlom pa/ gang zag gi ngo bo phung bo'i steng du btsal ste ma rnyed pa na de las gzhan pa'i bdag smra ba/ phung bo bdag tu smras te shi ba'i tshe rgyun chad par lta ba/ 'byung bzhi'i rdzas sogs thar pa ma yin pa la thar bar bshad pa/ las 'bras kyi rnam bzhag dang / skye ba snga phyi/ thar ba gtan nas med par smra ba la sogs pa'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam bzhag dag log bshad kyi gong bu 'ba' zhig tu zad la/ bdag cag gi ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis/ phung bo'i rgyun sogs bzhag ste 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag cing skad cig skad cig gis 'jig pa/zag bcas thams cad 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ thar ba bral 'bras su bzhag ste so sor brtag 'gog tu bstan zhing / snang ba rten 'brel bslu ba med pa dang / rang bzhin stong ba 'gal med du 'char ba mtha' bral dbu ma'i lam bzang du gsungs la/ thar ba 'dod pa rnams kyis sdug bsngal shes par bya ba dang / de'i rgyu kun 'byung spang bar bya ba dang / byang chub mngon du bya ba dang /der bgrod pa'i lam bsgom par bya ba sogs gzhi lam 'bras gsum — 8 —
gyi rnam bzhag phyin ci ma log par ston pas bstan pa gzhan dang 9mtshungs zla bral ba yin pa/ mtho btsun grub rjes mdzad pa'i〈khyad par 'phags stod 〉ros/66mi stegs gzhan gyi gzhung lugs la/ /ji lta ji ltar rnam bsams pa/ /de lta de ltar mgon khyod la/ /bdag gi sems ni dad par gyur/ / nya ces gsungs pa ltar ro / de lta bu'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'di la dbye na / 〈 chos mngon pa mdzod 〉 las/ 66 ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzin byed dang smra byed dang / /sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ / jigzhes gsungs te/ chos lag tu len pa'i tshul sgrub pa byed lugs gtan la 'bebs pa'i lung gi bstan pa dang / gtan la phebs pa na ji ltar gtan la phabs pa ltar sgrub pa'i rtogs ba'i bstan pa ste rgyu 'bras su gyur ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa gnyis su 'du zhing /de nyid 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa ni dge 'dun gyi sde dag la — 9 —
/rdo ( (( ༵༵ rlo sraXgo 53 (3 se/ masasnyi miXshā n+d+ra hūm̐ ༵༵ byi( brik+ṣa'i ljon pas mdzes par mtshan pa'i mi mjed 'jig rten khams chen po'i phyogs dang phyogs su bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde ji snyed cig spel gnang mdzad yod pa las/'dir gsang sngags rig pa 'dzin pa'i chos sde chen po ri bong dgon bkra shis byang chub chos 'phel gling gi ngo mtshar gdan rabs las brtsams te don ldan gtam gyi dga' ston 'gyed par bya ba la lnga/ gang zhig phyag 'debs mdzad pa bo sku 'phreng rim byon gyi che ba/ /gdan rabs rim byon gyis skyong khur gnang tshul/ dus 'gyur chen po'i skabs nyams rgud byung tshul/ nyams pa slar sos te dar rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa'i da lta'i rnam pa/ zhar byung ser mang 'dus sde'i byung ba mdo tsam brjod pa'o/ /1 phyag 'debs mdzad pa bo sku 'phreng rim byon gyi che ba/gang zhig phyag 'debs mdzad ga bo sku 'phreng rim byon gyi che ba brjod pa la gsum las/ dang bo/ mdzod dge'i bla ma tshul khrims rin chen zhes nges don mkhas pa'i dbang phyug de nyid kyi gsang ༷— 10 —
gsum rgya mtsho lta bu las thun mong snang grub kyi mdzad po cha tsam brjod par bya'o/ /de yang rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'di nyid gang du sku 'khrungs ba'i yul ni rab dkar gangs ri'i mu khyad kyis zlum por bskor ba'i gangs can bod kyi ljongs chen po 'di la bod dang bod chen po gonyis su phyes ba'i bod chen po'i char gtogs/sum gnyis sa la dbang bsgyur ba'i chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po sogs kyi dus bod chol kha gsum du phyes bar grags pa las mdo smad rta'i chol kha'i lho rgyud/ gling sa mthong ba kun smon nam mdzod dge gling dkar stod ces bya ba yin la/ mdzod dge gling dkar stod du 'bod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sngon mnga' bdag khri ral ba can rnagyi dus su ka ci'i mchod rten dkar bo yan chad mnga' 'og tu bsdus te/ dga' ye shes dar rgyas ( rigs 'di la dga' rigs zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sngon bod kyi rgyal dkas rgyal sa ma thob pa zhig la bu sdod nas/ thang lha soṭa yul lha rnams la gsol ba btab pas nam mkhor 'ja' tshon dang bcas te bu zhig byung bas shin tu dga' bar gyur/ de'i rigs la dga' rigs zer/ jus chen bzhi'i nange gi sga rigos dang mi gecig ces 〈bod mi bu gdong drag gi rus mdzod me tog skyed tshal 'i gsal) zer ba'i — 11 —
blon chen zhig khrul bsdu ru mngags pa des sa 'dir chu bo chen po gsum ( rma chu/ rme chu/ ska chu) 'bab cing / rtswa chu shin tu bzang bas sa stong du bskyur mi jib/ 'ebrog sde 'dzugs dgos zer nas gzhi bzung / de la bu gnyis byung ba'i che ba dga' stag ris can nam dga' stag thul can gyi bu rgyud la bla ma dge 'dun zhes rgya nag tu 'gro ba'i bla dpon mang bo'i phyag mdzod byed mkhan zhig byung bas phyag mdzod dge 'dun nam/ mdzod pa dge 'dun zhes ming du grags/ de'i mi rgyud ru sde dang bcas ba la mdzod dge zhes pa'i ming thogs tshul/ mkhas dbang dmu dge bsam gtan gyis mdzad pa'i 〈lo rgyus kun dga'i me long 〉 du gsal la/gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i rnam thar 〈 dad pa'i pad mo bzhad pa'i nyin byed 〉 du/ 66 khri srong gis mdzod pa'am phyag mdzod dga' ye shes dar rgyas bod kyi kha 'dzin la gling yul du mngags pa dge slong gi cha byad du yod pas mdzod dger grags zhes pa'ang 'dug gling dkar stod ces pa ni/ mkhas dbang dmu dge bsam gtan gyis mdzad pa'i 〈 gling seng chen gyi byung tshob mdor bsdus 〉las/ 66 mdzod dge stod yan chad rma stod du brtsi ba yin te/ gling dkar stod zer ba ni gling gis dbang bsgyur ba'i sa yin pas/— 12 —
gling dkar dang rma stod du brtsis te stod zer ba yin 'dug gces gsungs/ yang de nyid las/ mdzod dge'i sa der mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyi dus su blon po dga' ye shes dar rgyas zer bas sa bzung nas 'brog sde zhig chags pa yin mod/ hor gling 'khrugs nas gling gis dbang bsgyur bas mdzod dge gling dkar stod ces pa'i ming de chags/ gling gi sde lhag ngo ma zhig yod pa'i ming la gling ba zhes ming ma 'gyur bar yod/ ces gsal bor —bstan pa'i mdzod dge gling ba ( deng sang si khron zhing chen rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong cikhul mdzod dge rdzong gling ba zhang smad ma ru chen ) ni sku 'khrungs pa'i yul dngos so/ / de yang mngon rtogs rgyan las/66 rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang dang / 〉zhis ba'i thad kyi mdo las/64 de la byang rjen gyi rigs rus phun sum tshogs pa gang zhe na/byang chen rigs mthon po dag tu skye pa ste/ de ni byang chen gyi rigs phun tshogs yin no/ / rus phun sum tshogs pa gang zhe na/rigs gang las sngon gyi byang chen dag byung ba ste/ de ni rus phun tshogs pa yin no/ / : zhes gsungs ba ltar rje tshul khrims rin chen gyis rigs rus phunaci tshogs gang du skye ba bzhes tshul ni/ dga' ye shes dar rgyas nas rigs rgyud ma nyams pa'i dpon blo gros bzang gi — 13 —
rigs rgyud du / 'bos dpon po/ bzhag sdom dpon po/gling ba'i dpon po sogs byung / gling ba'i dpon po rab brtan gyi bu a 'brug la bu bdun yod pa'i chung /ba a klum gyi bu chung ba'i rgyud pa gling ba smad ma'am/ dpon tshang 'gab ma ru ngo mtshar ltas bzang dang bcas te sku bltams pas rigs phun sum tshogs pa dang /dga' ye shes kyi rigs rgyud 'dir gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me/khri chen dkon mchog bde chen/ mdzod dge'i ri khrod pa mkhas grub bstan 'dzin sogs sar gnas byang sems du mas sprul ba'i zlos gar bsgyur bas rus phun sum tshogs pa/ sku ma 'khrungs pa'i sngon la yum gyi phyag tu gser gyi rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo mthe bong tsam zhig rnyed de sku lus las 'od zer 'phro ba dang gsung 'byon pa sogs ya mtshar pa'i dge ltas mang du byung / 'khrungs tsam nyid nas zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te bzhugs pa las phal ba'i byis ba ltar ngu ngag sogs mi byed pa dang / sku gsung 9thugs rten gang la mjal yang ha cang thu gas dgyes nyams ston pa sogs dam pa'i rang rtags mang bo mngon du gyur/ dus rgyun thugs rgyud 'jam zhing blo rig gsal ba zhig yin pas/ yab yum gnyis kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i chos sgor zhugs na bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i — 14 —

gleng byas tshe gcod pa de min par gdug 'dre'i cho 'phrul yin 'dugchos grogs des khyod de ring ri khrod bsam 'grub gling na bzhugs ba'i tsag po'i ( rtse dbus ) gcod rgan ye shese tshul khrims tshang gi mdun du 'gro dgos tshul bsnyad pa bzhin phebs te rgyu mtshan zhus bas/ gcod rgan tshang gis khyod de ring phebs pa shin tu bzang /mdang nga'i mi lam la glo bur du gser gyi rdo rje zhig pang du babs byung ba la dar skud nag po zhig gis dkris te rgyang ring du 'then 'dug ngas dar skud brgyud de song bas mthar dkar mo'i dgon gyi 'du khang sgo chen du slebs/ khri'i steng na gdug 'dre 'jigs su rung ba zhig gis mche ba gtsigs bzhin dar skud 'then 'dug pa la/ ngas kyang shugs drag pos 'then pas mthar dar skud chad de rdo rje nga la thob/ phyir yong ste gtsang sbra byas pas rdo rje de gser 'od 'phro bzhin byang phyogs su 'phur song ba zhig rmis pas khyod kyi bar chad ngas sel yod/ 'dir nyin bdun la bzhugs dang khrus dang gtsang sbra byed/ de nas khyod bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs dang nges don gyi mkhas pa chen po zhig 'ong ba 'dra zhes sogs 'byung 'gyur du ma lung du bstan/ rje 'dinyid kyang ji ltar nor bu'i gling du bgrod pa'i med dpon bzhin dga' rab sa yis — 16 —
mtshon pa min pa'i thugs spro ba dang bcas rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i mdo sngags bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil du phebs te rmad byung thos bsam gling gi chos grwar zhugs/〈snying bo nges par bsdu ba 〉las/ rigs la gnas pa'i gang zag des/ / bshes gnyen dam pa bsten byas la/ / zhes dang /〈byang chub lam rim chen mo 〉 las/ slob ma la rgyud la yon tan sna gcig skye ba dang / skyon sna gcig 'grib pa yan chad bde legs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas ni bshes gnyen dam pa yin pas thog mar de bsten pa'i tshul gal che/ gsungs pa ltar/rje btsun bla ma 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bgyong bo sogs bka' pod gzhung brgya'i lus stobs rdzogs pa'i bshes gnyen gdong lnga'i khyu mchog lta bu du ma'i zhabs rdul gser gyi me tog spyi bos mchod cing bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten te/ ji skad du/ de ltas las tshar phyin bya'i phyir/ / nyi ma phyed dus gdungs pa yi/ / glang chen mtshor 'phrad mtshor 'jug ltar/ / las de la yang 'jug par bya/ /zhes glang chen dga' bas pad mtshor 'jug pa bzhin du/ gzhung bka' pod lnga sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas ba la sbyang — 17 —

sa ru phebs te dge ldan rnam par rgyal pa'i gling du zhugs shing cha phreng dge shes chos 'phel rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs pad bsten nas mtshan nyid kyi gzhung la spyang brtson lhod med gnang / re zhig nas gsang phur phebs te rtsod grwa chags med 'grims pas phyoṭa gang nas kyang nam langs pa lta bu byung gsungs/ bshes gnyen rin po che rgyun du phebs pas shar rtse mkhan po ngag dbang rgya mtsho dang dge bshes rgya mtsho gnyis bsten te 'dzin skyor rtsod gsum la chig sgril mdzad/ 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen ha cang zhan pas nyin mo tshoṭa dang chos gar phebs shing mtshan mor gzim shag tsam yang med par zla gam gyon te gling bar nas skyor sbyang dang dpe gziṭa gnang / dgung lo nyer gsum par nyag re bstan 'dzin chos 'phel dang lhan du rnam 'grel le'u dang bo'i tshogs gleng la bzhengs pas lung ririgs bang gi cha nas mkhas pa mgu ba'i sman du gyur/ dgung grangs nyer bzhi bar gtsang du paṇa chen rin po che'i zhal sngar bsnyen rdzoṭa zhu bar phyin pas khong gis ri bo dge ldan pa phebs byung zhes dgyes ba'i gsung lan gsum la gnang zhing gnang skyes gya nom pa bstsal/ snga phyir yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan/ klong rdol grub dbang rin po che sogs kyi mdun nas/ mdzod rtsa ba/ dbu ma rigs tshogs — 41 —
drug gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud phyim/ blo rgyung don bdun ma soṭa kyi lung dang 'jiṭa byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang bcas gsan/phar phyin dam bca' sogs rtsod pa gang yin gyi skabs/ gzhung don 'tshol ba gtso bor 'dzin pa las gzhan gyi kha sgo gcog thabs —gyi rig pa chung chung dag la mgo mi 'khor ba dang / slob gnyer gang yod khar 'byin pa'i nga rgyal dang khyad gsod riṭa gtan nas mi mdzad par ji ltar mkhyen pa'i don mtha' dag thuṭa rgyud 'dul ba'i nyams su bzhes/ dgung grangs so bdun bzhes pa chu byi lo'i cho 'phrul chen mor gzhung luṭa rab 'byams smra ba'i grwa skor mdzad de mkhas pa'i tshoṭa rnams leṭa bshad lan gyis mgu bar byas/ lo de'i zla dgu ba nas dpal ldan stod rgyud grwa tshang du zhugs te gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde bzhi'i gnad don spyi dang / khyad par rgyud sde kun gyi mthar thug dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i lam rim pa gnyis kyi dka' pa'i gnad rnams 'phaṭa pa klu sgrub yab sras dang /rje thams cad mkhyen pa yab sras kyi leṭa bshad zab mo la brten nas dpyis phyin par thuṭa su chud pa'i thabs lam la chos thog chos mtshams kun tu gartson pa gnang zhing sngags kyi dam bca' dang dga' ldan dgun chos kyi dge skos rim par bskyangs/ gsang — 42 —
'dus kyi bskyed rdzoṭa skor la dogs dpyod legs par zhus te brag yer bar gsang 'dus kyi bsnyen mtshams kha skong sbyin sreg dang bcas pa gnad smin mdzad/ dgung grangs zhe bzhi bzhes pa sa mo lug gi (1799 ) lor bla ma dbu mdzad kyi khri 'don byas/ yun ring ma 'gor bar gong sa mchog nas bka' sgyur byung ba bzhin mkhan khri la bzhuṭa dgos byung zhing rgyud grwa'i 'chad nyan sogs cha gang thad nas zhabs 'degs che tsam byung gsungs/ lo de dag du ser smad khri chen dge 'dun tshul khrims dang / spang lung rdo rje 'chang sogs kyi mdun nas/ 'grel ba bzhi sbrags/ ṭik+ka/lcang skya ngag dbang mchog ldan pa'i gsung 'bum/ bkris lhun sngaṭa phyogs po ti/ thang sag pas mdzad pa'i gsang 'jigs gnyis kyi bskyed rdzoṭa/ sgom sde shar ba'i 'jigs byed bskyed rdzogs/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i 'jiṭa byed bskyed rim/ paṇa chematshobasod nams graṭa pa'i gsang 'dus bskyed tso dzogros/ 'jam dbyangs bde pa'i rdo rje 'i bde mchog paskyed rim/paṇa chen chos rgyan gyi lcaṭa mkhar bka' brgya ma soṭa kyi bshad khrid rgya chen gsan/ detsho nas spang lung ri khrod du lo brgyad kyi ring la bzhuṭa nas gzhung lugs 'bum gyi dgorngas jidon dpyad 'jog dang /— 43 —
phyag skor maṇ+ḍal soṭa kyi bsag sbyangs / bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len bcas la gcigs tu brtson pas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sa lam gyi rtogs pa zab mo la mnga' brnyes par gyur/ dgung 4lo nga lnga ba lcags rta lor dga' ldan shar ba chos rje gnang dgos kyi bka' yig phebs par dgongs zhu lan mang mdzad kyang dgongs khrol ma byung bas zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshe bcu dgur bzhugs khrir zhabs sor bkod/ de'i phyi lor 7gong sa thams cad mkhyen pa rje btsun lung rtogs rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzin la bskos pas lha ldan du phebs te skyong khur zab mo gnang / gong sa mchog nas rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes skabs rje nyid nas su go ba mdzad/chu bya lor de mo rin po che dngos phebs kyis rje nyid dga' ldan gser khrir bzhugs par gsol pa btabs te mjal dar 'then /lo de'i zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer bzhi'i nyin 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i 'jigs bral gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por mnga' gsog gzengs bstod kyi mdzad sgo rgya cher spel zhing tshogs dbus su ljags bsngo dang / khri thog khang gi chos grwar lam rim gyi bshad lung sogs sngar srol bzhin mdzad/ je nyid kyi —dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rapa byung bcu bzhi ba'ime byi (— 44—ca

'degs nus pa'i gsung skyes bu slob bgrang gis mi lang ba byung /gzhan yang rje bdag nyid chen pos/ 66rang gis ji bzhin rtogs pa'i lam gyi gnad/ shugs drags brtse bas drangs pa'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /'gro ba'i yud kyi mun pa bsal byas nas/ / rgyal ba'i bstan pa ring du 'dzin gyur cig/ 9 gsungs ba ltar/ zab rgyas gzhung lugs 'bum gyi dgongs don go sla la don 'gril ba'i sgo nas bstan pa'i legs bshad pod ( brgyad )lhag skal ldan yid kyi mun pa sel zhing rgyal bstan yun ring gnas pa'i rten du bzhag nas/rab byung bcu ba'i sa khyi lo ste (18 28 ) lor rje nyid kyi dgung grangs gya gsum par zhi dbyings bdag gir bzhes pa'i tshul bstan to/ /phun tshogs gnam dpyod dar ma'i gnam ru la/ /rgya bod gzhung lugs stong gi mda' sbyar te/ /kun rmongs dgra bo rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa/ /srid sgrub gnyis pa khyod las gzhan na med/ /sngal ba'i bstan la rgyal ba nyid mtshungs 'jam mgon rgyal ba'i rgyalu sa ru/ /zab mo rten 'byung za ba rgyas gzhung gi stob gnad kun mkhyen —46—
zab lam pa/ /༷ rgya chen dbyings su rgyu skar ji bzhin rgyu bzhin rgyu ba'i rnams grangs rgya che yang /༷rigs lam phra mo'i rigs rtsal ngo mtshar rigs pa'i rgyal bo khyod nyid rgyal/ /khyod la rin chen gter gyi bang mdzod med/ /zhum zhum 'dur rgyugs byed mkhan tshe g.yog med/ /nga 'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal thugs na med/ /stong ba rten 'byung gzigs pa'i yon tan yod/ /rgyun du zhi dul bag yod khengs pa dpa'/mkhas mang rtsod pa'i khrod na gsung sgra mtho/ /chos brgyad sgeg mo'i bzhin la chags pa r+sāng / /lung rtogs bstan pa dkar po'i rgyan du t+yā/ /'jam mgon ring lugs gser sbyang btso ma'i dpal/ /dpyal ldan bla mas mkha' ru bsgrengs ba'i rlabs/ /rlabs 'phreng mkha' ru 'phyo bzhin ngo mtshar 'dzin/ /'dzin skyong spel ba'i bu slob mtha' ru rgyas/ mang thos chos kyi spyan stong rab g.yo legs bshad drang srong zho — 47——
'thung ba'i/ /gzhom bral rdo rje rtse brgya 'chang khyod dge ldan rnam rgyal gser gyi khrir/ /'bas skyes pad+ma'i ri kha bkod tshe rgyal bstan mgon dang ldan rgyano zhes/ /dran dbang bye bas bstod pa'i dbyangs snyan dgu tshigs zhags pa'i rgya las shor/ /gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang grosogs/ /che dgu'i gtsug gi rin chen nor/ /'bas stegs dma'aba'i sar mchod pas/ /su ma rtsen lha yang ngo mtshar 'dzin/ /bgrang bya du mar cho 'phrul smon lam skabs/ /'phags tshogs khri phrag zung gi dkyil 'khor du/ /sngon med legs bshad zab mo'i chab phabs pas /'jam mgon bla ma'i rnam thar slar yang dran/ /spang lung ri khrod bsam gtan khang bzang du/0 /rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i bskyed rdzogs r+ya tha' dag la/ /dpyad 'jog zab mo byas pa'i 'bras rtags su/ /—— 46 wawa
sa lam mthon po'i rtog pa rgyud la 'khrungs/ /kha cig grags skam rtsod pa'i las la 'bungs/'a ga' res nu/na sgom byi ba'i rtul zhugs 'chang / /mdo sngags 'gal med rgyud la sbyor mkhas pa/bsil ldan gangs ri'i ljongs na khyod nyid tsam/ / / mkhas grub gser ri'i phreng ba'in byon rnams kyis/ /bka' rtsom lhun po'i gtos dang ma/nyam na yang / / zab don ji bzhin 'byed pa'i khyod gsung gi/rdzobastan bcos mang bo skal ldam gso sa su che/ /zhes ri bong dgon bkra shis byang chub chos 'phel gling gi gdan rabs bshad sgrub bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan las khri chen byang chub chos 'phel gyi che ba brjod pa'i sarga ste gnyis pa'o/ /skya 'phreng gsum pa bskal bzang dam chos rgya mtsho'i che ba/gang zhig phyag 'debs mdzad pa bo sku 'phreng rim byon gyi che ba brjod pa las/ gsum pa rje btsun skal bzang dam chos rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo mchog gi 'khrungs yul ni/ 〈 mdo smad chos 'byung 〉las/ 66chol kha gsum du phye tshe mnga' ris gung thang nas — 49 —
sog la ཿskya bo yan chad dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ rma chu'i khug pa yan chad mdo stod mi'i chol kha/ de nas rgya'i mchod rten dkar bo yan chad mdo smad rta'i chol kha / jig gsungs ba las mdo smad rta'i chol kha'i nub phyogs / smar rol ma lag drug gi nang tshan/ rnga khog ba lags skya mo smar gyi lag zhes bya ba/ sngon bod kyi rgyal po'i rigs sras rtsod med gnam lde 'od srung gis dbang bsgyur ba'i stod mnga' ris kyi mi rgyud cig 'dir yong ste gzhi chags pas mnga' ba zer ba la bad 'gyur nas rnga ba'am/ yang na/ sa'i dbyibs rnga 'dra ba'i zlum po zhig yin pa dbyibs kyi sgo nas rnga ba zhes ming cithogs pa/rtswa chu 'dzoms shing longs spyod rgyas pa/ grub mtha' ris med kyi bstan pa shin tu dar ba'i yul khyad par can 'di la/ rnga stod smad ( deng sang rnga ba stod smad bar gsum du phyes ) gnyis su phyes pa'i rnga stod du/ rjes blo bzang grags pa'i dngos slob tsha kho ngag dbang grags pas mdo smad phyogs su dgon pa brgya rtsa brgyad btabs pa'i thog ma yag mgo dgon nam/ mtshe dgon gsang chen bkra shis gling dang khad nye ba'i lha sde a 'dus zer ba'i nang du/yab mgon po rnam rgyal dang yum phur ba 'tsho gnyis kyi sras su rab —50—
byung bcu drug pa'i na tshod ldan zhes pa shing mo phag gi ( 1925 )lo'i rgyal zla ba'i tshes bdun nyin ngo mtshar ltas bzang gis khor yug /khyab bzhin sku 'khrungs/ mtshan la tshe ring rdo rjer gsol/ chung dus nas phal ba'i byis pa dang mi mtshungs par sna tshogs sprul ba'i zlos gar 'byams klas su bstan pas yul mi kun gyi sems su yid ches dad pa'i drod khol bzhag cing / bstod pa'i dbyangs snyan chad med bzlas brjod kyi tshul du skye bo kun gyi ngag sgor gsal/dgung lo gsum gyi steng ma yum la nged gnyis 'gro dang nga la dgon pa zhig yod gsungs/ mkhas grub du mas yul phyogs gzhan du bskyod na legs tshul gyi lung bstan mang du babs bas/ ma yum gyis sku rgyab tu khur te sa mthar 'khyams/ mdo smad kyi dgon sde phal mo ra song kyang de dag nga'i dgon pa min gsungs/ mthar mdzod dge gling dzadakar stod kyi byams me'i me tog sgang lam mam/me tog sgang mdo ste sngon khri chen byang chub chos 'phel phebs nas sgar gzhi bzung gnas der slebs tshe/ thugs rab tu dgyes 5 nyams chen pos ma yum la phyag mdzub kyis ri bong dgon bkra shis byang chub chos 'phel gling rgyang bstan gnang ste/ ltos dang gan ni nga'i dgon pa dngos red gsungs/ de nas ri bong dgon du yong —51—
ste ma yum gyis gnas tshul yongs rdzogs dgon pa'i las sne rnams la zhus shing khong gnyis la a khu 'jam dbyangs sbyin pa tshang gis sdod gnas gtsang ma zhig g.yar te der bzhugs/ nyin der dgon pa'i spyi ba gnyis grub pa'i dbang phyug mgo log bla ma tshang gi mdun sar spyi sger gyi don du lung bstan zhig zhu bar song bas/ khong gis/ mdang dgong nga'i mi lam du khyed dgon pa'i mdun ri'i dbu rtse nas 'od dkar bo zhig 'phros byung ba la re zhig mas 'od kyi phung bo der yang 'od dang 'od zer gyis khyab ste 'phur song bas ngas rjes dede pa na/ khyed ri bong dgon gyi byams khang steng gi gser tog la thim/ nga ya mtshar te byams khang nang du phyin pas khri'i stong na bla ma zhig gis chos 'chad bzhin par 'od zer ca'aphro ba zhig mis pas khyed dgon par gang zag khyad par ba zhig byon yod pa 'dra gsungs/ nub der dgon pa'i nye 'dabs kyi me chu khar lha sa'i ser ba dgon nas phebs pa'i ser ba bla ma zhig zhag bzhugs gnang ba'i mi lam du gong dang gcig mtshungs byung yang yid ches kyi bden pa ma thob par re zhig lus/ de nas a khu byams pa sogs grwa ba bgres song 'ga'/ dga' ldan khri rabs nga gsum pa rgyal mtshan seng ge'i sku 'phreng bzhi ba lhu mo'i gser khri blo bzang bstan — 52 —
