rgyobs gsungs/ nyin der ri bong dgon gyi grwa ba bgres song rnams kyis sprul sku gdan drangs te phebs pas kun mkhyen mchog nas dbu gtugs gnang zhing khri la bzhugs su gsol/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid yig gi dpe cha zhig gnang / dgon pa'i grwa ba rnams kyis mchog sprul tshang la rab byung bsgrub rgyu'i skyabs 'jug zhus par/ kun mkhyen mchog gis da dung sprul sku dgud lo bzhi yin pas rab byung bsgrub mi 'os/ dgung lo bdun gyi steng a lags bla kho rin po che'i mdun nas rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes na legs/ rjes sor grwa sa bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs rgyu gyis sogs gsungs/ cadgung lo bdun bzhes pa lcags sprul ( 1941) lor sku 'khor rags bsdus dang bcas bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs te mkhas btsun bzang gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang bcas pa la 'gran zla bral ba'i a lags bla kho rin po che7rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa dkyus gcig tu bzhes shing mtshan la skal bzang dam chos rgya mtshor gsol/ a lags bla kho rin po che'i zhal nas mdang nga'i mi lam du chos dung dkar bo zhig gi sgra lhang lhang 'bud pa zhig thos kyang sgra —54—
grags yun thung bar gyur bas khyed cag gi bsod nams kyis 'chun dka' snyam/ bdag skyong dang sku rim zab mor 'bad dargos pa'i bka' gsung yang yang bstsal/ phyir rang yul la phyag phebs gnang skabs nyin zhig 'bos mtsho mgo nas sgar gzhi bsdad/ rje nyid gzim gur du gnyid la yer ba'i tshul mdzad pa na 'ja' 'od gsal zhing bkra ba zhig gis gzim gur yongs su khebs shing dri zhim phyogs kun thul ba sogs rtags mtshan mang bo der 'khod sku 'khor tshang mas dngos su mthong bas dga' dad kyi mtsho mo sngar las rgyas/rang dgon gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen mo gathug tshang a khu nyi ma tshang yongs 'dzin du bskos te/ yi ge'i sbyor klog nas bzung rgyud sde so so'i cho ga sogs tshogs 'don gyi rim pa rnams thugs 'dzin gnang / shing sprel lor ri 'phags zer ba shi bas rje nyid sa/shin sngag su gdan drangs tshe sku 'khor du rgya gling 'bud pa gnyis/yongs 'dzin dbu mdzad/ zhabs phyi ba/ gdugs 'dzin dang bcas te phebs( sku 'khor lnga dang bcas phebs pa ni bla ma tshul khrims rin chen gyi thob thangs dang gdugs ser bo bsgrengs pa ni sku 'phreng gnyis pa dga' ldan gser khri la bzhugs pa'i thob thangs yin par grags/ dus de nas phebs bzhugs gang gnang la sku 'khor cha tshang ba byas nas phebs kyin —— 55 —
yod) rta dngul sogs kyi 'bul ba rgya cher bltar/ 'di gshin sngas 'a phebs pa'i thog ma yin gsungs/ dgung lo bcu gsum steng slar yang bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs te a lags mtsho kha ba'i nang chen du bzhugs/ rmad byung thos bsam gling gi kha dog gong gi 'dzin grwa nas zhugaso te rim bzhin mtshan ldan dase/ ba'i bshes banyen du ma'i 'bas rdul spyi bros mchod cing gdo snga gres gurig gronas kyis gzhung mang bor thos bsam zab mo mdzad pas/ dbal mang paṇ+ḍita dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo r+ya chog mas 'dzin grwa'i bla ma'i thob stangs bstsal/ lo de dag tu dkyil 'khor rgya camtsho'i mnga' bdag a lags bla kho rin po che rje 'jigs med 'phrin la sa rgya mtsho/ rgya zhabs drung tshang / sde ston mkhan po rin po che/9 lde tsha ye shes rgya mtsho/ a khu stag tshang lha mo tshang sogs kyi mdun mas// shing bza' bskal bzang chos kyi rgyang r+ya tshan/ wa shul blo bzang bstan pa tshang sogs dang mnyam du dbang rjes gnang gi bdud rtsi ci 'dod du myong ba las dang bo dbang thob pa'i rim pa ni/'a jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma/ 'jigs rgyud dpa' cigdpa la gas nga ba 'dus ba bde mchog dril bu lha lnga/ kun rigmngon byang / mi 'khrugs pa/ thugs rje chen po/ bde mchog —56—
lu u ba/ dus 'khor/ sman bla/ rdo rje phreng ba/ mi tra brgya rtsa/ gdugos dkar byad grol sogs so/ / gnyis pa/ 'u nga thob pa'i rim pa ni/rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog dang rje yab sra/sa gsum gī gsung 'bum/ bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'a bum/ 'jigs med dbang po'i sasung 'bum/ byang chub lam rim chen mo/(sngags rim/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi sasung 'bum /ma ṇi bka' 'bum/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/jirje shes rab rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khri chen byang chub chos 'phel gyi gsung 'bum/ 'phags pa bkra shis brtsebs pa chen mo/mdo sde bskal bzang / gzungs mang 'dus ba/ sman bla'i mdo chog chos spyod brgyad cu/ dmigs brtse ma/ lam rim dmar khrid/ 'jam dpal zhal lung / tsha gsur/rje sangs rgyas bstan 'bar ma/ byang sham+bha lar skye pa'i smon lam / lam rim smon lam/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi smon lam/ smon lam sde lnga/9 sgrol dkar bstod pa/ legs bris ma/ mdo gdugs sgrol gsu ma/dpal ldan ye shes yon tan bzang bo'i bstod pa/ 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying bo / lam rim bsdus don/ lam gtso rnam gsum/— 57 —
mkha' mnyam ma/ dpal ldan yon tshogs ma/ rje'i gsang ba'i rnam thar/ rnam dag gangs ri ma/ dpal ldan sa gsum ma/rtogs brjod mdun legs ma/ shes bya'i mkha' dbyings ma/'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ skabs gsum pa/ rten 'brel bstod pa/ bla ma mchod pa/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ ltung bshags/skyabs 'gro / zhang ston bstan pa rgya mtsho ste a khu thabs mkhas tshang gi gsungs 'bum sogs kyi lung thob bo/ /gsum pa rjes gnang gi rim pa ni/'jam dbyangs rigs lnga/ dzam lha rigs lnga/ rta mgrin yang gsang / rta mgrin gsang sgrupa/ seng gdong ma dkar mo/seng gdong gtso 'khor gsum pa/ phyag rdor 'khor chen/ phyag rdor gtum po/ khyung gi yang gsang khros pa lha dgu/ drag po sum sbrel/ rigs gsum spyi sgrub/ mgon po phyag drug pa/ chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum/ lha mo/ rnam sras/ bag rtse/dam can rdo rje legs pa/ dam can mgar ba nag po/ gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar bo/ gnas chung rgyal bo sku lnga'i srog gtad/mar tse/ sa bdag snying gter/ khro bo bcu/ phur pa'i dbang dang rjes gnang / seng ge sgra/ khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa sogs kyi — 53 —
rjes gnang thob pas rab 'byams chos phung bye ba'i gter du gyur/de nas phyir ri bong dgon du phebs te gzhung lugs mang bo 'dzin skyor spel gsum la gcig tu gzhol/ khyad par du skyabs 'gro 'bum ther gyi mtshams/ mdo 'bum ther/ ga te 'bum ther/ya ma ra dza bye ba/ dmigs brtse ma bye ba/ yig brgya 'bum ther/'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma/ dpa' bo gcig pa/ chos rgyal/kun rig sgrol dkar/ thugs rje chen po/ jigadugs dkar/'jam dbyangs dkar po/ tshe lha rnam gsum/rnam snang mngon byang /'pho sbyang bcas kyi sku mtshams la bzhugs shing bsgrub pa nyams bzhes kyis dus 'da' bar mdzad pas gsang sngags rnal 'byor zab mor mnga' brnyes par gyur/ dus kyi 'pho 'gyur dang bstun nas sangs rgyas kyi bstane pa rin po cher yang god chag bzlog tu med pa zhig 'byung ba sngon nas mkhyen te dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes pa rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu sbrul ( 195 2 ) lor rgyu nor gang la'ang snying bo med cing mi rtag pa 'ga' zhig tu gzigs pa dang /shin tu rnyed dka' zhing rnyed na don che ba'i dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i dal ba'i rten khyad par can yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang cha mtshungs pa zhig rnyed pa'i skabs 'dir sdig pa dang ma 'dres pa'i — 59—
chos rnam dag cis byed par dgongs nas/ zla gsum tsam gyi ring la rang gi rgyu nor yod do cog sbyin gtong bla na med pa gnang / 〈spyod 'jug 〉las/8(phyugs kyis bsgrubs na'ang mi dalon pa'i/ / mnog chung gang yin de don du/1 / dal 'byor phun tshosas rnyed dka' 'di/ / las kyis mnar ba rnam/sa kyis bcom/ / nyaha 'es bsungs ba ltar/ rang kho na'i ched du stod dbus gtsang nas smad rgya nag bar du khyi/ bzhin nyul te dad bshin gyi rgyu rdzas sang thob mdzod du bcus nas yar dkon mchog la mchod rnga/ dang / mar sprang bo la sbyin gtong phra mo tsam yang mi nus par sgrib gnyis yi dwags kyi rtul zhugs la gnas pa'i rang bde 'ba' zhig gi zla zas tsam la brtson pa ni dud 'gro phyugs kyis bsgrubs na'ang dka' ba ma yin pas na longs spyod gang la'ang 'jungs pa med par rnam gsum sbyin pa'i las la spro ba'i tshul 'di ni byang chupa sems dpa'i spyod nga/ ngo mtshar ba'o/ / de nas thun mong snang tshod du bya bra' sprang bo'i tshul mdzad nas ri khrod dben pa dang chu mis brgya rtsa bcas 'grim ste/ (las ngan 'khrul snang gi rgyu las byung ba'i gcod bya gnod byed/nye ring chags sdang sogs ma reg dug lnga las byung ba'i bya ba mtha' —60—
sku 'phreng gsu ma pa bskal bzang dam chos rgya mtsho/—dag la snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems sgom ste/ 〈 spyod 'jug 〉las/ 88lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang / / dus gsum dge ba thams cadagakyang / rna/ sems can kun gyi don sgrub phyir/ /phangs ba med par btang par bya/ / 99 gsungs pa ltar/bdag gces 'dzin rtsa ba nas bcad de lus srog phangs ba med par lha 'dre'i gzan du ster ba'i sprungs pa nyams len zab mo la rtag tu gzhol bas nyams rtog mthon po'i yon tan rgyud la 'khrungs pas mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med par bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad de mdzod dge spru'/ rgod ces mdo smad kun tu mtshan snyan gyis khyab par byas/ 1958lo'i dus 'gyur skabs su bla slob kyi chos 'brel la ser gas 'byung bar dgong sa nas rang yul du ma bzhugs par lha mo 'ang du gtan sdod gnang ste phal ba'i khyim pa ltar rgyal khab gyi las ka gang yod la phebs/ dus 'gyur gyi skabs sogs su thun mong snang grub kyi rdzu 'phrul dang lung bstan sogs mtha' yas pa 'dug kyang 'dir re re bzhin yi ge'i ngal ba ma byas la 'ga' zhig 'og nas dkyus gcig tu 'god par bya'o/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i 4lcags pho sprelan ( 198 0 ) lo nas —61—
rig gnas gsar rje'i g.yo 'gul drag po'i 'ching rgya tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i srid dus kyis pham par gtor te rgyal bstan yang dar gyi rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i nyi ma shar ba na rje 'di nyid kyang phyir rang dgon du phebs te 'du khang bskyar bzhengs dang / dgon pa'i 'grig khrims/ sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs sogs la do dam dang thugs khur zab mo bzhes/ rang dgon gyi 'chad spel dang phan bde kho na la dgongs nas so so'i 'dod mos ltar chos gsungs/ru sde'i nang gi 'tsho ba'i dka' ngal can rnams la snga phyir nas spyi rgya14250dang 'bras rgya ma1250phye rgya ma2506 g.yag drugbong bu gcig lug gnyis/ ri bong dgon la spyi 'jog sgor60892rgyal yongs sgyu rtsal lhan tshogs la sgor2000rdzong nang bstan mthun tshogs la sgor6000gling ba zhang lte pa'i slob grwa dang zhang 'phrod bston sman khang gnyis la sgor2000khyon mi rigs slob gso dang 'tsho ba'i dka' ngal can sa gnas rang skyong sogs kyi thad la sgor24929sbyin gtong gnang zhing khong nyid dus rgyun grwa rkyang dkyus ma'i tshul du bzhugs/ khong gi gzhan phan lhag bsam la gong rim nas kyang gzengs bstod dang bsngags —62—
brjod yang yang thob ste rgyal gces chos gces kyi mtshan snyan dang /zhang lte ba'i slob grwa'i mtshan 'dzin slob dpon dang zhang 'phrod besten sman khang gi mtshan 'dzin yon krang / rdzong chos lugs 5mthun tshogs kyi gtso 'gan pa/ khul chos lugs mthun tshogs kyi —tshogs mi/ ri bong dgon do dam u yon lhan khang gi kros rin bcas kyi las 'gan kyang rim par bzhes te mthug shor med mar phyag gas gnang / rje 'di nyid ni rtog ba klong du brdol zhing ci mdzad sprul ba'i zlos gar kyi rol rtsed bsgyur ba zhig lags pas tshur mthong phal ba'i mthun snang du grub pa'i mdzad pa ngo mtshar zhing dad ba bskyed pa brjod kyis mi langs pa 'gro ba kun gyi kha na 'jags med bzlas brjod kyi tshul du gnas pa las 'dir yid ches kyi dad pa 'dren pa'i lcags kyu ru cha tsam yi ge'i lam nas ston pa la/bcos bsgyur cung ma byas pa'i sngon du ri bong dgon gyi rten gtsor grags pa'i rgyal ba'i yum chen mo'i dpe cha byin can zhig yod pa rje 'di la phul/ khong gis rin gong mtho dma' la ltos pa med par pod re re byas nas phyogs la lung gi nyo mkhan su yod la btsongs bas skya ser phal mo ches log lta dang dmod tshig bar med du bsgrags/ rjes su bstan pa yang dar gyi rdzogs ldan shar ba na sngar —63—
btsongs pa'i dpe cha rnams phyogs so so nas phyir phul bas grangs bsgrigs tshe pod gcig kyang chad pa med pas skya ser kun gyis sngar bsags las la nongs 'gyod dang ngo mtshar gyi mdzad par ha las par gyur/ lcags pho sprel ( 198 0 ) lor tang gi mi rigs srid jus ngos 'beb dang rig ciganas gsar rje'i g.yo 'gul drag po'i 'ching rgya las grol nas bod brgyud nang bstan slar gso byed pa'i rdzogs ldan gyi nyi ma shar te gtsug lag khang dang sku gsung thugs rten mang bo gsar bzhengs byed skabs su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi'i dgra bo bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi sku la 'tshe ba/spru tshogs mthun sgril dang rnam ngakar gyi bya ba la phra rmo rdzun tshig gi dbyen 'byed pa/ chos srung gi mthu la mi skrag pa/ dkon mchog la skyabs med pa/ bla ma la yon tan med par smra ba sgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba'i bstan dgra dam nyams zhig gis khong rin po che'i sku la ngan sems dang byang chub chos 'phel gling gi bshad sgrub 'chad spel gyi rlabs chen 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang la gnod sems kyis go skabs dang stabs la ltas nas phyi rol mi stegs pa'i log chos la bsten nas mnan gtad dmod ngan gyi cho ga sgrub te mnan pa bzhag khong gis zag med ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs te rang — 64 —
cag dgon pa 'di'i rten khrod du lha sku zhig gi gzungs gzhug nang la mnan pa ba'ag yod 'di myur du ma blangs na grib skyon gyi nyen kha che tshul sogs dbu mdzad dkon mchog rgya mtsho dang dgon pa'i do dam u yo na sogs las sne la gsungs par tshang mas bka' gros mdzad nas khong gis blangs na grib skyon gyi nyen tshabs che bas mi 'thad / gsang ba sngags kyi rtsa la 'byor ba / mthu ldan nus stobs can zhig gdan drangs nas blangs na 'grig pa'i gros mthun byung /bla ma bstan pa rgya mtsho dang dge slong grags pa rgya mtsho spun gnyis kyis bya ba 'di khur len don 'khyol ba byas nas drag po gnam lcosas kyi me char 'bebs pa'i mthu ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa grub pa'i bo 'phang mthon por brnyes pa'i 'dam mda'i grupa chen pa rje blo gsal tshang gdan drangs/ rje nyid dang dgon pa'i do dam las sne bcas bla slob drus dang bcas mtshan mo'i go skabs la brten nas blangs pa 'o bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyi snang brnyan sman 'jim gyis bzos sku zhig yod pa de'i gzungs bzhug nang du mi btsang ba ste phag ze lta bu'i spu rigs dang klad zho lta bu snum gyi rigs/khrag dang bcas pa rtswa'i rigs/ 'dra gzugs mang bo la lcags — 65 —
sgrog rgyab yod pa dang / thag pa khri gang tsam bzhag yod pa bcas ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i sgom bzlas la brten nas tshang ma'i mngon sum du blangs/ mi gtsang thams cad gad snyigs dang lhan du me la bsregs/ brnab sems can des bsam ngan sbyor rtsub gyi brlag sems ngan pas gnod ma tshugs par gting 'don byas nas ston pa la slar yang tshad dang ldan pa'i gzungs gzhug phul te rab tu gnas par mdzad/shing mo gling gi ( 1985) lor gling ba bar ma'i yon bdag kha shas kyi re 'dod ltar khyim phebs gnang skabs su g.yo sgyu can gyi rkun po zhig gis stabs la ltas nas khong la dngul phor zhig yod pa brkus/ phyir gzim chung du slebs tshe dngul phor med pas zhabs phyi ba mngags nas rtsad gcod du song kyang lag son ma byung /nub mo sku mdun pa la ku re'i tshul gyis/ spyir na dngul phor de rin thang che ba'i dngos bo zhig min kyang gshin po dad pa can zhig gi 'bul pa yin pas gang na yod na mi bskyur gsungs/ gzim khar phyag phreng mdun cog steng du gor gor byas nas bzhag phyi nyin sku mdun pa yar langs skabs dngul phor phyag phreng dkyil du dngos su babs 'dug/ ——66—ji
yang stod ma'i mkhar shul tshang gi bu mo zhig thogs mdas bsad par khong gshin sngas su gdan drangs/ tshogs pa mang po la go sla ba'i 'bel gtam dang bslab bya sna tshogs gsungs nas bar do ngo sprod gnang zhing dad ldan mang tshogs kyi rgyud la thar ba'i sa bon bskrun/ bar do ngo sprod tshar rjes gshin po 'di'i lus phung na dngos po zhig yod pa 'dra bas 'pho lung 'thob dka' gsungs nas ltas par rna long cha gcig yod pa tshang mas mthong ba dang de nas khong la zhus pas spyan nam mkhar gzigs shing dmigs pa chen po'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag nas phaṭa sgra gsum gsungs pa na rnam shes dag pa chos dbyings su drangs song snyam pa'i nyams snang zhig tshang ma la shar/ sngar khong la skur 'debs kho na byed pa'i log lta can re gnyis la nyin der dad pa brtan po thob nas ci gsungs bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i dam bcas pa dang tshe rabs phreng pa'i bar du rjes su 'dzin pa'i skyabs 'jug zhus/me pho stag gi ( 1986) lor mtha' ba'i khyim tshang zhig gis rgya mag pa zhig gzhag pa lo gnyis tsam nas rang yul du song yun ring 'gor rjes 'phrin pa zhig 'byor ba ni kho rang gi khyim tshang dang pha ma nye 'brel dag gis bris pa'i 'phrin yin/ 'phrin yig las —67—
stabs ma legs par glo bur du bcos thabs bral ba'i nad zhig byung ste khyed tsho'i mag pa tshe las 'das song tshul gsal bo bris yod/gnas tshul de bo rjes rje 'di nyid gdan 'dren zhus nas 'pho ba gsung du bcug khong gis sngon 'gro bla ma rgyang 'bod nas bzung ste bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bsdu rim dang bcas rgyas par sasungs ming dmigs pa chen po'i ngang tshe 'das kyi rnam shes bde chen dag pa'i zhing du 'dren pa'i ded dpon chen por zhugs pa na mi de 'jig rten phyi ma na med par mkhyen nas 'pho ba ma gsungs/ mi de 'jig rten phyi ma na med 'dra ba snang greng ltar bdag gis phan mi thogs pas 'bul ba mi dgos sasungs/ zla ba gcig lhag 'gor rjes rgya mag pa phyir la thon pas khong gi chags thogs med pa'i ye shes kyi mkhyen pa la kun ngo mtshar bar gyur/rab byung bcu bdun pa me pho sprel ( 1992 ) lor sku dngos kyis byang chub ma chod rten zhig bzhengs nas gzungs 'jug ma phul bar tshogs chen 'du khong gi thog so gnyis par bzhugs su gsol nas gzungs gzhug 'bul ba'i dus zhig yod gsu ngas/ log lta can kha shas kyis lkog lab byas/ shing phag ( 1995 ) lor sku la bsnyung gzhi drag po bzhes/ khri chen lnga ba chen po sogs skyes bu — 68 —
dam pa mang bo dang lhag bar du stag tsha rje drung rin po ches bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i mgon du cis kyang bzhugs dgos tshul sogs brtan bzhugs nan mo gsungs pa dang bsnyung gzhi 'di che rkyen 'dzoms pa'i tshad ldan gyi sman khang zhig tu gshegs bcos byed dgos pa'i lung bstan gnang / dgon grong tshang mas zhabs brtan dang rim gro mang rdze byas nas rnga ba khul dmag yan lag sman khang du phebs te brtags pas mkhris pa'i rdo skran yin pa gsal po shes/ gong rim nas kyang rgyab skyor tshad med gnang ba dang sman rams pa mang bos bka' gros mdzad de gshegs bcos byas nas mkhris pa'i rdo skran blangs/ tha mal ba'i snang ngo la rdo skran rdog po lnga yod/rdo skran de dag sku mdun pa dang nye gnas sku g.yog dag sis nyar tshags byas nas phyir khyer yong / bsnyung gzhi sangs drag tu song ste phyir phebs skabs su rdzong chos don cu'u dang 'brel yod las khungs/ gling ba dgon grong tshang mas chibs su rgya chen po byas shing dad ldan mang tshogs la phyag dbang gnang / dgon pa'i las sne dang ru chen khag gi 'go 'dren rnams// khong gi sku mdun du yong ste 'tshams zhu dang brtan bzhugs phul bas/ thugs dgyes rna nyams chen pos da tshe yi 'phen pa zad na ma gtogs bar chad med/— 69 —
mkhris rdo de sngar bzhengs ba'i byang chub mchod rten du zhog dang sku geg yongs su rdzogs song ba yin gsungs/ sngon kyi rdo skran rdog lnga bo 'phel te ma ṇi ril bu tsam gyi rdog brgya dang brgyad cur 'phel yod pa dgon grong tshang mas mngon sum du mthong / de ni khong rin po che'i sku las byung ba'i rang besrel lam dad ldan mang tshogs la byin rten du gnang ba'i rin thang med pa'i bsam 'phel nor bu dbang rgyal las lhag go/ da rung rdzu 'phrul dang mkhyen pa la thogs pa med par dmangs khrod du rlung ltar grags pa mang yang yig tshogs la 'jigs nas ma bris so/ / de ltar rje 'di nyid kyi mdzad 'phrin gdugs dkar gyi grib bsil snum pos ris su ma mchis pa'i 4yangs pa'i ljongs chen por khya4ba bzhin da lta bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i dpal du zhabs pad mi 'gyur rdo rje'i khams su brtan te bzhugs bzhin lags la/ khong rin po che'i zhal nas 88da lta bdag lo grangs re bzhi yin / 'das pa'i lo mang bo'i brgyud rim mdor bsdus 'ig dngatshod lta'i gnas tshul sogs phal cher lo rgyus kyi yi ger bkod tshar 'dug mdzod dge bla ma tshul khrims rin chen gyis grwa sa chen mo la thugs smon gtad nas mi lo mang bo'i ring la bla slob zhal 'dzoms ma byung bdodaka' ba mang bor phrad/ der brten — 70—
bdag gi skye 'phreng brtsi tshul la yang rigs mi 'dra ba 'ga' re byung /gang ltar da lo mang bor nga yang 'dug min mi shes/ deng gi spyi tshogs dang snyigs ma'i mi la dad pa dang sems la 'gyur ldog che zhing drag shes brtan po zhig med pas ngas dgon grong kun la phyi ma'i sprul sku'i thad du bka' yig dam 'byar ma zhig 'jog rgyu'i gra sgrig yod/khyed cag dgon grong tshang mas sems bde mo byos dang / phyi ma'i sprul sku ni gangs can bcu phrag rig par mkhyen dpyod yangs shing ji bstan pa dang 'gro ba la gcig tu sman pa'i mchog sprul nyi gzhon gsar ba zhig 'byon rgyu yin par the tshom med nya ces bslu med lung bstan gyi nor bu gdan rabs kyi sa bon rtsom sgrig pa rnams la dngos su bstsal to/ /ji srid 'gro ba'i 'khor mtha' ma stong bar/de srid rgyal ba rgyal sras tshogs rnams kyis/ /sna tshogs sprul ba'i rol gar sgyur ba'i tshul/ /kha 'bab chu bo rnams bzhi'i rgyun la 'gran/ /gang zhig rgyu tshogs pa las 'bras smin pas/ /dge legs 'bum gyis mtshon min me tog cig/ /rnga ljongs 'dzin ma'i thig ler 'khrungs dang lhan/ /— 71 —
dbang gzhu'i gur khyim 'od kyis zlum por bsrungs/ /na tshod sgo nga'i spubs las ma grol kyang / /gdul bya'i lhag mar lus pa'i skal ldan 'gro/ /skyong du 'gro zhes brtse chen tshad ma'i lung / /sgyu 'phrul lha mo'i thos 'dzin rgyan du btas/sa/sngon gyi thugs bskyed lha chen gser gyi gzhu/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams shugs kyis 'then dang lhan/ /kun rmongs gzhom mkhas khyod sku rdo rje'i mda'/ /bkra shis chos gling khri la thol gyis zug/dus gsum gsal gzigs mkhas grub rab 'byams kyis/ /bslu med bka' lung dgongs pa gcig mthun te/ /mgon khyod sngon gyi khri la mnga' gsol bas/ /ljongs 'dir rdzogs ldan dus bzang slar yang bsus / / rgya bod gzhung calugs khang bzang gcig zlum pa/ /bshes gnyen nyin byed dbang bo'i dkyil 'khor las/ /legs bshad 'od zer stong gi bcud 'thungs pas/ /blo gros pad mo rgyas pa'i rtse dga' ngom/ /ya nga yang rnam gsum sbyin par goms drags pas/— 72 —
mang mang mdzod du spungs pa'i rgyu nom kun/ /lhag lhag med par spyin gtong mdzad pa'i tshul/ /lho da lhod mgrin pa'i lam nas bsngags bya'i phul/ /gha lha'i 'khrul snang 'khrugs pa yid kyi cha/tshor/ /bzung 'dzin bral ba'i gdon gyis brlams pa tsho'i / gyu sri'i log rtog spyan mig g.yo tsam gyis/ / bzung med dbyings su mchod la khyod nyid dpa'/ /ca gcig tu bdag gzhan mnyam brjer brtson brtson nas/ /gnyis snang spros pa'i kun rtog dbyings su thim/ /sku gsum lam du 'khyer shes gdam pa rnyed/ /bdud bzhi'i kha la gzhom med rdo rje bsnun/ /༈tshe rabs du mar sdig la cher rngam mu stegs lta bar stesatra 'cha' ba'i/ / zhing bcu kun tshang dam nyams dgra bos mnan gtang 'a/sa la cher 'bad kyang / zas gtsang sras po'i mdun sa dma' bar dga' rabs dpung tshogs ngal ba bzhin/ /gnod pas ma tshugs phyir mig med par rgya mtsho'i pha mthar — 73 —
bros so lo/ /nam zhig bsod nams ka bas ma thegs te/ /kho bo'i sgyu lus phung bo zhig gyur kyang / /chos srid mkhyen pa rgyas pa'i mchog sprul ni/ /ring min 'byon zhes gsungs 'di phyi rabs gsos/ /bkra shis chos gling tshang tshing nags ma'i rtser/ /lugs gnyis gshog yangs dkar po'i 'phur ldeng gis/ /dus gsum dge ba'i mgrin glu 'khrol bzhin du/ /mdzad 'phrin dga' ston nyams pa med par smon/ /sku bzhi'i khri la dbang 'byor bas/ /don dam 'das 'khrungs ma mchis kyang / /tshur mthong 'gro ba'i dpung gnyen du/ /zhabs pad mi 'gyur brtan gyur cig/ces ri bong dgon bkra shis byang chub chos 'phel gling gi gdan rabs bshad sgrub bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan las 7rje btsun skal bzang dam chos rgya mtsho'i che brjod pa'i sarga ste gsum pa'o/ /gnyis pa/ gdan rabs rim byon gyis skyong khur gnang tshul/— 74—
gdan rabs rim byon gyis skyong khur gnang tshul la gnyis/bka' chen gdan rabs rim byon gyis skyong khur gnang tshul/ /gdan sa rang nas byon pa'i mkhas grub 'ga'i mdzad rnam mo/ /dang bo/ bka' chen gdan rabs rim byon gyi skyong khur gnang tshul ni/ bka' drin mtshungs zla bral ba'i mdzod dge'i bla ma tshul khrims rin chen gyis ri bong dgon bkra shis chos 'phel gling gsar 'debs mdzad nas yun ring ma 'gor bar gtsang bkra shis lhun por chibs bsgyur gnang ste paṇa chen sku 'phreng bdun pa7rje btsun bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po mchog la mjal bas/kun gzigs mchog nas kyang thugs dgyes pa'i gsung gleng mang du 'phros/ rje tshul khrims rin chen gyis/ ngas mdo smad du rgyud sto da grwa tshang zhig gsar 'debs byas yod pas dgon mgo bkra shis lhun por phul ba lags na/ dgon 'di chos srid gnyis kyi cha nas skyong khur mdzad pa'i mkhan po zhig bkas gnang bar zhu zhus par kun gzigs mchog nas thugs dgyes pa'i gsungs gnang ste dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen mo bka' chen blo bzang dbang phyug— 75 —
zhes gzhung bka' pod lnga/ gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i cho gre phyag len dang bcas pa la nang byan chud pa zhig bzhugs pa dgon 'di'i mkhan por bskos/1gdan rabs dang bo bka' chen blo bzang ji dbang phyugde yang rje 'di nyid ni rab byung bcu sasum pa'i shing khyi (175 4 ) lor stod mnga' ris yul du sku 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas byis pa phal ba'i spyod tshul las ring du 'das te dbang bskur ba dang chos 'chad ba sogs kyi rnam 'gyur mang du bstan/dgung lo brgyad kyi steng chos sde chen po gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i chos sgor zhusas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung bka' pod lnga srogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa la gsan sbyang mthar phyin pa mdzad pas mkhas pa'i mtshan snyan thob/ khyad par du dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su gzhung bka' pod chen mo lnga gzhir bzhag gi steng / dbu ma rtsa shes / dbu ma 'jug pa / bzhi brgya ba/ṭīka chen rigs pa'i rgya mtsho/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal/ dbu ma'i stong thun sogs gzhung chen — 76 —
gdan rabs rir skyo na gyis skyong khur gnang tshul/grangs las 'das par dam bca' chen mo nga nag pas mkhas grub bye bas bstod bsngags me tog 'thor ba'i yu /'a du gyur cing kun gzigs paṇa chem bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang bo mchog nas bka' chen gyi mtshan btags gnang / de nas yul 'di'i sadul bya rnams rjes su 'dzin pa'i dus la babs pa na kun gzigs rin po che mchog nas bka' shog dang pad+ma ra ga'i bka' tham sogs bstsal te ri bong dgon gyi mkhan por bskos/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags khyi ( 1790 ) lor rje tshul khrims rin chen tshang dang lhan cig mdo smad kyi phyogs su chibs bsgyur gnang / rma klung dal 'bab ring mo'i 'gram ngogs su 'byor tshe yul skyong dge bsnyen la sgo dkar mo mngon sum du byon te phebs bsu sogs byas pas khong rnam banyis thugs rab tu dgyes/ skabs der bka' chem blo bzang dbang phyug mchog gis la sgor mchod bstod 'di mdzad/66) pad+ma 'byung gnas la sogs sngon dus kyi/ / grub pa'i dbang bos dam bzhag klu'i dge bsnyen/ / gnyan chen la sgo zhes grags 'khor tshogs bcas/ / mchod dang gtor ma gsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs/ / rta mchog rag pa glog chen 'khyug 'dra'i steng / / zag pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gying kha dog dkar/ /— 77—
res 'ga' dmar nag sa bdag khros pa'i gzugs/ / rtag bar mdung dmar gri 'dzin brtan par bzhugs/ / sngags drug phyag rgya ting 'dzin bcas pa yis/ / byin rlabs dkar dang dmar ba'i gtor ma dang / / sman rag chang phud gser skyems bsang sna'i sprin/ / 'bul gyi dgyes pa chen pos rol tu gsol/ /de ltar gsol nas sangs rgyas bstan pa dang / / lhag par rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha ba'i/ / bstan pa bstan 'dzin bcas pa'i zhabs brtan cing / / sbyin bdag 'khor bcas dar ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / khyad par yul 'di'i mi nor 'khor bcas kyi/ /bde 'bangs longs spyod rgyas shing dar ba dang / / gzhan gyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byed pa kun/ / myur du drag po'i chad pas gsod par mdzod/ / lhag bsam dag pa'i sbyi sbyi sbyi dge bsnyen la sgo la sogs srung mas kyang / / g.yel ba med par rtag tu grogs byed shog/9 ces pa'o/ / rim gyis mdzod dge gling dkar stod du phebs pa na bkra shis chos 'phel gling gi dge 'dun pa yongs dang gling ba stod smad bar gsum bcas dgon grong gnyis gas lam thag ring bom sa nas chibs su dang ser sbreng byas zhing /bla slob zhal 'dzoms byung ba'i gnas der bka' chen gad 'go zhes — 78—
thog tshul bla ma tshul khrims rinagachen gyi che ba brjod pa'i skabs bshad pa ltar ro/ /rim gyis dgon par phebs 'byor byung ste 'gyur med rdo rje'i khri 'phang mthon por mnga' gsol mdzad/ je tshul khrims rin chen mchog dang phan tshun la dbang bka' chos kyi rgyun kyang mang du spel/ / skal ldan du ma la rab byung dang dge tshul/ bsnyen rdzogs sogs kyi sdom pa gnang ba dang / lam rim dang sa lam/gzhi gsum lag len gyi khrid sogs kyang yang yang gnang / khyad par du zla gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad nas gsang chen rgyud kyi rgyal bo dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub mchod nyin bdun la 'tshogs pa'i —srol btsugs shing sbyin bdag kyang rje nyid nas gnang/ gzhan yang rgyud sde so so'i rdung phyag len dang me ri bca' bzo dbyangs bar rta/ dkyil 'khor gyis thig sogs kyang gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i phyag bzhes ltar du bslabs/ chos 'dul ba'i bca' khrims phra mo tsam la'ang thugs nyams len legs por 'jog dgos pa sogs kyi bslab ston kyang mang du gnang / de ltar bgrang bya bco brgyad kyi bar du lugs gnyis kyi bya bzhag thams cad la skyong khur zab mo gnang ste dgung lo nga lnga bzhes pa sa pho 'brug gi ( 18 02 )— 79—
lor chos sde chen po bkra shis lhun phor phyir phebs te gtong sgo dang bzhag 'jog rgya che ba gnang / de nas/ gdan sa chen po de nyid du skal ldan du ma la zab rgyas chos kyi gru char 'beb bzhin yun ring bzhugs ste rlabs chen 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba rnams legs par ma/thar phyin nas gzugs sku rags pa'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul bstan to/ /gdan rabs gnyis pa/ bka' chen blo bzang spyin pa/bka' chen blo bzang spyin pa dpal bzang bo lags ni rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing sprel ( 1769) lor kong po'i yul du sku 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas rab tu byung ste bkra shis lhun ngo 'i —chos grwar zhugs/ blo dang rig pa'i rnam dpyod mchog ritu yangs pa zhig yin pas gzhung chen bcu la sogs pa ra mkhas ba'i grags snyan rab tu 'bar/ mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos bkur de 'jam dgon snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa ma lus pa gsan/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i sa mo sbrul gyi( 12 09) lor paṇa chen bstan paldi nyi ma mchog nas bka' tham dang bka' shog gnang ste dgon 'di'i mkhan por mnga' gsol/ dgon 'dir phebs te lugs gnyis — 80—
kyis skyong khur zab mo gnang zhing dbang lung man ngag sogs kyang mang du spel/ khyad par du hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu gcig nas 'phags ma rnam par rgyal ma'i mchod pa nyin lnga/ tor zla dgu ba'i tshes nyer gnyis nyin bkra shis gso spyong dang / kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgrub mchod chen mo nyin bdun/ spyin sreg dang bcas pa la 'tshogs pa'i srol btsugs shing phyag len mtha' dag zhib rgyas su gnang / de ltar lo 'khor nyi shu'i bar du dgon 'di'i 'jigs bral rdo rje'i khri la bzhugs te/ sa glang ( 18 29) lor khri mthar phyin pa'i dga' ston rgya cher bltar te dpal ldan bkra shis lhun por phyir phebs/ mang 'gyed dang spyi 'jog sogs mang du byas/ de nas gdan sa rang dang ri khrod sogs su rtse gcig sgrub pa la gzhol ba'i mur zhi phar gshegs so/ /gdan rabs gsum pa/ ri bka' chechod byams pa ༷ rin po che/bka' chen byams pa rin po che ni gtsang rta nag gi yul du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun gyi steng nas chos sde chen po bkra shis lhun po'i chos grwar zhugs/ 4 lnga rig bshes gnyen du ma bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten te mdo sngags rig gnas dang — 81 —
bcas pa la thos bsam rdo rus thug pa lta bu gnang / dgung lo so lnga'i thog gzhung chen bcu'i dam bca' chen mo bzhag ste bka' chen gyi mtshan btags blangs/ lcags stag gi lor kun gzigs paṇa chen mchog nas bad+ma ra ga'i bka' tham dang bka' shog sogs legs par gnang ste dgon 'di'i mkhan khrir mnga' gsol/ lo der bsu ba rgya chen po dang bcas bkra shis chos 'phel gling 'dir phebs te mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i khri 'phang mthon por bzhugs shing khri ston yang rgya cher byas/ dbang lung dang sa lam bskyed rdzogs sogs kyi khrid gnang / skal ldan du ma ngur smrig tshangs spyod 'dzin pa'i dpal la bkod/ khyad par du bskang gso rnams kyi dbyangs dang bar rta/ dgong mo'i gling skyor sogs gsar 'dzugs dang smon lam chen mo'i 'tshogs tshul dang gsung rtsotshul rnams la dag bcos legs po byas/ de yang rje 'di grub pa mthon por gshegs pa zhig yin pas so so skye bo'i blo las 'gongs pa'i ya mtshan gyi rtags mang du bstan pas shing bza' rdo rje 'chang sogs skyes chen du mas kyang zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs shing bsngags brjod kyi rol mo cir yang dkrol/ bgrang bya nyer brgyad bar du dgon 'di la skyong khur zab mo gnang ste rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me — 82—
sprul lor khri mthar phyin pa'i dga' ston sogs legs par byas te/phyir bkra shis lhun por phebs nas bzhag 'jog dang mang 'gyed sogs rgya cher spros/ de ltar sku tshe gang bor thos bsam sgom gsum gyis dus 'da' bar mdzad de gdan sa rang du sku mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan to/ / gdan rabs bzhi pa/ bka' chen blo bzang ༷ ༷'phrin las/rje blo bzang 'phrin las mchog ni stod mnga' ris kyi phyogs su sku 'khrungs shing dgung lo dgu'i steng du bkra shis lhun po'i chos sgor zhugs nas dge bshes mang po bsten te gzhung bka' pod lnga la thos bsam gting thug pa byas/ khyad par dbang bka' lung sogs kyi gdams pa mang du gsan cing rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi dgongs don dang phyag len mtha' dag kla byang chub par gyur/ dgung lo so druge steng gzhung chen bcu'i dam bca' bzhag nas bka' cachen gyi mtshan btags thob/ de nas rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i sa rta ( 12 58 )lor paṇa chen sku phreng brgyad pa dpal ldan chos grags bstan pa'i ri gadbang phyug mchog nas bka' tham dang bka' shog gnang ste dgon 'di'i mkhan khrir dbang bskur/ lo der dgon 'dir phebs — 83 —
gdan rabs gnyis pa ngaka' chen blo bzang spyin pa/nas sngar ltar skyong khur bzhes / khyad par du hor zla bdun pa'i tshes drug nyin rgyan druku mchog gnyis kyi phyag mchod dang tshes bcu drug nyin mi 'khrugs nga 'i stong mchod sogs gsar 'dzugs gnang /lo nyer bzhi'i bar tu 'jigs bral rdo rje'i khri la bzhugs nas lcags 'brug lor khri mthar phyin pa'i dga' ston gnang ste gdan sa rang du phyir phebs/ de nas chos sde chen po de nyid du rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la phyag rjes rlabs che ba bzhag nas zhi bar gshegs so / /༷ gdan rabs lnga ba/ bka' chen dam chos dpal 'bar/rje bka' chen dam chos dpal 'bar mchog ni bkra shis lhun po'i nye 'dabs kyi khyim tshang dbul bo zhig tu sku 'khrungs/ nar son pa na yab yum gnyis kyis chos sde chen po de nyid du bzhugs nas rabaca tu byung / mtshan la dam chos dpal 'bar tu gsol/gzhung chen du ma thugs 'dzin dang mdo sngags gnyis kyi dgongs don la thos bsam mthar phyin/ dgung lo nyer gnyis thog paṇa chen bstan pa'i dbang phyug dpal bzang po'i zhal sngar dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bslab gzhi yongs su tshang pa'i bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes te bslab khrims mig 'bras bzhin du srung — 84 —
gabar mdzad/ dgung lo so dgu'i steng gzhung bcu'i dam bca' bzhag nas bka' chen mtshan btags blangs/ rab byung bco lnga'i lcags sbrul ( 122 1 ) lor rje chubastan pa'i dbang phyug mchog gis bka' tham dang bka' shog gnang ste hor zla brgyad pa'i nang gling 'dir phebs shing khri ston yang ha cang rgyas pa gnang / 'grig lam kun spyod sogs la gzigs rtogs shin tu zhib mo mdzad cing gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs kyi dbang dang bka' lung mang du bstsal/ lo nyer lnga'i bar du skyong khur byas nas sa sprel lor khri mthar phyin gyi dga' ston gnang ste gdan sa rang du phyir phebs/mang 'gyed dang spyi 'jog sngar las lhag bar byas/ de nas yang dgon sde 'ga' zhig gi khri dang dge rgan gyis 'gan bzhes shing dgung lo don bzhi'i steng gzugs sku rags pa'i bkod pa chos dbyings subasdus so/ /gdan rabs drug pa/ bka' chen blo bzang ༷ dpal ldan/bka' chen blo bzang dpal ldan mchog ni stod mnga' ris kyi yul sde chung ba zhig tu ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du rnam dang bcas te sku bltams/ chung ngu'i dus nas gtsang bkra shis lhu na po'i chos grwar — 85 —
zhusas/ bka' pod rab 'byams kyi gzhung la sbyang brtson gyis mthar phyin/ dgung lo nyer dgu'i steng kun gzigs brgyad pa chen po'i mdun nas bsnyen rdzogs kyis sdom pa bzhes shing mtshan blo bzang dpal ldan du gsol/ dgung lo so brgyad steng gzhung chen mo bcu la dam bca' rgya che ba mdzad pas bka' chen gyi mtshan btags thob/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing sprul ( 190 5 ) lor paṇa chen sku phreng dgu ba chen po blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dge legs rnam rgyal dpal bzang po mchog nas rje 'di nyid la rin chen pad+ma ra ga'i bka' tham dang bka' shog/ rang byung du grags pa'i bag rtse'i btsan mdung dmar bo sogs gnang ste dgon 'di'i mkhan khri ru phebs dgos pa'i bka' lung gser gyi me tog spyi bor bstsal bas/ dgyes bzhin zhal gyis bzhes te hor zla bzhi ba'i nang gling 'dir chibs bsgyur mdzad/ rang byung gi btsan mdung byin rlabs kyi tshan kha rab tu 'bar ba de dgon pa'i bstan srung gi gtso bo bag rtse'i phyag tu bzhag te rab tu gnas par mdzad/ rten 'brel dang dge ltas mang bo byung bar tshang mas gleng / (dus 'gyur skabs su btsun pa rgan bgres rnams kyis dgon 'di'i byin rten khyad par can de srin po ling ka mgrin bcu'i zas skal du ma byin par sa 'og tu sbas/— 86 —
de nas mi lo sum cu lhag la rdul khrod du gzim dgos byung yang rdzogs ldan skyid pa'i nyi ma shar ba dang mnyam du can a dpal dag gis sa 'og nas blangs skabs sngon ltar dmar 'od 'khyug bzhin bzhugs/ khrus gsol dang spos sna bsu ba ser sbreng dang bcas bag rtse'i phyag tu phul skabs bkru shis pa'i sbrang char sim sim du babs te sngon ltar dge ltas du ma byung ba mngon sum du grub/) chos sde 'dir bka' drin lhag par che ste/ skal ldan du ma la dbang lung man ngag gis tshim par mdzad cing / sgra dang snyan ngag rtsis sogs rig gnas kyi skor dang / lam rim sngags ——rim bskyed rdzogs/ sa lam sogs kyi dpe khrid mang du gnang /zla de'i tshe'i nyer brgyad nyin gsar bu rnams la rgyud sde sogs kyi blo rgyugs blangs/ gzhan hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bdun nas mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i sgrub mchod chen mo sbyin sreg dang bcas ba nyin brgyad la 'tshogs pa'i srol chen gsar 'dzugs gnang / bsgrub bya du ma ngur smrig tshangs spyod 'dzin pa'i dpal la bkod/ lo nyer lnga'i ring dgon 'di la bka' drin dpag par dka' ba'i skyong khur gnang zhing mkhan khri legs par mthar phyin nas gdan sa chen po bkra shis lhun po ru phyir phebs/ rgyun srol ltar mang 'gyed dang spyi 'jog tshad med byas/ gdan sa rang dang chos sde du ma'i bu slob — 87 —
grangs las 'das par dam pa'i chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ de ltar sku tshe'i mdzad pa rnams yongs su rjogs te dgung lo gya gcig be+e steng gzugs sku zhi dbyings su thim tshul bstan to/ /gdan rabs bdun pa/ rje blo bzang yon tan/rje blo bzang yon tan mchog ni gtsang du sku 'khrungs shing chung ngu'i dus nas rab tu byung / bkra shiris lhun po'i chos grwar zhugs/mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa la mkhas pa'i grags snyan rab tu 'bar/ dgung lo zhe gcig bzhes pa rab byung cu drug pa'i sa sprul ( 1929) lor kun gzigs paṇa chen mchog gis bka' tham sogs gnang ste dgon 'di'i mkhan khrir mnga' gsol mdzad/lo bcu'i bar du lugs gnyis kyi skyong khur zab mo bzhes shing khri mthar phyin pa'i dga' ston sogs sngar rgyun ltar gnang ste sa stag lor phyir gdan sa rang du phebs nas gtong sgo sogs rgya cher bltar ro/ /gdan rabs brgyad pa/ rje blo bzang bkra shis /je blo bzang bkra shis mchog ni stod mnga' ris kyi phyogs su sku 'khrungs shing dgung lo lnga'i steng bkra shis lhun po'i chos sgor zhugs/ cho ga chos spyod mang bo thugs 'dzin gnang / khyad par — 88—
rgyud sde sogs kyi phyag len dang gar thig dbyangs gsum la mkhas pa'i tshad mar gyur/ paṇa chen sku phreng dgu ba chen mo las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa stag( 1928 ) lor bkra shis lhun po gzhung nas dgon 'di'i khri la bskos/ 'on kyang skabs der paṇa chen dgu ba chen mo'i dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i lo yin pas bka' tham dang bka' shog sogs gnang yod kyang thugs dam pad+ma ra ga min par grags/ rje 'di nyid lo gsum las khrir bzhugs rgyu ma byung bar gdan sa 'di ra gzugs sku mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan cing gdung mchod nyin du ma'i bar du byas so/ /gdan rabs dgu ba bka' chen byams pa kun bzang /mkhan po byams pa kun bzang mchog ni stod mnga' ris su sku 'khrungs shing chung ngu'i dus nas bkra shis lhun po'i rtse rnam rgya' grwa tshang du zhugs / sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi sogs la sakhas pa'i dbang bor gyur/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags sbrul ( 1961) lor kun gzigs bcu ba chen mo 7paṇa chen er ti ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo mchog chos sde chen po sku 'bum — 89 — —
du bzhugs skabs bka' chen byams pa kun bzang mchog la bka' tham sogs bskur nas ri bong dgon gyi mkhan khrir bzhugs dgos pa'i bka' bstsal/ lo der sku 'khor gsum dang bcas mdo smad du chibs bsgyur mdzad pas yul 'di'i dgon grong gnyis kyis bsu ba ser sbreng rgya chen po byas/ chos/ srid lugs gnyis kyi bya bzhag gang la'ang thugs khur nan mo bzhes shing gling ba stod smad bar gsum gyi dud khyim so so'i re ba chos kyis bskangs/ dus rgyun dkar zas rkyang rkyang bzhes shing gsung gleng mang bo med par kha ton sgrub sbyong la brtson pa chags med gnang / rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa khyi ( 1958 ) lo'i dus 'gyur chen po'i skabs nag nyes kyi zhwa mo bkab ste ngo rgol dang gcar rdung shas mi bzod pa mang bo byas rjes mdzod dge rdzong gi khrims khang du khrid/ re zhig nas si khron (tshirgya )zer ba'i mtha' 'khob kyi khrims khang zhig tu khrid de lo lnga la btson 'jug byas/ de rjes khrims khang nas btson grol btang kyang rang yul dang ri bochego degon gnyis kur ma phebs par gnas der lo lnga tsam la bzhugs te sku gshegs so/ /gdan rabs bcu ba rje blo bzang sbyin pa/rje blo bzang sbyin pa mchog ni dgung lo bdun gyi steng gtsang — 90 —
bkra shis lhun po'i chos sgor zhugs te thos bsam rgya cher byas/dgung lo nyer gnyis kyi steng bzhag sdom khang sar dbon gyi mkhan khrir phebs te skyong khur byas shing rgyal dge dgon par yang gzigs rtogs rgya cher gnang / bcos bsgyur skabs phyir rang yul du phebs dbang ma byung bar btson khang tu khrid/ rgyal bstan yang dar gyi skabs slar yang bzhag sdom khang sar dgon gyi khri la bzhugs /spyi lo ( 192 1 ) lor ri bong dgon dang gling ba stod smad bar gsum gyis yul skyong la sgo'i nye 'dabs kyi thang chen du kun gzigs bcu ba chen mo mchog gdan drangs te/ ri bong dgon 'dus spyi nas nged cag la ra/khan po zhig mngags dgos tshul zhus par kun gzigs mchog nas rje blo bzang sbyin pa tshang la khang sar dgon dang ri bong dgon gnyis mnyam du skyong dgos pa'i bka' bstsal/ de nas bzung je blo bzang sbyin pa mchog lo re bzhin dgon 'dir phebs te thugs skyong tshad med byas shing gling ba tsho ba gsum gyis kyang gshin po gang yod kyi bla mar gdan 'dren dang 'bul ba rgya cher bstar/ ri bong gong 'gab kyi lab rtse gsar tu bstod/ spyi lo ( 19〈〈 ) lor ri bong dgon du gos sku chen mo bshams mjal gyi srol gsar tu btsugs shing gos sku gsar bzhengs kyi 'gan len — 91 —
gnang / 1989lor rtse sngags pa grwa tshang gi phyag rgyun ltar gyi 'cham chen gsar du btsugs shing 'cham gos yongs rdzogs bzo ba'i las 'gan khur/ rjes su zhal 'bag kyang gtsang nas bzhengs te gdan drangs/ gzhan yang smon lam chen po'i bla bre bzo grub ma dang / jo sku li ma dngul gyi phra rgyan can/ ja pra brgyad sogis spyi 'jog rgya cher byas shing da lta zhabs pad brtan cing mdzad 'phrin 'phel ba'i skabs lagasaso/ /de ltar chos sde 'di'i gdan rabs rim byon gyi rnam thar mdo tsam brjod zin na yang 'khrungs 'das kyi lo tshigs dang mdzad pa gzhan mang bo zhig la da dung yang blo ldan rnams kyis dpyad pa mang du byed dgos pa'i gams so/ / snying rje'i gter chen rgyal dang rgyal sras kyis/ /'khor mtshor bying ba'i 'gro rnams sgrol ba'i tshul/ /khyab 'jug yid kyirol ba mar ka ras/ /sa chen snying bo 'degs pa'i dpal la 'phya/ /drurgyal bstan dri med gser gyi gong bu che/ /— 92 —
lung dang rigs pas bcad sbyang byed mkhas pa'i/ /gdan rabs rim byon ('phrin las snang ba'i gzis/ /dge 'dun gur kum gsar ba'i sde chen rgyas/ /chos phung bgyed khri'i rin chen gan mdzod las/ /khyad 'phags gsang sngags yid bzhin dbang sga rgyal/ /thos bsam dar dpyangs rtse mor mchod byas tshe/ /ci 'dod dngos grub 'jo ba'i skal bzang rnyed/ /dbang lung man ngag sbrang char me tog 'beb/ /bskyed rdzogs sgom sgrub dbyar gyi chu gter rgyas/ /gsang sngags bla med rdo rje theg mchog gi/bshad sgrub 'khor lo 'dzin pa'i sde 'di rmad/ /mkhas grub 'bum phrag ma dros gzangs can las/ / rilegs 'khrungs grib bsil snu ma pa'i chu 'dzin che/ /'gro ba'i tsha gdung gnyen por brel pa na/ /tsa ta ka rnams dga' bas glu sgra sgrog/zab zub gsang chen bla med rgyudasogs rgyud bzhi'i cho ga gsungs pas stun / /— 93 —
snyan snyan chos kyi tshangs pa'i dol mor nol rnams zung 'jug go 'phar myuXr/ /myur myur bde chen rgyal ba'i dgu' ston dgu' ba la ni sbyor ba'i phyir/ /phyir phyir le lo gnyis snang daXng bcas deXng 'dir spongs shing rtsom pas brel/ /dus kyi mtha' mar gyur kyang thub pa'i bstan/ /mdo sngogs 'chad nyan yar zla'i 'phel khar 'gran/ /'khor 'das skyon yon rtog pa'i khrims ldan sdes/ /'dzam gling mtha' dbus med par mdzes par brgyan/ /ces ri bong dgon bkra shis byang chub chos 'phel gling gi gdan rabs bshad sgrub bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan las bka' chen gdan rabs rim byon gyis skyong khur gnang tshul brjod pa'i sarga ste bzhi ba'o/ / — gnyis pa/ gdan sa rang gi mkhas grub 'ga'i mdzad rnam/je btsun bla ma dam pa tshul khrims rin chen gyi thugs smon nyi 'od dron pos legs par bskyangs pa'i dgon 'dir/ tshe gcig — 94 —
sgrub pa snyoms shing rtog pa klong du brdol ba'i nyams len pa dang /mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa 'i bka' pod gzhung lugs mang bor mkhyen rgya mkha' las yangs shing mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum la ma nga' brnyes te bstan pa'i khur chen 'degs nus pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi mkhas grub ji snyed cig byon pa las phal cher dus yun gyis ring du bskal bas rnam thar sa bon mi rnyed pa dang / re 'ga' dus 'gyur chen pos me lha'i zhal du bstims pas 'dir brjod pa'i skal ba ma ldan mod/ nye rabs su byon pa'i mkhas grub 'ga'i mdzad rnam mdor bsdus shig 'bri ba la/thug tshang a khu nyi ma/gsang chen rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i cho ga bskyed rdzogs dang bcas pa g.yas 'khyil mgrin pa'i lam nas snyan par sgrog pa'i nges don gyi yongs 'dzin jam pa 7thug tshang a khu nyi ma mchog ni rab byung bco lnga ba'i thams cad 'dul ba zhes pa me mo phag ( 1827 ) lor yab thug tshang ngag dbang dang yum sgrol ma skyed bya ba gnyis la sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gsum steng du ri bong dgon gyi tshogs grwal du zhugs nas bshes gnyen chen po rje dpal ldan rgya mtsho tshang sogs tshad ldan gyi slob dpon du ma tshul bzhin du bsten/ klog la — 95 —
byang ba'i phyir rdo rje gcod pa blo la ma byang bar du tsheg ded byed du bcug pas yi ge dkar nag dnga'abri klog la blo bskyed ya bral ba byung / bshes gnyen rnams kyis snod ldan gyi slob ma brtson 'grus can zhig yin par mkhyen nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang dus 'khor/ kun rig mi 'khrugs pa sogs kyi 'don rta dbyangs rdung phyag len thams cud dang chos spyod yongs rdzogs kyi khrid sba gsang med par lhug stsol gnang / khong gis kyang chung dus nas rang dgon gyi bya ba mtha' dag la thugs khur byed pa dang che ba rgan bgres la ñca bkur sri zhu byed pa sogs dam pa'i rang gshis lhan skyes su chags/ grwa sa chen po rnams su ma zhugs kyang tshe rabs snga ma'i bag chags dang lha skyes kyi mkhyen rgya rab tu yangs pas bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun khong du chud pas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi 'khor lor dbang 'byor bar gyur/ dus rgyun gtsang sbra dang thugs zhib ha cang che bas dgon pa'i gtsug lag khang bzo bskrun dang mtha' na gtor ma bca' bzo sogs gang thad du thun mongs ma yin pa'i nges cha dang lag rtsal ldan pas tshang mas gtsug gi tog ltar bkur/rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags sprul ( 1941 ) lor dpon — 96—
gong 'gab dang rang dgon gyi bla ma las sne bcas gcig mthun gyis rnam 'dren dam pa 7rje skal bzang dam chos rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i yongs 'dzin du bsko bzhag mdzad/ mchog sprul dam par byams skyong gang legs gnang zhing rang dgon gyi sgrig lam do dam dang khyad par sku sger gyis gsung rab dpe mdzod lha khang zhig smyo bzhengs te nang du sku gsung thugs rten dang mchod rdzas yo byad ma tshang ba med pa bzhag 'jog gnang pa ma zad chu byi ( 1912 )lor khong dang gdan rabs drug pa bka' chen blo bzang dpal ldan rnam gnyis kyis rta mgrin lha khang zhig gso dang rgya bskyed gnang ba sogs phyogs gang thad nas bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnang /khyad par sde 'dir bshes gnyen chen po 7rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sogs gsung skyes kyi bu slob mang bo bskyangs/rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing lug ( 1955 )lor sku lus la bsnyun zug cher med kyang rtag 'dzin can rnams kyi rgyud la mi rtag 'du shes bskyed cing yang dag chos la bskul phyir rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi bsnyen pa gsung bzhin zhi bar gshegs so/ /sum mthil dge bshes phun tshogs yon tan/— 97—
sum mthil dge bshes chen mo rje 7phun tshogs yon tan mchog ni ( mdzod dge'i rdzong rme chu zhang ) 'bos sum mthil tshang la sku 'khrungs/ byis pa'i dus su pra tshag cig yin pas yab yum gyis grwa sa zhig la bzhag nas sgrig 'og tu bcug na legs snyam ste gdan sa chen po gser khri dgon dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling gi chos sgor bcug stag tshang lha mo tshang sogs tshad ldan gyi bshes gnyen mang bo bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin bsten te thos brtson lhod med gnang bas rig gzhung mang bor rnam dpyod kyi blo rtsal rab tu rgyas/rig byed ma lhag pa'i lha ru bsten ti bsnyen pa mang du bzlas pas sngar las lhag pa'i blo rtsal ngo mtshar ba 'phel/ de nas gser khri dgon gyi bla ma re'i yongs 'dzin dang 'chad khrid dge rgan du bsko tsis byas pa na mtshan mor bros bshog kyis sku 'bum byams pa gling la phyag phebs gnang nas mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i rig pa'i khyu mchog dam pa the dpa' ris rab gsal tshang bshes gnyen du bsten nas dka' spyad rdo rus thug pa lta bus gzhung bka' pod chen po lnga la sbyangs pa dpyis phyin pa mdzad pas dge bshes kyi mtshan rtags blangs shing snyan pa'i dbyar rnga phyogs brgyar lder/ je dpa' ris rab gsal tshang gi bka' yi — 98—
cod pan spyi bor phabs te khyod kyis sngon gyi ku sā li dang bka' gdams pa rnams bzhin gnas nges med 'grims la 'khrul snang lha 'dre'i gzugs su snang ba de dag thams cad dang nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i snyems byed kyi rtsa ba 'di chod la chos kyi skal ba chad pa'i 'gro ba mang bo la skyabs 'gro dang rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas 'gro ba'i blo kha chos la bsgyur bar brtson na phan che ba sogs 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan mang bo bstsal / de nas gdan sa chen po gser khri dgon du phebs nas khri chen rin po che'i yongs 'dzin dam pa a khu rab rgyas tshang sogs dang / byams me 'bras spungs dgon/ a skyid ser ba dgon/ gro tshang dgon sogs dgon sde mang bor phyag phebs gnang ste bu slob mang bo bskyangs/ rje dpa' ris rab gsal tshang gi bka' ltar ri khrod dben pa dang chu mig brgya rtsa 'grims/ dgung grangs bzhi bcu'i nang la son pa'i skabs shig nas gdan sa chen po ri bong dgon gyi tshogs la zhugs 'dun skyes te tshogs zhugs gnang zhing dgon 'di'i tshogs 'don thams cad thugs la bzung / rgyud sde so so'i gzhung dang rtsa 'grel/gzhi gsum lag len dang / skyabs khrid/ khong gis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i lam rim chen mo'i zin bris shog grangs lnga brgya lhag yod — 99—
pa sogs kyi khrid mang bo gnang / khong la ljags rtsom 'ga' re yod kyang dus 'gyur gyi skabs su me sreg bor gtor sogs kyi rkyen dbang du gyur bas da lta nga tsho'i mjal skal du ma ldan la/ yongs 'dzin dam pa dang khong rnam gnyis kyi sku bstod sbrags ma ste/'jam dpal dbyangs dngos blo bzang dab gsal zhabs/ /'bral med rigs kyi bdag por bsten pa'i mthus/ /phun tshogs yon ta na mdzod la dbang 'byor ba'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 4sol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di rje nyid kyi gsung yin pas da lta slob ma 'gas zhal 'don byed bzhin pa'o/ /dus kyi g.yo 'khyom skabs te spyi lo ( 1958 ) lor mdzod dge rdzong mi dmangs khrims khang du phebs dgos byung / de'i skabs ris med kyi khrims pa ba mang bo la nad yams chen po byung ste mi mang bo tshe las 'das bar khong gis thugs kyis ma bzod par gong rim gyis mnar gcod dang rdung rdeg gang la'ang 'dzem dogs med par khrims pa ba'i tshogs la bde mchog rkang brgyad ma gsungs nas bka' bgo dang zhal phu gnang bas nad yams de'i mtshams chad par gleng / sa mo phag ( 1959 ) lor khrims khang du rkyen — 100 —
