rtsonges par bzung ste mchod pa byas gyur na/ /bskal par bsags pa'i sdig chen rab bcom nas/ /shin tu mi zad gshin rje'i grong las thar/ /stong gsum skye bo mig bral srog nyams la/ /mig srog byin kyang de yi dper mi phod/ /de bzhin skye bo dgra bcom la bkod nas/ /bskal par mchod pa'i dge bas dper mi phod/ /bskal ba grangs med byas pa'i sdig pa yang / /mun la nyi ma ji bzhin ma lus sel/ / 〉〉zhes gsung ba ltar tshe rabs 'di dang bskal ba grangs med du bsags pa'i nyes ltung thams cad dang ma rung dug gsum las byung pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba'i nyes pa mtha' dag sel ba'i thabs zab sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob pa'i dge ba rlabs chen ldan pa tshad mas grub bo/ / sgor khri phrag kha shas kyis bzhengs ba'i sku —gdung byang chub mchod rten de 'du khang chen mo'i dri gtsang phug tu gdan drangs nas dad ldan 'gro ba'i bsod nams gsog pa'i rten du bzhugs su gsol lo / /gzhan ya nga dgon 'dir nye ba'i dus su'ang / gzhung brgya — 117 —
smra ba'i dbang bo blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa rje bstan pa rgya mtsho sogs mdo sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i mkhas grub bgrang las 'das pa byon dang 'byon bzhin pa lags so/ /rta mchog bdun gyi shugs la ma brten skya rengs bu mo'i bsu ma med/ /bcu gnyis khyim gyi phebs lam mi ldan pad mo'i 'dab lo grol min pa'i/ /rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i mthongs su rab 'phags 'chad spel 'od zer 'bum 'byed mkhan/ /thugs bskyed kun tshang nyi sga gcig gis ljongs 'di'i mun tshogs lhag med gzhil/ /rigs rus mthon po sum mkhril gangs las rgyal sras seng chen ngar ma 'khrungs/ /phun tshogus rnam dpyod mche ba rab rno lung rigs ral ba sdug cing snum/ /bcu phrag ldon taXn lus stobs dar te rgol ngan gshed du rgyu ba'i tshe/ /— 118 —
dus 'gyur chom rkun mtshon la drangs pas snying rlung dmar ngo sangs thams med/ /dkon pa'i mardog gyur mdo sngags rgyal bstan mi dbang nor bzang mnga' thang med/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can khyad par bzung ba'i ngo mtshar tshangs ba'i dbyangs kyi dpal/ /ma bzod drag sngags bzlas par 'bad pa'i rtog ge ha ri nag po'i dpung / /kun nas pham tshe bshad sgrub rgyal mtshun mkha' ru bsgrengs khyod bstan pa'i rgyan/ /chos brgyad mdzes mas lus sems bslus te 'ga' res gzhung lugs chang bzhin 'thungs/ /bang mdzod stong ba'i 'dre gdon gsod phyir kha cig drag sngags bzlas bar brtson/ /nges don bshad sgrub dri bral gangs ljongs mkha' mthar dben pa'i dus/ / ri'khor 'das skyon yon ji bzhin mkhyen pa'i mkhas grub khyed rnams skal bas rnyed/ /— 119 —
mtha' bral sngo bsangs nam mkha'i mthongs/ /nyi zla'i 'od kyis mdzes pa ltar/ /bkra shis chos gling sde chen po/ /nges don bshes gnyen dag gis bsrungs/ /rgyud chen kun dga' don 'grub nas bzung ste/ /brgyud pa'i gsang ba sngags kyi gaṅgā mo/ /rgyud stod mtha' bral rgya mtsho'i ngogs yangs 'dir/ /thos bsam sgom pas drangs rnams bka' drin zab/ /yar ngos tshes kyis chu klung rnam bzhi bskyed/ /des kyang zla ba'i 'phel kha rdzogs pa bzhin/ /gsung skyes bu slob gur kum gsar ba'i sdes/ /khyed cag mdzad bzang skyong la kun nas brel/ /zhes ri bong dgon bkra shis byang chu ba chos 'phel gling gi dan rabs bshad sgrub bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan las gdan sa rang gi mkhas grub 'ga'i mdzad rnam brjod pa'i sarga ste lnga ba'o/ /gsum pa/ dus 'gyur chen po'i skabs nyams rgud byung tshul/rje btsun bla ma tshul khrims rin chen gyi thugs bskyed dang — 120 —
bka' chen gdan rabs rim byon/ gdan sa rang gi mkhas grub rim byon gyis gtsos dge 'dun gyi sde chen pos ri bong dgon gsar du tshugs nas mi lo nyis brgya la nye ba'i bar nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu thos bsam gyis dus 'da' bar mdzad cing lha khang dang 'du khang rten dang brten pa rbacas phyogs thams cad nas dbyar gyi chu gter chen po'i dpal la co 'dri brtson zhing bslab gsum sde snod 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun pa nyis brgya la nye bar 'phel rgyas bla na med pa byung yang sems can spyi mthun gyi las dbang dmar phyogs zla ba'i rjes su bsnyegs pa sa pho khyi'i ( 1958 ) lo nas gangs can sā la'i sman ljongs chen mor rgyu skar ltar bkra ba'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin sbyin bdag dang bcas pa la nyams 'grib chen po byung ba ltar/lo de'i zla brgyad pa'i tshes bzhi nas dgon 'dir yang nyams rgud byung ste lha khang dang 'du khang so so'i sgo brgyabs cing dge 'dun pa rnams mtha' ba yul tsho'i mi rnams dang chabs cig brag rgan zer ba'i ri rtsar ded/ der nyin kha shas la tshogs 'du byas rjes grwa ba phal cher phyir rang rang gi yul du mngags/ spyi chen cho shul/ spyi chung 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho/ bla ma bstan pa dge/dge skul rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sogs grwa ba bcu lhag logs su — 121 —
bkar nas bya ba mang bo zhig nag nyes su bgrang ste ther 'don dang ngo rgol byas rjes mdzod dge rdzong gi khrims khang du khrid/ zla dgu ba'i tshes nyi shu'i nang slar yang mkhan po kun bzang byams pa sogs grwa rgan kha shas mdzod dger khrid de btson du bcugzla bcu ba'i tshes bcu dgu'i mtshan mor bla grwa mang bo (76rgya ) zer ba'i khrims khang du bskyel te phyogs so sor bkram/snga phyir phyogs yas mas kyi khrims khang nas mkhan po byams pa kun bzang / spyi pa chen po cho shul/ sum mthil dge bshes chen mo phun tshogs yon tan/ shes rab gser nya/ hu ra bla ma/ a khu bstan pa dge/ blo bzang don 'grub/ blo rab/ bzod pa/a khu bla ma/ blo rgyal/ sangs rgyas sogs grwa rgan bcu lhag phyir rang yul du slebs ma thub par sku gshegs/rim gyis dgon pa'i 'du khang dang lha khang du bzhugs pa'i rten gtso mdzod dge'i bla ma tshul khrims rin chen gyis bzhengs shing sangs rgyas 'od srung gi 'phel gdung gzungs bzhugs na bzhugs pa'i ston pa'i sku byin can/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i blos bslang bdud rtsi rang 'beb can/ rje tshul khrims rin chen gyi 'bral spang ston pa/ rin gong gzhal du med pa'i byang chub mchod — 122 —
rten/ snar thang nas gdan drangs ba'i gser bris je tsong kha ba brgyad cu'i gyan thang nyi shu/ gser gyis bris pa'i dpag bsam 'khri shing gi thang ga sum cu/ seng tshang sku 'phreng gnyis pas gnang ba'i 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i gser sku/ bstan 'gyur/ sum phab byas pa'i 'phags pa brgyad stong ba gser dngul spel mas bris pa/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pas kyang bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor ba'i gser gyis bris ba'i rgyal ba'i yum chen mo/ lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i gsung 'bum/ paṇa chen sku 'phreng mang bos dgon 'di'i gdan rabs rim byon la bstsal ba'i bdag rkyen dang bka' tham/ bka' shog sogs sku gsung thugs rten bgrang gis mi longs pa dang gsung rab lha khang bcas gtor bshig mer sreg chu la bskur ba sogs byas te ming gi lhag ma med par bzos/ lha khang dang 'du khang grwa shag bcas su gling ba stod smad bar gsum dang mtha' ba sogs kyi kun hre bsdad de dgon pa'i rnam pa tsam yang med par gyur/ chu stag ( 196 2 ) lor phyogs thams cad du dgon pa nyams gso byed pa'i dod tsam byung yang 'dir grags 'gul med par lus/ spyi lo ( 1964 ) lo nas rigs gnas gsar brje chen po zhes pa'i lo bcu'i zing 'khrugs kyi me lce dmar — 123 —
bo smyos ba bzhin phyogs 'dir mched de rta mgrin lha khang ma gtogs ka ba drug cu lhag can gyi tshogs chen 'du khang dang byams khang sogs gcig kyang ma lus pa thal ba'i rdul du btang / grwa shag rnams su bzhugs pa'i dpe cha mang bo rlung la bskur zhing rgyu nom yod tshad gang 'dod du khyer/ de ltar mnar gcod dang sdug bsngal/ mu ge sogs bzod par dka' pa'i zhags thag nag pos yongs su bsdams te mi lo mang bor dbugs kyi gtong len dang mig gi lta stangs tsam la'ang nyams 'jog dang dogs zon byed bzhin ches nyam chung dang thabs sdug gi 'tsho ba skyel dgos byung ngo/ /rgyal bstan ti si'i lto ba las babs sna tshogs grub mtha'i shang shang chu bo dal gyis rgyu/ / rkang bzhi phyugs dang lo legs snye mas 'phel kha 'gran tshe rong 'brog dga' ba'i 'dzum dkar grol/ /gangs can sā la'i sman ljongs yangs por rkang gnyis su yin 'tshe med zhi bde'i 'tsho ba skyid/ /
rang mtshan thub pa'i glung chung len skabs bzlog tu med pa'i glo bur dus 'gyur sa chen g.yos/ /mtshan gyi snyan pa yod dgu tshang ba'i 〈rig gsar 〉 srid mo sha zan cakhutraṭa ༷phreng 'dzin 'bum gyi khrag dron mchod cing don lnga snod drug tshogs 'khor bshams/ /rus pa'i gdan dkar gcal du bkram ste rkang gling dmar bo'i dbyangs rta 'gran/ /kha sems nag kyang bsgyur bcos bzang zhes smyon pa'i gar stabs lang long g.yo/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa sngo bsangs nam mkha'i mdangs/ / gzhan du bsgyur ba nam yang yod min te/ /rnog phyogs shar rlung btsan po'i 'du 'god kyis/ /sgrib dang bral ba'i snang ba cir yang 'char/ /rin bral rin chen gter mdzod me la bsregs/ /gsung rab gsung 'bum gang yin rlung la spur/ /'du khang lha khang dang bcas sa la brdabs/ /gser sku dngul sku mang bo chu la 'phangs /
byams ldan bla ma mun pa'i btson la bcug/mkhyen ldan mkhas dbang skyag lud bran du bkol/ /dpyod ldan dpon po mthon po'i g.yang la btags/ /brtse ldan pha ma 'dur rgyugs g.yog la khrid/ /rang rigs gshed du babs pa rang mi 'gas/ /chu sna gar khrid rang gshis ston bzhin du/ /pha rgan bsad pa'i dmar nag khrag gi gos/ /'du tshogs khrom pa'i dbus su ngom so byas/ /yod na phyug bdag ming gis ngo rgol dmar/ /med na 〈ta krer 〉 slob zer dgag khrid btsan/ /bcu phrag rig gzhung rnga bcad rngog lo byas/ /ri chu lab rtse sogs la zhwa nag g.yog/'chi bdag yin zhes rwa can ma byung la/ /'dre gdon yin zhes mche ba ma gtsigs kyang / /dga' rab byin rlabs zab pa'i dpung tshogs 'dis/ /yangs ba'i rgyal khams chen mo bar med dkrugs/lo stong bsags pa'i khyad 'phags rin chen nor/ /lo bcu'i zing 'khrugs dmar bos khyur mid btang / /— 126 —
lo rgyus bsub tu med pa'i rdo ring 'di/ /lo na rgan gzhon su yin thugs la zungs/ /rig gsar tsher ma'i 'jig rten gyi/ /rnam pa kho bos ma mthong yang / /sdug myong rgan po'i zhal sgo na/ /cha tsam ma nyams gsal ler gnas/ /zhes ri bong dgon bkra shis byang chub chos 'phel gling gi gdan rabs bshad sgrub bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan las dus 'gyur chen po'i skabs nyams rgud byung tshul gyi sarga ste drug pa'o/ /bzhi ba/ / nyams pa slar sog te dar rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa'i da lta'i rnam pa/nyams pa slar gsos te dar rgyas su 'gro bzhin ba da lta'i rnam pa brjod pa la/ chos sgo phyes te gsar 'tshogs dang rten bzhings mdzad tshul/ phyogs so so nas skyes chen dam pa gdan drangs te 'chad spel gnang ba/ 'don 'grig kun spyod kyi rim pa/sku gsung thugs rten ji tsam bzhugs pa'i dkar chag 'god pa ste bzhi'o/ /( 1 ) chos sgo phyes te gsar 'tshogs dang rten bzhengs — 127 —
mdzad tshul/bzod med dus 'gyur gyi mun pa nag pos bar med du g.yog ste yun ring phyin mthar/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags sprel (198 0 ) lo nas rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i dpung tshogs rtsa ba nas pham ste tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum par gtan la phabs pa'i srid jus bzang bo mes rgyal gyi khyon yongs la spros pa dang chabs cigrgyal bstan yang dar gyi skal bzang mngon par shar bas dgon sde so sor chos sgo phye 'go brtsams/lo der ri bong dgon la'ang rdzong dang zhang srid gzhung gis chos sgo phyes te slar 'tshogs rgyu'i chog mchan thob pas tshe srog gsar du rnyed pa lta bu'i dga' ba dang bcas te gling ba smad ma'i mnyam las khang gi nang du 'tshogs/ a khu blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis dbu mdzad byas te gnas brtan bcu drug gi phyag mchod gsungs (sngon gyi grwa ba bcu dgu ma gtogs lhag med ) spyi lo ( 198 1 ) lo'i hod zla dang bor sngon gyi rta mgrin lha khang ( lha khang 'di mtha' ba yul tshos mdzod khang lta bu byas nas bzhag pa'i drin gyis gtor bshig chen mo ma thebs par lhag yod ) du sku gsung thugs rten ci 'byor bzhugs su gsol te — 128 —’
cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo la gsar du 'tshogs/ lo de nas yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong dang dbyar gnas/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang 'jigs byed/bde mchog dril bu lha lnga gsum gyi sgrub mchod/ kun rig cho ga thugs rje chen po'i cho ga nyin gsum/ bskang gso sogs la 'tshogs thub byung / gzhan yang lo de'i ston khar yul skyong la sgo'i nye 'dabs kyi thang chen du kun gzigs bcu ba chen mo 7paṇa chen er ti ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo mchog gdan drangs te ri bong dgon 'dus spyi nas gsol ba btabs pa bzhin/ rje blo bzang sbyin pa dgon 'di'i mkhan khri la bskos/ sngon gyi thang ka dang rten rnying sogs la rab gnas mdzad/ rnam sras/ 'dzam dkar phongs sel ma gsum gyi gter bum bsgrubs/ kun gzigs mchog gi sku dpar sogs rten skal mang du bstsal zhing chos srid lugs gnyis kyi cha nas bslab ston rgya che ba mdzad/ spyi lo (198 5 ) lor dus 'khor sgrub mchod slar gso dang kun rig bdag 'jug gsar du tshugs/ rje rin po che'i 〈 rtogs brjod 'dun legs ma 〉las/66rgyud sde gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud rnams kyi/ /— 129 —
gtso bor gyur ba rnam snang mngon byang gi/rgyud la sbyangs pas spyod pa'i rgyud kyi phyogs/ /gang yin de yang legs par nges par byas/ / ji zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyud sde bzhi'i nang tshan spyod pa'i rgyud kyi gtso bor gyur ba rnam snang mngon byang gi sgrub mchod dze dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi thugs bzhed ltar gsar du btsugs/ de'i phyi lor sngar 'don bzhin pa'i bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i sgrub mchod de dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lū u ba'i lugs kyi sgrub mchod du bsgyur/ spyi lo (192 4 ) lo nas gling ba dgon grong drug gi gros kha gcig mthun ngang tshogs chen 'du khang gsar bzhengs byed rgyu byas/ stag tsha a lags rje skal bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshang gis sgor 70 0 0khri chen lnga ba chen po rje blo bzang rnam rgyal lung rigs seng ge mchog gis sgor 140 0 0khyashul sprul skus sgor 1 0 0 0shing bza' skal bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan tshang gis sgor 40 0 0gzhan gling ba dgon grong drug gis rgyu 'byor ci yod phul te/ dgon pa'i a khu bzod pa dang brtson 'grus a khu dgon pa gsum dang gling ba stod smad bar gsum rnga ba khul dmag yan lag phyugs gnyer 'brog ra ( gling ba mo khrung zer )mtha' ba bcas dgon grong gi mi sna — 130 —
sum cu tsam la 'du khang gsar bzhings kyi khur sprad/ kho tshos kyang nyin mtshan dbyer med du ka ba ring thung 12 0can gyi 'du khang gsar bzhengs kyi las 'go dngos su brtsams/ spyi lo ( 198 5 )lor dgon grong gi mi sna a khu bzod pa/ ri 'bring / skal bzang bzod pa/ byang rig kho bcas pe cin du kun gzigs rin po cher lo skal 'bul du ( khong sku ma gshegs kyi par gling ba dgon grong gis bskyal ) song skabs/ a khu bzod pas/ 'du khang gsar bzhengs byed gyin yod pas legs 'grub yong bar skyabs 'jug zhus/ khong gis khyed cag gi dgon pa'i nub phyogs kyi brgya rtsa'i ngos su sbyin bsreg mang bo phul dang 'du khang legs 'grub yong gsungs/ phyir yong ste rim gro myur du bsgrubs/ lo 'khor gsum tsam gyi ring la 'du khang gsar bzhengs kyi las 'dzin pa rnams kyis gtsos dgon grong gnyis kyis 'bad brtsod byas pa la brten/ sgor khri phrag bzhi bcu lhag song ba'i tshogs chen 'du khang rtsig pa rdo las byas shing bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi rgyud smad grwa tshang gi 'du khang dang tshad gzhi mthun pa bzo bkod tshon tsi dang bcas pa cha thams cad nas phun sum tshogs pa zhig (1986 ) lor 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi rten du grub/ bsod nams dpal gyis — 131 —
mtho pa'i phyogs ris med kyi sbyin bdag mang bos sku gsung thugs rten mchod rdzas yo byad sogs bgrang gis mi langs pa gsar bzhengs dang bzhag 'jog byas pas 'chi med lha yi grong khyer sa la 'phros pa ltar gyur ba na rnam 'dren zas gtsang gi sras bo lha las babs pa'i dus chen khyad par can te smin drug zla ba'i dmar phyogs bzang bo gnyis par tshogs chen 'du khang legs grub kyi dga' ston rgya cher bstar zhing nyin de'i sbyin bdag a khu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos byas/ phyogs so so'i dgon pa dang lha sde rnams kyi 'du khang legs 'grub la sku gsung thugs rten sogs legs skyes sna gatshogs phul/ khyad par du gling ba stod smad par gsum gyi dpon po paṇa chen skyabs dang mkhan pa thar nam kho gsum gyis dga' ston la ci 'byor gyi 'bul ba btegs bas/ ri bong dgon gyis kho tshor ston pa'i gser sku byon legs ma re rten skal du gnang /gzhan yang spyi lo ( 198 4 ) lor gling ba smad mas sbyin bdag byas te ka ba nyi shu lhag can gyi rje'i lha khang gsar du bzhengs pa dang / spyi lo ( 19〈lde ) lor smad ma'i mgo log zla bas sgor khri gnyis lhag gis byang chub mchod rten chen mo bzhengs/ spyi lo (1929 ) lor a khu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos sbyin bdag byas te — 137 —
sgor khri gnyis lhag gis 'jam dbyangs kun sazigs kyi lha khang rten dang brten pa bcas lebs par bzhengs / spyi lo ( 1992 )lor rgya paṇa chen skyabs kyis sbyin bdag byas te sgo ra khri bzhi la nye pas thugs rje chen po'i lha khang bzhengs/ spyi lo 4 ( 1996 ) lor dgon pa'i spyi zur grags pa rgya mtshos sgor khri bcu lhas gis 'bas brtan seng gdong lha khang rten dang brten pa bcas pa bzhengs/khams bkra shis don 'grub sogs khyim/ tshang 'gus sgor khri lnga la nye pas bzo bkod legaso shing lta na sdus pa'i /'khor phreng brgya lhag dang / bar ma'i tshe dpag skyabs tshang gis sgor khri ba'i tsam gyis bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi 'bor chen dang mtshan nyid ma thun zhing 4sung rab da pa4ra khang gi gzungs sngags cha tshang bzhugs pa'i thugs rje chen po'i 'khor chen sogs bzhengs/ gzhan ru sde da nga khyim sger gyis 'khor khang gsar bskrun dang rten bzhengs sogs mtha' yas kyang so sor 'bri khom ma byung la rten rnams 'og gi dkar chag skabs su gsal / sngon dgon 'dir cho 'phrul smon lam gyi tshes bcu gsum nyin gos sku bshams srol med pas/ rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan tshang gos thugs brtson dang bsku la ma yang yang gnang pas smad ma'i a bu ru skor gyis sgor khri bsu ma la nye bas — 133 —
gos sku chen mo gtso thang rgyal ba byams pa mchog lha bla ma tshul khrims rin chen/ kun gzigs rin po che/ rje rin po che/ skyes bu gsum gyi srung ma bcas gsar bzhengs byas pas spyi lo ( 1922 )lor cho 'phrul smon lam gyi tshes bcu gsum nyin gos sku bshams mjal gyi srol legs par tshugs/spyi lo (1989 ) lo'i zla bzhi ba'i nang mkhan chen blo bzang spyin pa mchog gi gsung bkod ltar grwa ba sum cu lhag bzhag sdom khang sar dgon du phebs te zla gsum lhag gi ring la gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i rtse sngags pa grwa tshang gi phyag bzhes ltar gyi 'cham cha tshang bar bslabs/ spyi lo ( 1990 ) lo'i cho 'phrul smon lam gyi tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin 'cham dngos su tshugs pas dge ltas mang du byung zhing mjal ba'i 'du tshogs kyang sngar yul 'dir byung ma myong ba lta bu rgyas/ ( gung thang drug pa chen mo 7rje btsun bstan pa'i dpang phyug mchog yul 'dir phebs skabs kyi gsung bshad cig tu/ 66 'cham tshugs pa shin tu legs/ sngon ri bong dgon ma tshugs pa'i sngon du'ang yul 'dir 'cham zhig cung tshugs pa'i lo rgyus yod/ 'cham zer ba 'di sngon paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi dag pa'i gzigs snang du chos skyong rnams kyis zhal gzigs shing gar 'khrab pa'i rnam pa dngos bu slob rnams la phyag khrid gnang — 134 —
ba zhig red sogs gsungs/ ṇ+ḍa ltar char rjes kyi myu gu bzhin du dgon 'dir phyogs thams cad nas 'phel rgyas byung ste 'grig lam kun spyod dang tshogs 'don sogs sngar srol bzang po rgyun skyong dang /bstan 'gror gcig tu sman zhing mkho gal che ba'i sngar med mang bo gsar btod/ lha khang dang 'du khang mang po gsar bzhengs dang rgya bskyed bla na med pa byas so/ /'od dkar gzhon nu gza' yis zin na yang / /yun ring mi 'gor grol ba chos nyid bzhin/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams chu gter ma skam pas/ /rgyal bstan pad ma'i 'dzum dkar cis mi grol/ /dad ldan 'gro ba'i longs spyod gter kha dang / /sna tshogs bzo ba'i 'phrul 'khor lhan 'dzoms pas/ /dge legs bye bas rab gtams rten brten pa'i/ /gzi byin dbyig 'dzin sgeg mo'i lto bar chags/ /sngon byon dam pa'i phyag rgyun chu bo bzhi'i/ /rang mdangs ma nyams gling 'di'i mtsho mor 'beb/ /'ga' re sngar las lhag par gong 'phel bas / mkhas grub mang bos bsngags brjod me tog thor/ /— 135 —
dus 'gyur chen po'i rlung nag 'tshub ma'i khrod/ /lus sems dal ba med par ngal ngal bas/1 /da lta chos sgra snyan mo'i dbyangs rta dang / /lhan cis bag phebs sim pa'i bde ba myong / /snazhes pa'ang spro dga'i rlung shusas gyen du rgyu ba'i rang sgra'o/ /( 2 )phyogs so so nas skyes chen du ma gdan drangs te 'chad spel gnang tshul/ri bong dbon gresar du tshusas te mang tshobs bcos bsgyur byas pa'i bar du gung thang sku 'phreng rim byon sogs skyes chen dam pa du mas dgon 'dir zhabs kyi pad mo bkod de dam pa'i chos kyi gru char spros tshul dus yun gyis bskal bas ma nges kyang / 'dir bstan pa yang dar gyi skabs phyogs so so nas skyes chen du ma gdan drangs te 'chad spel gnang tshul tho tsam 'god r+b+ya la/rab byung drug pa'i lcags mo bya ( 192 1 ) lo'i ston khar kun gzigs bcu ba chen mo 7paṇa chen ir ti ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo mchog la sgo'i nye 'dabs su gdan gadrangs skabs gling ba dgon grong gi zhus ngor skyabs 'gro/ dmigs brtse ma/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ tshe lha rnam gsum/ ma ṇi/— 136 —
byang sham bha lar skye ba'i smon lam sogs kyi lung gnang / rgyal lab kyi rtsa khrims brtsi srung dang / mi rigs mthun sgril/ཿ pha mar bkur sti sogs byed dgos pa'i bka' slo ba mang du bstsal/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me sprul (1989 ) lo'i ston khar gung thang drug pa chen mo 7rje btsun bstan pa'i dbang phyug dpal bzang bo mchog dgon 'dir sadan drangs te nyin la cas la bzhugs/jingage 'dun 'dus pa'i tshosas dbur phebs te thugs smon gnang /thugs rje chen po'i dbang dang /ji gdugs/ ngakar byad grol gyi dbang / 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi rjes sanang bcas kyi bka' drin bstsal/ dgon grong gnyis ka la thusas brtse bas bka' slob r+ya nga du bstsa 'a ge ba las zur gcig sgra thas (52 cha )tu gsal ba 'di lta ra/ ru sa cha 'di mgon po 'od dpa ga med kyi gdul bya'i zhing khams dngos yin/tsa sngon mdzod dge gling ba 'dzi ha cang dar myo nga / rnam thar sogs su gsal ba ltar na dud khyim stong gcig dang lnga brgya tsam yod tshod red/ de dus kyi dpon po rnams kyis kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo dang gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me sogs yul 'dir gredan drangs te chos 'brel zab/kun mkhyen yab sras kyi slob ma/ gling pa'i dpon tshang gi rgyud du — 137 —
'khrungs pa'i bla brang dge bshes tshul khrims rin chen tshang gis ri bong dgon gsar du btabs rjes bla brang nas dge rgan mngags te skyong khur sanang ba dang dgon pa'i ming yang kun mkhyen mchog gis bstsal ba'i lo rgyus yo da/ mdzod dge nyin ma dang byams me bum skor sogs gling ba nas chad pa sha ltas red/ da skabs ru sde sogs sngon ltar mi rgyas kyang skyabs mgon snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs bskyed smon 'a ma gyis dgon grong gnyis ka 'phel rgyas dga' rab byung 'dug deng sang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi srid jus bzang zhing rig gnas gisar rje zer ba'i sanya' gnon med pas rgyu nor phran tshegs re yod dus/ khyed gsar bu rnams kyis mgo 'phang gronam du btegs te rang snang gang dran ma cod/ khyed tsho su yin yang phan tshum 'gris mthun ngang / kha sems jalar pos bya ba sgrubs dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos dang rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims la mthun pas rang gi tshe 'di phyi'i don yang des ('grub pa yin/ nged gung thang tshang la mtshon na/ sku gong ma gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me/ rje dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs sku 'phreng rim byon sa 'dir phebs shing chos gsungs bas mi rabs sngon nas chos 'brel zab mo yod/ bdag kyang mdzod dge gling bar thengs — 138 —
gsum la yong myong / bar skabs dus dbang gis mi lo bzhi bcu sbyatsam la ma thon/ da skabs lo mthon por son kyang sngon kyi chos 'brel dang khyed tsho'i re ba ltar 'grim 'grul mi bde zhing lam thag ring po la ma 'dzem par yong ba yin/ des na nga'i sha tsha ba'i sems gtam ni/ dgon pa grwa tshang yin na thugs mthun khrims gtsang gi ngos nas lam bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len dang / thos bsam sgom gsum la brtson pa/ sngar srol bzang po mi nyams pa bcas byed rgyu shin tu nas kyang gal che/ deng sang chos lugs dad pa rang mos yin kyang / dgon pa'i nang du zhugs phyin dgon pa'i 'grig khrims gang yod la brtsi bkur nan mo byed dgos/ khyed 'jig rten grong ba tshos nam yin yang nang 'khrugs dang sa rtsod chu rtsod ma byed par phu nu 'grig mthun dang dkon mchog gsum la dad pa brtan po byos dang / yul 'dir sngon nas da bar du tshe 'das ci yod dang / khyed cag tshang ma/ phyi ma na ngan song med/ bar do na 'jigs skrag med/ thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang myur du 'thob pa'i smon lam 'a debs lnga zhes sogs kyi bka' slob mtha' yas pa bstsal/spyi myo ( 1988 )lo'i ston khar lnga rig smra ba'i paṇa chen shing — 139 —
bza' bskal bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog dgon 'di'i dbang d+ku ra bla mar gdan drangs/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang snga bon dang bcas r+yaṃ / gsang 'dus/ bde r+ya chog lū u ba/ thusas rje chen po/ kun rig mi /'khrugs pa rnams kyi dbang / rigs 4su ma/ spyi sgru ba/ mgon po/ chos rgya la/( lha mo/ rta mgrin gros nga sgrub rnam sa kyi rjes gamang / 'jam dpal na tsham brjod/ cha gsu ra gyi 'u nga / skyabs 'gro'i khrid sogs n+thi 5 rgyas su bstsa la/bla brang bkra r+shas 'khyi la gyi rgyud smang bla zur rdo rams pa lha rmo 'i blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dbon 'di'i bca' ri ga 〈dngul dkar me long 〉 (༄ zur rgyan zhis zhus par zur rgyan 〈 rnga yab dkar ko 〉 zhes ngu ljags rtsom gnang bas/ rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan tshang dase skul la bzhusas ska bas thog mar tshogs dbus su sasungs/ spyi lo ( 199 2 ) lo'i zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin slar ya nga shing bzang rim ngo ches yul 'dir 'bas kyi pad mo bkod/ tshes bco lnga 'i nyin 'jigs byed ngapa' po gcig pa'i dbang gi sta gon/ ci bcu drug nyin dpa/'a po gcig pa'i dbang ( khri chen sku 'phreng gnyis pa'i gsung gi ma ṇi ri' sgrub wawa— 1ge /: wawa
dang / skyabs 'gro/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ yo na tan gzhi gyur ma/ rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs / bla mchod bcas kyi lung gnang / tshes bcu bdun nyin rnam lcang mngon byang gi dbang /1ltung bshags/ skabs gsu ma pa mdzad bcu/ rten ('brel bstod pa/ jo'i bstod/ rtogs brjod 'dun lesas r+ya / rnam dag gangs ri ma/ dpal ldan sa gsum ma/ /lam rim bsdus don/ bzang spyod/ byams smo na rnam sa kyi lung gnang / tshes bco brgyad nyin/ sman bla'i dbang / theg chen saso sbyong /spyod 'jus tho ga mtha'atsho ma / bde smon/ byams pa'i sku gzugs ma/ bar do'i 'phrang sgrol / lam/ sngags smon lam ༈bstod pa don ldan ma/ nyi gzhon /'char ka r+ya /— rje'i gas nga rnam//sman thung mdo/ gdugs brkyar/ seng gdong ma'i zlog bsgyur sogs kyi lung bstsa la/ tshes bcu dgu'i nyin/ rigs sna gsum spyi sgrub /: chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum rnam sras bcas kyi rjes gnang / bag rtse dang gnas chung rgyal bo sku lnga'i srog gtad /tshes nyi shu'i nyin/ 'jam dbyangs dkar bo/ sgron dkar/ klu dbang rgyal bo/ med gdong ma bcas kyi rjes gnang dang sgrol ma'i lung / tshe dbang bcas gnang ngo/ /wawa 141 wawa
tshigs su bcad pas spo sa skor byas rjes sanam lo grogar tshes kyi dga' ston la rol / kum gzisas/ rin po che'i satsos bsta na 'oridzin skyes bu rnams kyi 'bas brtan du lo gcig 'a grwa ba re res 'jigs byed bsnyen pa sogs ci gsungs kyi grangs ka 'bul ༈tshes sanyis nyin banas chung rgyal bo sku lnga'i lha tshes rgyas pa gsu ngas/ tshes bdun gyi phyi dror cho 'phrul smon lam chen mor yar 'tshosas byadzos te phyas len thams cad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ltar/nga ra 'tshogs nyim skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas pa dang / skabs gsum pa chos skyong rnams kyi gtor 'a bu'/ rgyas pa bcas gsungs te grol/: tshes brgyad nas smon lam dngos ga'i 'a/ 'tshosas shing nyin tham sa cad du/ zhogs 'tshogs 'a skyabs 'gro semase bskyed rgyas pa dang dzam dkar chu rgyun/ lam rim gsol 'debs// yon tan gre'ir gyur ma/ 'jibs byed lha bcu gsum/ ma dang gser zhun ma/ 'jigs byed lho sgo bcas gsungs/ de nas 'jam dpa' mtshan brjod kyi 86 chos kyi rgya' ma tshan legs nga ra 'dzus/sa 99zhes pa'i bar sasungs te grol/ gung tshigs la gnas bcu dang gtor 'bul rgyas pa/ — de nas mtshan brjod kyi 88 'gro na gdugs gcig yangs ba ste thes pa nas gsungs pa dang /—— 148 wawa
༷dpal ldan sa gsum ma bar rta/ gtor 'bul mdor bsdus bar rta byas te grol/ de nas dung brda gsum dang bcas smon lam dngos gzhi la 'tshogs/ dmigs brtse ma'i bar rta dang /legs bris ma/ skabs gsum pa/ byams ba'i smon lam dang thog mtha' ba gnyis res mos/ ('di'i nang dbu mdzad kyis bla mar mjal kha zhu) bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung gi mchod phreng ste/ ngo mtshar ba'i mchod pa bco brgyad/ mchod pa nyer gcig pa dang nyer lnga ba/ yo byad kyi mchod pa bcu/ dbu rgyan/ dar dpyangs/ chos gos rnam gsum/ drang srong gi snod/ gdugs rgyal mtshan/ rnga bo che/ dung g.yas 'khyil/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon lnga / bkra shis rtags brgyad 'bul ba sogs 〈 dge legs gter mdzod 〉ji lta ba dang / mjug tu bla mas(mkhan po phebs na bsngo ba sogs mkhan pos gsungs dgos) bsngo ba dang / bstan 'bar ma/ bde smon gsungs pa sogs grwa sa chen po'i phyag bzhes ma nyams pa dang / dgong 'tshogs la drug cu ba bsngos te grol ba yin no/ / tshes bcu gsum nyin gos sku chen mo/tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin rtse sngags pa grwa tshang gi phyag len ltar 'cham chen / tshes bcu drug nyin byamag pa gling skor chen mo/ ( rje — 149 —
btsun byams pa mgon po'i snang brnyan khyogs la bzhugs su gsol te gling skor byed pa ni rje btsun byams mgon gling 'dir myur du byon te chos kyi 'khong lo bskor ba dang 'khor kyi thog mar 'gyur ba sogs rten 'brel gyi gnad chen po yod pa sngon byon dam pa rnams kyis mang du gsungs) tshes bcu bdun nyin smon lam chen mo'i lhag mchod/ hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad nas ras pris la brten te dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub mchod nyin bdun sbyin sreg dang bcas/ bco lnga'i nyin rnga chings/hor zla gsum pa'i tshes lnga nas dus 'khor dbyangs chags nyin brgyad la byed/ tshes bcu gsum nyin gtor ma bca' bzo dang bsham bkod/ tshes bcu bzhi'i phyi dror yar 'tshogs dang /bco lnga nas thig dkyil la brten te dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub mchod nyin bdun dang / nyer gnyis nyin sbyin sreg dang tshogs bsngo/ nyer gsum nyin lhag mchod du 'tshogs te bla ma mchod pa gsungs/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes gcig nas bcu drug bar thugs rje chen po'i smyung chen sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bar bzhugs/tshes bcu bdun nyin thugs rje chen po'i cho ga'i sgo nas sbyin sreg byed/ hor zla lnga ba'i tshes gcig nyin rgyab ri'i rtser lha chen dga' ba rab snang gi lab rtse bstod du phebs te 'dzam gling spyi bsang — 150 —
sogs gsungs/ mjug tu ne'u ser gyi gtor chog 'don/(ne'u ser gyi gtor chog 'don pa dgon mgo gtsang bkra shis lhun po yin pas red zer) de nas nyin kha shas la shing slong byed/ tshes bcu gcig nas nyin bdun la ma ṇi ril sgrub tu 'tshogs/ mjug tu grwa tshang gis spos sne drangs shing rol mo sna tshogs kyi mchod pa thogs te ma ṇi ril sgrub kyi bum pa gdan drangs nas tshogs chen 'du khang la —chos skor byed/ lnga ba'i bcu dgur rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi gdung mchod/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes gcig nas grwa ba rnams rang rang gi pha yul du phebs te nyin bdun gyi ring grong ba rnams la ma ṇi ril sgrub kyi dbu 'dzin byed/ tshes bco lnga'i nyin dbyar khas len gyi sbyor ba byas te phyi dor sku rim la 'tshogs/( dbyar gnas kyi ring k+ṣ+ṇā nyin rer maṇ+ḍal bzhi ba ma chags pa byed/)tshes bcu drug gi zhogs pa snga mor dbyar khas len dngos su byed/nyin de nas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lū u ba'i bdag 'jug nyin bdun la 'tshogs/ rjes su sbyin sreg dang rnga chings kyang yod/tshes nyer bzhi nas nyin lnga la rim bzhin mgon po/ chos rgyal/lha mo/ rnam sras/ bag rtse rnams kyi bskang gso gsungs te nyin rer bskang bshags stong re 'gro bar byed/— 151 —
tshes nyer dgu'i nyin chos skyong spyi'i skang gso rgyas pa dang mjug tu bskul ba/ kha 'bar ma bcas gsungs/ bdun pa'i tshes gcig nas mchod pa nyin gsum/ tshes bzhi nas seng sang smyung gnas pa'i gdung mchod/ lnga'i nyin gnas brtan bcu drug gi phyag mchod rgyas pa/ bdun brgyad gnyis la bka' 'gyur zhabs brtan/ tshes bcu gcig nas nyin lnga la rnam rgyal ma'i khri mchod/ bcu drug nyin mi 'khrugs pa'i stong mchod/ nyi shu dgu'i nyin dbyar gnas dgag dbye dang ljongs rgyu bcas byed do/ /hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig gnyis la dbyar ston byed/ tshes gsum nas nyin bdun la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa'i sgrub mchod rab gnas chen mo dang sbrags te gsungs pa dang mjug tu zhi rgyas gnyis kyi sbyin sreg 'don/ tshes bcu la rnga chings su 'tshogs/ hor zla dgu ba'i tshes bco lnga nas nyin drug la kun rig dbyangs chags/ tshes nyer gnyis kyi snga dror bkra shis gso sbyong dang nyin de nas kun rig sgrub mchod chen mor 'tshogs shing nyer brgyad nyin sbyin sreg gsungs/ lha babs dus chen gyi nyin bla ma gzhung las pa dang dbu mdzad chen mo gnyis gsar du khri la bzhugs/ hor zla bcu ba'i tshes nyer gcig nas rnam snang mngon — 152 —
byang gi sgrub mchod la 'tshogs/ nyer snga'i nyin dge skul gsar ba khri la bzhugs/ de'i dgong mor 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gdung mchod du mtshan 'tshogs byas te chos spyod sna tshogs gsungs/tshes nyer brgyad nyin kha skong sbyin sreg byed/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bdun nas mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub rimachod sbyin sreg dang bcas pa nyin brgyad la 'tshogs tshes nyer lngar 'cham pa grwa tshang dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mtshams la bzhugs/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bzhir kha skong sbyin sreg gsungs/ tshes lnga nas 'cham pa grwa tshang gi 'cham gshar sbyang byas te tshes bcu gcig la 'cham rgyugs sprod/ tshes nyer gcig par kun gzigs snang ba mtha' yas7paṇa chen er ti ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo'i gdung mchod/ nyer gnyis nyin 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma dang gser zhun ma gsungs te mjug tu nyer bsdu dang phyi dror dgu gtor gyi gtor ma bca' bzo byed/ tshes nyer gsum nas gtor sgrub chen mor 'tshogs/ nyer lnga'i nyin rje btsun bla ma tshul khrims rin chen gyi gdung mchod/ nyin 'di nas tshes nyer dgu'i bar tshogs 'cham byed/ nyi shu dgu'i nyin gtor rgyag dang dgu gtor gyi 'cham grub nas lo mjug rdzogs/ lo gcig gi nang du cho — 153 —
ga chen mo bdun gyi sgrub mchod gsungs pa'i dgon sde da lta mdo dbus gtsang gsum du ches dkon par mthong / rgyun gyi zhogs 'tshogs la 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa dang gser zhun ma /lho sgo sogs gsungs/ de yang dpa' cig rgyun du tshogs 'don mdzad pa ni dgos pa chen po yod de/ spyir dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi mtshan brjod pa las/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan lan gcig brjod pa phan yon che ba dang 'tshang rgya ba thams cad 'jam dbyangs la brten dgos par gsungs pas 'jam mgon rgyal ba chen pos kyang / 86nged kyi rgyud pa 'di la bla ma yang 'jam dbyangs/ yi dam yang 'jam dbyangs/ chos skyong yang 'jam dbyangs la brten pa zhig nges can du gal che nya / zhes dang 〈 'jigs byed chos 'byung khams gsum rnam rgyal 〉las/88 ri bo dge lugs pa'i btsun chung zhig yan chad kyis kyang rdo rje 'jigs byed rnal 'byor du byed nya/ ces sogs gsungs pa'ang don 'di lta bu la dgongs par mngon no/ / zla re'i nyi shu dgu gang yin la skang gso dang / tshes gnyis rnams su gnas chung lha tshes/ yar ngo mar ngo'i dus 'brel gso sbyong / chos thog gang yod la mtshan skyor/ rgyun du mgon khang bas bskang gso 'don pa/— 154 —
chos thog gang yin yang yar 'tshogs skabs su rgan pa rnams kyis 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po dang / gzhon pa rnams kyis 'jam dpal mtshan brjod skyor sbyong byed pa sogs dam pa gong ma'i phyag bzhes gang tshugs thams cad ma nyams par byed cing chos mtshams su zla phyed zla phyed nas gsar bu rnams la tshogs 'don ci yod kyi blo rgyugs len pa/ khom skabs gang yod la sa lam dang bskyed rdzogs/lam rim/ sngags rim sogs la dpe gzigs dang / tha snyad rig gnas kyi dpe khrid sogs la'ang rgyun du brtson no/ /gangs ri'i mu tig bkram pa'i zhing khams su/ /dgon sde che phra bgrang gis mi longs kyang / /gsang sngags dkyil 'khor bdun gyi sgrub mchod la/ /nyin mtshan dus drug brtson mkhan sde 'di tsam/ /dus gsum ye shes sems dpa' sum brtsegs sogs/ /pha rgyud gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos can/ /'jigs mdzad dpa' bo gcig pa'i rgyun 'dzin pa/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i zhal gdams dron po dngos/ /'dzam gling mdzes byed rgyun drug mchog gnyis zhes/ /kun gyi smra byed khri la rtag gnas kyang / /— 155 —
don dam bka' drin tshor ba'i dan rtags su/ /'di na mchod 'bul stong gi srol bzang gnas/ /kho bos 'di ltar bsngags pa ma brjod kyang / /blo gros gzu bor gnas pa gang yin gyis/ /chos sde 'di yi thun min ngo mtshar la/ /bstod tshig me tog mi 'thor ga la srid/ /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /( 4 ) sku gsungs thugs kyi dkar chag—sku gsung thugs rten ci tsam bzhugs pa'i dkar chag 'du khang chen mo ka ba ring thung gnyis ka 1 2 0phyi'i brtsig pa rdo kho na las grub pa/bkod pa mdzes shing lta na sdug pa/ steng du gser zangs las grub pa'i gser tog dang rgyal mtshan/ ri dwags pho mo/chos 'khor/ spen rgyan sogs kyi gzi 'od 'phro zhing nang rten du sku gsung thugs rten mchod rdzas yo byad sogs skye dgu'i dang ba 'dren zhing thar ba'i sa bon 'jog pa bgrang gis mi longs ba bzhugs pa las/ 'dir che long tsam zhig 'god pa la/ dri gtsang khang ngam byams khang du/ gtso bo jo bo shākya mi ne'i sku brnyan chen mo/— 156 —
g.yas su rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha/ mnyam med thub pa chen po/ rgyal ba seng ge nga ro sogs sman sku mang bo/ tsan dan las grub pa'i byams sku/ jo sku li ma khri gang can/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i sman sku tshig stong dang /'thag grub kyi ston pa'i sku thang brgyad brgya sogs mtha' yas pa bzhugs/ mgon khang nang du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum/ mgon po phyag drug pa/ rnam sras/ chos rgyal phyi sgrublha mo/ bag rtse/k+ṣitwa pa la sogs kyi sku brnyan sman 'jim las bzhengs pa/'du khang chen mo'i nang du rje rin po che'i sman sku/ rje tshul khrims rin chen gyi sku brnyan sman 'jim las grub pa/ gzhan rdo rje sems dpa' / ston pa gtso 'khor gsum pa gnas brtan bcu drug paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba chen mo/ sman bla bde bshegs brgyad/ ltung bshags so lnga sogs kyi sku brnyan sman 'jim las grub shing bzo bkod khyad du 'phags pa/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i bzhugs khri'i rgyab ngos su rje'i gzigs pa lnga ldan gyi bris thang /'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa/ — dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi — 157 —
skyod rdo je lha so gnyis/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma/ ku na rig lha so bdun/ thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong / bde mchog lū i ba lha drug cu rtsa gnyis/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor/ rnam snang mngon byang lha grangs gya gcig sgrol ma g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu/'phags pa gdugs dkar mo'i lha tshogs/ mgon po phyag drug pa/chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum sogs kyi gyang thang mang bo rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i zhing bkod/ sgo 'phyor du rgyal bo chen po bzhi dang / rigs ldan drag po'i zhing bkod bden bzhi'i blang dor gyi 'jug ldog mtshon byed srid pa'i 'khor lo/ rgya mthongs su skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing / 'thag grub kyi ston pa'i sku chig stong / rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi zhal thang tshem grum sogs brjod kyis mi longs pa bzhugs so/ / dri gtsang phugs kyi thog gnyis par rnam sras lha khang du rgyal bo chen po rnam sras rta bdag brgyad kyi sku brnyan sman 'jim las bzhengs pa/ rgya mthongs g.yas su khri chen gung thang drug pa chen mo'i gzim khang bkra shis 'od 'bar dang g.yon du seng sang smyung gnas pa chen mo'i gzim khang 'dod dgu 'khyil ba/ nang du ston pa gtso 'khor gsum pa — 158 —
dang gnas brtan bcu drug gi 'dra sku byin can/ dri gtsang phugs kyi yang thog tu lha khang ka ba bco brgyad can/ nang du 'jam mgon rgyal pa gnyis pa'i sku brnyan stong phrag gcig gsung gi rten la yang rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog tshar bzhi/ bstan 'gyur tshar gcig rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum tshar gsum/bu ston rin po che'i gsung 'bum/ kirti blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung 'bum tshar gsum/ dze'i gsung 'bum sde dge'i dpar/byang chub lam rim chen mo tshar bcu drug rgyal ba dge 'dun grub kyi gsung 'bum/ paṇa chen sku 'phreng rim byon gyi gsung 'bum tshar gsum re/ kun mkhyen sku 'phreng rim byon gyi gsung 'bum/gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/ thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma'i gsung 'bum/ rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ sa skya paṇa ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan kyi gsung 'bum/ lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje sogs rgya bod kyi mkhas grub du ma'i gsung 'bum grangs las 'das pa bzhugs/ thugs kyi rten la dri gtsang phugs su rgyu rin chen gnyis pa las grub pa'i rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gdung rten byang chub mchod rten gyi mtho tshad la khri tsi lnga dang dngul srang nyis brgya lhag tsam dang sgor khri phrag kha shas kyis — 159 —
bzhengs shing / chos 'khor bcu gsum dang dar dpyangs g.yas g.yon bcas la dngul gyis rigs gsum mgon po'i gzungs sngags lan ñca bris pa 'bur rdung can/ g.yu byur gzi spos shel ba so sa le spram dang ma ṇi ho sogs rin thang gzhal du med pa'i phra rgyan gyis legs par spras shing mthong ba tsam gyis yid kyi dang ba 'dren pa/ gzungs bzhugs su sku 'bum byams pa gling dang bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi gzungs gzhug rgyas pa sogs byin rlabs kyi tshan kha rab tu 'bar ba'i gzungs sngags zab mo dang / khong rin po che'i gdung rus cha tshang / 'bral spangs ston pa/ phyag 'phreng / na bza' cha tshang / yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum pod bdun/ 'jam bsdud bzang gsum/byang chub lam rim/ ston pa stong sku/ rje rin po che'i sku khri gcig dang chig stong lnga brgya/ paṇa chen sku 'phreng bcu ba7rje btsun blo bzang 'phrin las lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog gis gnang ba'i paṇa chen sku 'phreng rim byon gyi gdung tshwa dang phyag tshwa na bza' /sku 'phreng bcu ba khong nyid kyis thum pur byas te gnang ba'i byin rten sna tshogs/ stag tsha sprul ba'i sku rje btsun skal bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog gi sku gong ma'i gzim sngas su 9— 160 —
bzhugs pa'i rje rin po che'i gser sku byon legs ma/ / mdzod dge khri ba rje blo bzang spyin pa tshang gis gnang ba'i rgyal ba dge 'dun grub pa dang / bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen sku 'phreng rim byon bcas kyi na bza'/ bla ma shang rin po che'i gtso thal/paṇa chen sku 'phreng bcu ba chen mo'i gdung tsha dang byang sems ril bu/ gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i gdugs dkar srung 'khor bka' rgya ma/ skye bdun ril bu/ rin chen ril bu/ lha ldan jo bo'i na bza'/ rje rin po che'i tshems par/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan kyi byin rten/ rgyal ba dben sa ba'i gdung tshwa/nor gling rten mdzod nang gi rgyal ba sku 'phreng rim byon bla brgyud dang bcas/ sa dge rnying gsum gyi rin chen rigs dang byin rten 'gangs chen/ rgyal dbang rin po ches gnang ba'i byin rten/ rin chen btso thal/ rnam 'joms khrus ril/ sa skya gong ma'i brgya rdo/stong rdo/ khri dar lung ma/ lha sa'i jo khang nang gi lha tshang ma'i zhal gser/ gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i lha khang tshang ma'i lha rnams kyi zhal gser/ jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku thal/ sman sna bzang bo bcu gsum/ khri chen lnga ba chen pos gnang ba'i rje'i lam rim chung ba/ rje tsong kha ba'i tshems par/ paṇa chen sku 'phreng bcu ba'i — 161 —
gdung ts+tsha dang na bza'/ byams me gtsang blas gnang ba'i paṇa chen sku 'phreng rim byon gyi na bza' dang phyag ts+tsha/ paṇa chen sku 'phreng lnga ba nas bcu ba'i bar gyi gdung ts+tsha/ seng tshang sprul skus gnang ba'i 'jam dpal mtshan 0rjod/ gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyug gi mchod rten mthong grol chen mo legs 'grub kyi dran rten 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ seng tshang sku 'phreng bar ma'i na bza' dang dbu lo sa sngags sogs byin rten khyad du 'phags pa bgrang gis mi longs pa bzhugs/gzhan dgon pa'i nub phyogs su rta mgrin lha khang (lha khang 'di bcos bsgyur skabs su'ang chag 'jig ma byung la dgon pa'i rten gyi gtso bo'i gras shig red) nang du bzhugs pa'i sku gsung thugs rten ni/ ston pa shakyu thub pa/ rje rin po che/ rje btsun byams mgon/ thugs rje chen po/ ki rti blo bzang 'phrin las/ rje tshul khrims rin chen/ rten gtso slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ gu ru mtshan brgyad/ snang srid zil gnon/ rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa lha dgu/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ phyag rdor/ khyung / seng gdong gtso 'khor gsum pa/ gnas chung rgyal bo sku lnga sogs kyi sku brnyan rgyu sman spos las grub pa/ gsung rten du bstan 'gyur tshar gcig gser gyis bris pa'i 'bum — 162 —
tshar gcig je yab sras rnam gsum gyi gsung 'bum/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi gsung 'bum/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes dang blo bzang chos rgyan gnyis kyi bsung 'bum/ 'ju mi pham pa'i gsung 'bum/ lam rim sngags rim dang rgyal rabs sogs mtha' yas pa yod/ thugs kyi rten la gser gyi mchod rten chen mo gcig bcas bzhugs so/ / 'du khang rgyab phyogs su rje'i lha khang nang du / je yapa sras rnam gsum/ phyag rdor/ thugs je chen pa phyag bzhi ba/ rje'i stong sku sogs sman sku mang bo/gsung gi rten la rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur/ byang chub lam rim chen mo tshar brgya dang gnyis/ sngags rim chen mo tshar brgya dang gcigrje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum sogs legs bshad mang du bzhugs so/ / shar gyi 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs lha khang nang du rten gyi gtso bo 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs/ g.yas su 'jam dbyangs dmar ser g.yon du 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge/gzhan 'jam dpal mtshan brjod 'jam dbyangs nag po sogs sman sku mang bo/ rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i gyang thang / rje yab sras gsum dang 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad kyi gyang thang sogs rten gsum mtha' 9yas pa bzhugs so/ / gzhan yang thugs rje — — 163 —
chen po'i lha khang du/ gtso sku thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong /de'i g.yas su rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ g.yon du dpal phyag na rdo rje/ mi 'khrugs pa/ rje btsun bla ma skal bzang dam chos rgya mtsho/ rdze gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje sems dpa' / gnas brtan bcu drug sogs kyi snang brnyan sman spos las grub pa dang gsung rab gyang thang sogs mang bo bzhugs so/ /zhabs brtan seng gdong lha khang gi ( 'di ni paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po mdo smad kyi yul la tshibs bsgyur gnang skabs su dgon pa 'di'i nub phyogs su lha khang ngam tshwa khang gang rung zhig bzhengs na bla ma'i zhabs brtan la phan zhing 'chad nyan sogs gang thad du legs tshul sogs bslu med gsung gi bdud rtsi bstsal yang rgyu rkyen sna tshogs pas yun ring bzhengs ma thab par lus/'jam dbyangs bla ma bstan pa'i sgron mes/64blo dang brtson pa'i nus pa ci yod kyis/ /sngon rabs dam pa'i rjes su slob byed pa/ /de ni skal bzang skye bo zhes bya ste/ /dal 'byor thob pa 'bras bur bcas pa yin/ / ’ gsungs pa ltar dad partson can grwa rigs grags pa rgya mtshos bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhabs pad brtan cing bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams kyi sku tshe bskal — 164 —
ba rgya mtsho'i par du brtan pa dang 'dus sde rin po che'i 'chad nyan rgyas phyir rang gi tshogs mang 'gyed kyi skal dang / grong chog sogs dad rdzas ci byor thams cad chud zos su ma btang bar brtson pa drag pos sgor khri phrag bcu lhag gis seng gdong lha khang gnyis thog can 'di legs par bskrun)nang rten la seng gdong gtso 'khor gsum pa sman 'jim kyis bzos pa dang // ltung bshags so lnga/ rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa/'od zer can ma/ phongs sel sgrol ma/ tshe dpag med/ rnam rgyal ma/ 'jam dbyangs dkar bo/ rigs gsum mgon po/sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma/ rnam par 'joms ma/ mdo gdugs sgrol gsum/ mgon chos lnga sogs kyi ldem sku mang bo/ gsung rten du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog bskal 'phags ting sasu ma/ bstan 'gyur cha tshang dang gzungs bsdus sogs/thugs rten du byang chub mchod rten cha gcig thog rtseg gnyis pa na/ seng gdong ma'i sku 'bum bcu dang / ston pa'i sku 'bum/rje'i sku 'bum/ seng ge sgra dbyangs kyi sku 'bum/ gdugs dkar sku 'bum/ rta mgrin sku 'bum sogs sku 'bum mang bo dang /rje bla ma skal bzang dam chos rgya mtsho mchog gi sku tshad tsam kyis bzos pa'i si'u thang byin rlabs can sogs bzhugs so/ / byang — 165 —
phyogs su bar ma'i sde gzhung gis bzhengs pa'i rje'i ts+tsha khang (tsu khang 'di sngon gro tshang paṇ+ḍita'i sku 'phreng gong ma zhig gis mi srin kha gnon du bzhag) nang du rje rin po che'i sku 'bum ther mang bo bzhugs la snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mthong thos myong grub tu nyam thag 'gro ba'i nad gdon sogs zhi bar byed cing byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar bzhin pa lags so/ /nga yi sku brnyan nga dang khyad med par/rnam dag tshad ma'i lung gis gsal bar bstan/bstan pa'i snying bo gsung rab gcig bu zhes/rgya bod mkhas grub thams cad mthun par gleng / /thugs kyi chos sku'i mtshon don mchod rten zhes/ /mdo rtsa'i ṭī ka sogs las mang du bsngags/ /nges legs grong khyer mthong bar 'dod pa dag/tshogs gnyis rin chen gsog la cis mi 'bad/ /tshang tshing srid pa'i nags klung skyeg po ru/ /yang yang 'khyams pa'i rnam mang 'gro ba'i tshogs/ /bsod nams gser gyi them skas la brten nas / /gtan bde'i khang bar ngal gso'i skal bzang rnyed/ /— 166 —
mchog gsum dam pa'i byin rlabs gzi 'od 'bar/ /rten gsum 'bum phrag bsod nams dpal du lci/ /sgo gsum dang bas mchod dang bkur ba'i mthus/ /sku gsum zung 'jug go 'phang myur 'thob shog/ces ri bong dgon bkra shis byang chub chos 'phel gling gi gdan rabs bshad sgrub bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan las nyams pa slar sos te dar rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa'i da lta'i rnam pa brjod pa'i brga ste bdun pa'o/ 4/lnga ba/ zhar byung ser mang 'dus sde'i byung ba mdo tsam brjod pa/ser mang 'dus sde'i byung ba brjod pa la gsum/phyag 'debs gnang ba bo'i mdzad rnam dang 'brel te ser mang 'dus sde'i byung ba dngos brjod pa/ nyams pa slar gso byas te sngar srol bskyangs tshul/ sku gsung thugs rten ji tsam bzhugs pa'i dkar chags 'god pa'o/ /( 1 ) phyag 'debs gnang ba bo'i mdzad rnam dang 'brel te ser mang 'dus sngo'i byung ba dngos brjod pa/ skabs babs kyi brjod byar gyur ba'i ser mang 'dus sde ni/— 167 —
mdo smad lho rgyud kyi mdzod dge gling dkar stod du grags pa'i sa'i thig ler/ lha rigs dga' yi dpon rgyud ma nyams shing smug po ldong gi 'bangs rgyud ma chad pa'i gling ba stod smad bar gsum zhes rgyu longs spyod rnam sras gter la 'gran zhing / dpa' drag rtsal seng chen rgyal bor snyems pa'i ru sde skar tshogs bkra ba ltar chags pa las/ gling ba stod kyi sa'i char khri chen sku 'phreng gnyis pas rab byung bcu gsum par phyag btabs pa'i sgrub sde khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin/ khri chen sku 'phreng gnyis pa7rje blo bzang rgyal mtshan seng ge ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me glang ( 1757) lor 'bo ra'i khrom thog (deng seng 'a' ho rdzong khongs) tu yab drung ba lcags po byams dang / yum lcags mo byams gnyis kyi sras su sku bltams/dgung lo bdun du khri rgyal mtshan seng ge'i ( stag tshang /lha mo'i dgon 'debs pa bo) yang sprul tu thugs thag bcad de lha mo'i gser khri dgon du gdan sar bkod/ lha ramasu dge bshes khā shī blo bzang rgya mtsho yongs 'dzin tu bsten/ re zhig nas lha ldan du phebs te 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi chos grwar zhugs shing mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu lta gsan sbyong mthil phyin mdzad/ gong sa brgyad pa chen pos cho lo dang / tham — 168 —
ga gru sgor/ bka' shog sku gsung thugs rten/ gdugs rta dar sogs rnam grangs stong lhag gi dngos rten bstsal/ phyir phebs te lha mo'i gser khri dgon dang / gtsos dgon dga' ldan chos gling sogs dgon sde mang bo chos kyis bskyangs/ mdo smad kyi phyogs thams cad dang rgya hor sog gsum du zhabs kyis bcags shing skal ldan mang bo rjes su bzung / khyad par du gling ba hu ra stod ma'i dpon rabs gnyis pa dpal mgon sogs kyis gling ba stod smad bar gsum la mchod gnas kyi sgrub lde zhig 'dzugs rgyu'i ( skabs 'dir ri bong dgon tshugs med) skyabs 'jug yang yang zhus pas rab byung bcu gsum pa'i phyed phyi ma ( lo tshigs gsal bo ma nges) ru hu ra stod ma'i sar dge tshul slong dang dge bsnyen gang yin 'tshogs chog pa'i sgrub sde chung ngu 'di phyag 'debs mdzad cing ser ma 'dus sde zhes mtshan gsol/ khong gi sku gong ma khri rgyal mtshan seng ger dga' ldan gser khri'i thob rtags su gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang bo nas gnang ba'i gdugs ser bo zhig yod pa de dang tshogs dung zung gcig khri chen gnyis pa rang nyid kyi shangs khrag gis bris ba'i dpal ldan mgon po phyag drug pa'i snang brnyan sogs sku gsung thugs rten mang bo gnang ste srung ma'i gtso bo mgon po la gyis — 169 —
gsungs nas gnyer gtad nan mo phul/ gling ba stod smad bar gsum nas dge tshul slong dang dge bsnyen sogs lnga bcu lhag 'dus/lo rer thugs rje chen po'i smyung chen dang / ma ṇi'i bdun sgrub/sman bla'i bdun sgrub/ dga' ldan lnga mchod chenamo/ chos skyong spyi'i skang gso sogs chags med du gsungs/ gzhan gling ba stod smad bar gsum la sku rim ci dgos dus thog tu bsgrubs pas dad ldan mang tshogs la phan 'bras bla na med pa byung / rim gyis ser mang 'dus sde shin tu rgyas pas lcags sga can brgyad cu dang /lcags srab can lnga bcu/ lcags snyed can sum cu/ ('di dag rim bzhin thob thang gis btags rnga/ zhig yin par grags) zhes mtshan snyan shin tu che ba byung / skabs 'di dag tu khri chen sku 'phreng gnyis pa'i zhal nas/ khyed ser mang 'dus sde'i khrod du phyag rdor gos sngon can gyi sprul ba sogs nges don grub pa'i dbang phyug mang du bzhugs pas thugs lhod yengs med par 'gro don lta brtson dgos pa'i bka' nan mdzad/ mdzod dge'i bla ma tshul khrims rin chen gyis ri bong dgon bkra shis byang chub chos 'pheb gling gsar tu phyag 'debs gnang rjes/ lo re bzhin dga' ldan lnga mchod chen mo'i skabs/ ser mang dang ri bong dgon gnyis mnyam 'tshogs byas — 170 —
te dbu mdzad dang dge skul kyang ser mang gis byed srol yod/ zla bzhi ba'i tshes 'gor ri bong dgon pa'i gling 'dabs su gzhi bcas nas smyung chen la bzhugs pa dang /dgon pa'i grwa ba re gshegs na ser mang gdan drangs te gsang 'dus sogs kyi cho ga gsungs pa bcas ri bong dgon pa dang ser mang gnyis ni dpon po gcig gi mnga' 'og dang lha sde gcig gi mchod gnas yin pas phan tshun chos 'brel gser gyi thag pas dam bor bsdams shing hu ra stod smad bar gsum mtha' ba dang bcas ba'i mchod gzhi gcig bor gyur to/ /nyams pa slar gso byas te sngar srol bskyangs tshul/spyi lo ( 1958 ) lo nas yangs ba'i tha gru kun la bzlog tu med pa'i dus 'gyur byung zhing / de rjes rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i drag ser yang lo mang bor babs pas ser mang 'dus sde la yang bzod par dkazha ba'i chags 'jig dang mnar gcod thebs te grwa rgan gsum tsam khrims khang du khrid de nyonar gcod drag — po'i 'og sku gshegacas/ 'du kheng dang sku gsung thugs rten gcig kyang ma lhag par 'byung bzhi'i zhal zas su bstems te bgrang bya bcu phrag zung lhag 'das/ spyi lo ( 192 0 ) lor tang gis mi rigs — 171 —
srid jus bzang bo dngos 'bebs byas te rgyal bstan yang dar gyi nyi ma shar ba na/ sde ba'i 'go 'dren dang mang tshogs kyis khri chen lnga ba tshang la ser mang slar 'tshogs rgyu'i re 'dun nan mo bton par khong gis chog mchan thob bas sngon gyi ser mang ba bcu bdun hu ra stod ma'i mnyam las khang du 'tshogs/ (dge slong spyin pa rgya mtsho ma gtogs gzhan rnams rten skya bo'i rtul zhugs 'chang ba sha stag red ) sngar srol ltar dus mchod dang sgrub mchod sogs rim bzhin tshugs thub pa byung / spyi lo ( 1991 ) lor ru chen gyi 'go ba ma phun dang /mjal ba/ mgon po tshe ring gsum gyis ser mang la 'du khang zhig bzhings rgyu'i gros byas te stag tsha rje drung rin po che bskal bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshang gi mdun du 'du khang bzhings yul gyi sa brtags gnyis khyer bas/ cig shos shin tu legs pas der 'du khang bzhengs chog la rim gro mang bo bsgrub dgos gsungs/ rim gro ci yod bsgrubs rjes hu ra stod ma'i mang tshogs la skul slong byas te ma dngul bsdus shing / ma phun dang /mjal ba/ mgon po tshe ring gsum gyis ma bzhag dang blangs ngang 'du khang gsar bzhengs kyi las 'gan yongs rdzogs khur/ zla gnyis pa nas 'go bzung ste zla drug ba'i nang du ka ba bcu gcig — 172 —
can gyi 'du khang chung ngu tshon rtsi dang bcas ba legs 'grub byung ste dga' ston chen po bltar/ sku gsung thugs rten mang bo gsar bzhengs dang 'du khang phyi rol tu'ang zangs 'khor che chung lnga lhag btsugs/ sngon khri chen gnyis pas shangs khrag gis bris ba'i mgon po'i thang ga dus 'gyur skabs 'jig song bas/ slar yang mgon po'i thang ga gsar du bzhings te khri chen lnga ba chen po gnyan sras lab rtse bstod du phebs tshe spyan 'bul zhus pas khong gis khri rgya nag pa tshang la mgon po'i thugs gar sa bon 'bri ru bcugs shing rnam pa gnyis kyis rab gnas phul zhing snyan dar 'then/ khri chen mchog gis/ sngon gyi 'don cha thams cad chags med dang da lor ser mang gi grwa ba res myur mdzad ma khri re gsungs na shin tu legs pa'i bka' gsung bstsal ba ltar bla lhag tu bsgrubs/ dus de nas ser mang 'du khang du snga phyir khri chen gung thang bstan pa'idabang phyugmdzod dge bla ma bskal bzang dam chos rgya mtsho/ stag tsha yab sras/shing bza' bskal bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mdzod dge khri ba'am ri bong dgon gyi gdan rabs bcu ba rje blo bza spyin pa sogs skyes chen dam pa mang bos zhabs pad bkod cing dbang bka' chos sogs zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo lan mang bskor zhing — 173 —
byin gyis brlabs pas phyogs thams cad nas sngar srol nyams pa sor chud dang / ma nyams gong 'phel tu 'gro bzhin pa lags te/lo rer ri bong dgon nas grwa ba tshad ldan zhig ser mang 'dus sde'i bla mar mngags nas hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin yar 'tshogs byas te tshes bco lnga nas sman bla'i bdun sgrub la 'tshogs/sa ga zla ba'i nang du hu ra stod ma'i ru sde dang bcas pa thugs rje chen po'i cho ga'i sgo nas smyung chen la 'dug hor zla drug pa'i tshes gcig nas zhang ston bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gsung gi ma ṇi'i ril sgrub chen mor nyin bdun la 'tshogs shing mjug tu ma ṇi'i bum bskor yang byed/ hor zla bcu ba'i tshes nyer bzhi nas dga' ldan lnga mchod chen mor yar 'tshogs byas te nyin gsum gyi ring la 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gdung mchod du chos spyod brgyad cu dang smon lam bde lnga sogs grwa sa chen po'i phyag bzhes ji lta ba bzhin tu gsungs/ sgrub mchod dang dus mchod gang yin gyi mjug tu dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i yi dam gyi sgo nas chos skyong spyi'i skang gso rgyas ba la tshogs/ gzhan khom skabs gang yod cela dad ldan khyim tshang so sor bca' ba dang rim gro ci yod dus thog tu phebs nas gsungs shing / nad pa tshabs chen yin na rgyud ci— 174 — —
thams cad kyi rgyal bo dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bdag mdun bum gsum dang bcas pa'i sgo nas lho sgo bskur bas mngon sum myong grub kyi sgo nas phan pa chen po yod ces ru sde yongs kyis rgyun tu bstod la/nga tsho mtho sgang dang lung kyog so sor bkram ste dgon sde gzhan la 'brel 'dres dka' ba'i 'brog pa zhig la mtshon na/ ser mang sgrub sde 'di ni dus thog la phan pa'i sman bzhin du dad ldan mang tshogs la phan 'bras khyad du 'phags gapa thon dang 'don bzhin yod ces smyug thogs pa bdag gi thos 'dzin du'ang yang yang brgyud 1rdordo / /༷sku gsung thugs rten ci tsam bzhugs pa'i dkar chags ༷ 'god pa/lhag bsam dang snying stobs 'gran zla bral ba'i mi ser dkyus ma mgar gcod sogs kun gzigs bcu ba chen mo'i drung du mjal bar song tshe ser mang 'dus sde 'phel rgyas 'byung ba'i skyabs 'jug dang rten skal zhig gnang bar zhu zhus par/ kun gzigs mchog gis paṇa chen sku 'phreng dgu ba rje btsun ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba dpal bzang po'i zhabs phyags ya gcig gnang ba da lta 'du khang — 175 —
'di'i rten gyi gtso bor bzhugs la/ khri chen gung thang drug pa chen mo 'dir phebs bzhugs gnang skabs kyi gsung bshad du/ 66 sa cha 'dir 'di lta bu'i 'dus sde dang lha khang re yod pa shin tu legs/khyad par du kun gzigs dgu ba chen mo'i 'bas phyags gcig bzhugs pa ni ches ngo mtshar zhing sa cha 'di'i bsod nams red/kun gzigs dgu ba chen mo bdag gi bla ma yin pas zhabs phyags 'di mthong ba tsam gyis ngas ngos zin gyin 'dug do dam legs por byed rgyu gal che ga gsungs/ kun gzigs bcu ba chen mo 7rje btsun blo bzang 'phrin las lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog sku dngos kyis gnang ba'i tshe dbag med rgya bod sog gsum gyi yi ges bris ba gzungs gzhug can dang / paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba'i bzhugs khri / paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon gyi na bza'/ khri chen lnga ba chen pos gnang ba'i bla mchod tshogs zhing dang khong nyid kyi sku par/ rwa lo rdor grags kyi snang brnyan byin can/ rje bla ma bskal bzang dam chos rgya mtsho mchog gis gnang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi mdzad bcu'i thang ga dang khong rin po che'i sku par/ shing bza' skal bzang mchog gis gnang ba'i rdze rin po che'i sku 'dra/ mdzod dge khri ba blo bzang sbyin pas gnang ba'i paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba'i sku — 176 —
par/ snyigs ma'i mgon po sman bla bder gshegs brgyad kyi sku brnyan byin ldan/ stag tsha rje drung rnam gnyis kyis snga gzhug du gnang ba'i rje rin po che'i gser sku li ma dang / thugs dze chen po/ston pa'i sku 'dra/ khā shi sprul ba'i sku〉blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog gis gnang ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi 'dra sku/ khri chen 7blo bzang rnam rgyal lung rigs seṅge mchog dang rgya nag pa rnam gnyis kyis rab gnas mdzad cing rgya nag pas thugs kur hūṃ yig phyag bris gnang ba'i mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thang ga byin can/ gdugs dkar phyag stong spyan stong dang sme ba lha dgu'i gyan thang / dpal rta mgrin dmaran po'i sku brnyan sman 'jim gyis bzos pa/ gsung rten du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog dang / bstan 'gyur/ 'bum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon gyi gsung 'bum/ / kun mkhyen drug pa chen mo rje btsun blo bzang 'jigs med thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dpa la bzang bos gnang ba'i tshe mdo byin can/ khri chen lnga ba chen pos gnang ba'i lam rim chen mo/ sngags rim/ gzungs bsdus/ gzhan mdo sde bskal bzang / 'phags pa brgyad stong ba/ mdo ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal bo sogs mtha' yas pa bzhugs — 177 —
so/ /rgyal ba dngos kyi gdul byar ma gyur kyang / /rgyal bstan snang ba 'bar ba'i rtse dga' la/ /rgyal blon 'bangs bcas 'phrul 'degs mi dman pas/ /ljongs 'dir nam yang chos kyi chu gter 'phyur/ /mi dbang chen po'i re bcol gling bu yis/ /rgyal sras khri chen gnyis pa'i rgyud bskul te/ /spyi mthun bsod nams nor 'dzin sgeg mo'i gzhir/ /gsang sngags sgrub pa 'dzin pa'i dga' tshal bskrun/ /bshad sgrub sprin dkar dgon pa'i chos sde dang / /sgom pa nyams bzhes zab pa'i sgrub sde sogs/ /go la'i khyon 'dir grangs mtha' mi dmigs kyang / /ser mang 'dus sde 'gro la gcig tu sman/ /stong gsum nor gyis gzhal par mi spobs la/ /nyi zla'i 'od kyis gzi byin mi bzod pa'i/ /sku gsung thugs rten yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /'di phyi'i dngos grub stsol ba'i rten du bzhugs/ /ces ri bong dgon bkra shis byang chub chos 'phel gling gi — 178 —
gdan rabs bshad sgrub bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan las zhar byung ser mang 'dus sde'i byung ba mdo tsam brjod pa'i sarga ste brgyad pa'o/ /mthar smras pa/rgyal bstan lung rtogs gdengs can chu gter mkhas grub klu dbang 'bum gyis brdzid/ /rnam dag khrims gtsang ngur smrig gis mdzes dge 'dun ngang mo'i khyu tshogs rgyas/ /mthar thug dngos grub rtag tu 'jo ba'i rten gsum rin chen nor bus gtams/ /brgya phrag du ma'i lo rgyus ches zab blo chung rtsal gyis brgal nus min/ /nges don mkhas pa spyan zur ma g.yos kyang / /col chung blun po'i lag tu ma shor bar/ /sde 'di'i byung ba brjod pa'i las skal che/ /smug po ljong rgyud bu la lha yis bstsal/ /gang de'i ngo mtshar gāṅgā'i klung rgyun che/ /don ldan bdud rtsi'i ro bcud mngar mo can/ /rgyal kun dza hu yis kyang rdzogs min na/ / ▶▶— 179 —
bdag blo'i bskul pa'i shong ba srid re skan/ /'on kyang bskul pa'i rnga las sgra dbyangs bzhin/ /bdag mgrin skye ba lnga ba'i bu ga las/ /chos sde 'di yi yon tane phyogs cha tsam/ /sgrog pa'i ngal ba khur du len dgos byung /skyes sbyangs blo gros lus stobs rgyas min yang / /mkhas r+ya chog du ma'i 'bas rdul legs mchod de/ /shes rig li shi'i me tog cung zos pas /byung rgyal smra ba'i spobs pa bdag la rgyas/ /de lta na yang kun gsal mtha'/ /bye'u chung mig gis gzhal min pas/ /ma rtogs 'khrul bshad snyog ma'i tshogs/ /gzur gnas mkhas dbang spyan sngar 'chags/ /phal cher mdo sngags bzhung lugs rgya mtsho las/ /shes rig rin chen 'tshol la brel ba'i dus/ /gzhan gyi che ba brjod nas lce zad pa'i/ /nga yi gshis ka 'di la yid thang chad/ /'on kyang 'di snang sgyu ma'i lang tsho mar/ /— 180 go
'dod sred spar mo dmar pos 'tham bzhin du/ /grong dang khrom nas mi tshe 'da' ba dag/bsam na kho bo'i las kyang mchog tu mthong / /bde sdug gcig tu ma nges 'khor ba'i gshis/ /dga' skyo skad cig skad cig rang gi gshis/ /de'i phyir gnyis 'dzin yid kyi mthongs yangs las/ /byang chub chos gling gdan rabs nyi ma shar/ /thugs rje'i cha bsdus 'phags pa mig mi 'dzum/ /snang mtha'i mgon po nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor zung / /gangs can 'dzin ma'i dgong la mngon 'phags te/ /dge legs snang ba dkar pos khyab gyur cig/dge ldan lugs bzang rnyog bral rgya mtsho rgyas/ /bslab gsum gzhung la thos bsam 'chad nyan rgyas/ /thos don sgom sgrub zab mo'i nyams len rgyas/ /mthon po'i ri rtse nyul ba 'brog ba'i bu/ /dma' mo'i zhing kha skor ba zhing ba'i bu/ /skyid po'i grong khyer 'grim pa dpon po'i bu/ /thams cad shes rig dpal la brtson par shog/— 181 —
gdan rabs gzhal med khang bzang bskrun pa la/ /rgyu nor mthun rkyen sbyar ba'i lha sde dang / /sna tshogs dka' ba spyad pa'i chos grogs sogs/ /mthar thug sku bzhi'i rgyal sa zin gyur cig/tshul 'di smra ba bo yang tshe rabs phreng / / mtshan ldan bshes gnyen ded dpon la brten nas/ /mdo sngags gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i 'jings brgal te/ /ku shes nor bu'i gling du rtsen par smon/ / / /zhes ri bong dgon bkra shis byang chub chos 'phel gling gi gdan rabs bshad sgrub bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/sngar chos grogs dam pa ar ma'i dga' ba rgya mtsho dang ngag dbang dge 'dun gnyis kyis bskul ngor phran gyis sa bon tsam zhig bris yod kyang / / da lor mdzod dge'i bla ma bskal bzang dam chos rgya mtsho mchog gis gtsos ri bong dgon gyi dge skul thabs mkhas rgya mtsho sogs las sne lhan rgyas dang / do dam u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gzhon pa bstan pa rgya mtsho che/ gzhan bstan pa rgya mtsho chung / 'jigs med rgya mtsho che/ ngag dbang blo bzang / gso rig smra ba byang rig kho sogs kyis gdan rabs rgyas pa zhig 'bri — 182 —
rgyur yang yang bskul zhing / snga phyi kun tu phyi nang gi rten 'brel sogs kyang legs par 'grig pas/ chos sde chen po rnga ba sgo mang dgon gyi gral mthar gtogs pa ldong yon tan rgya mtshos rab gnas sa stag ( 1998 ) lo'i mchu zla ba'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba dang bor 'go bzung ste nyin bco lnga tsam la dka' ba spyad mthar zla de'i dmar phyogs rgyal ba dang bo'i sa gnyis nang phrad dngos grub sbyor ba'i nyin mor mdzod dge gling dkar stod kyi ri bong dgon du mjug rdzogs par sbyar zhing / byang rig kho dang mkhyen brtse/ 'jigs med sogs kyis yi ge 'bri khur mtha' 'khyol ba byas so/ /'dis kyang thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che nam yang 'jig rten na nyi zla ltar gsal ba'i rgyur gyur cig dzayan+tu/
zur lta'i yig cha/mdo smad chos 'byung / rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long /bod sog chos 'byung / bod kyi lo rgyus kun dga'i me long / deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i klu dbyangs/ bod kyi lo rgyus don chen re'u mig deb ther dkar bo/ deb ther kun gsal me long /bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/ bod kyi lo rgyus rags rim g.yu yi phreng ba/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi gdan rabs/be+e ser/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i rnam thar/ bod mi bu gdong drug gi rus mdzod me tog skyed tshal/ gling seng chen gyi byung ba mdor bsdus/ kun lho'i bod brgyud nang bstan dgon sde so so'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ mdo smad klu stod kyi lo rgyus/ stag tsha bkra shis chos bzang gling gi gdan rabs lha'i rol mo/ bstan rtsis sogs so/ /— 184 —
