gotsho/ / mchod brjod/rgyal kun ye shes gcig tu zlum pa ngag gi lha mchog 'jam dpal dbyangs/mnyam bzhag sku las g.yo ba med kyang skal ldan gdul bya'i mos blo ru/ /mtshan nyid bcu ldan bshes kyi rnam rol sna tshogs dgos 'dod stsol ba'i rje/ /'bral med spyi gtsug rgyan du rtag bsten dge legs me tog deng 'dir stsol/ /'phags pas byin rlabs 'phags yul dkyil 'khor na/ /mang bos gcig bgros mang bkur lha yi rje'i/ /rgyal sras rim byon rgyal rabs 'bum phrag bcu'i/ /ngo mtshar byung ba srid pa'i rgyun du 'phur/ /mang bkur rigs rgyud ma nyams dmag brgya'i bu/ /— 1 —
mtshan bzang mkhyen stobs kun las khyad 'phags pas/ /bod kyi rgyal khams skyong pa'i dbang thang can/ /gnya' khri btsan po'i thog ma'i bka' drin dran/ /pur rgyal bod kyi mnga' thang gdugs dkar po/ / sna tshogs thabs mkhas 'phrul gyi dpung ba yis/ /dgong du 'degs mkhas rgyal rabs nyer bdun gyi/ /mdzad rjes jo mo blo ri'i srog la thim/ /dam chos nyi ma ma shar ba'i / /bod yul mun pa'i gcong rong du/ /thog ma'i skya rengs bsus pa'i rje/ /de sras lnga sogs phyogs las rgyal/ /chos srid mig gcig yi ge'i rig 'phrul dang / /sdos dang chos min rgyal khrims thig shing bzos/ /chos kyi srol btsugs mtha' bzhi dbang du bsdus/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sum gnyis sa las rgyal/mkhan slob zhal 'dzoms dge 'dun gzhi ma btsugs/ /the'i tsung blon chen ko dzu'i dmag dpung pham/ /chen po thang gi thob kyang stobs kyis blangs/ /— 2 —
chos srid gang la 'gran bral khri srong rje/ /lo paṇa gdan drangs mdo rgyud 'bum phrag bsgyur/ rgya bod 'khrugs pa'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal/gung gu rme rur sa mtshams rdo ring btsugs/ /mnga' bdag khri ral mdzad rjes deng 'dir dran/ / ——gnya' khri'i rgyud cig bu la smon tshe 'od gsal lha yi dkyil 'khor las/ /lha sras dga' ba 'bum ldan 'khrungs pa'i rigs rgyud gtsang bo'i rlabs kyi rtser/ /thon pa'i blon chen nyi ma'i 'od rnon mdo khams smad kyi gangs la zug/chos srid gzi 'od lham mer 'phros shing rigs rgyud rma klung rgyun dang 'dres/ /rab dkar kha ba'i rdul mang brtsegs pa gangs can sā la'i sman ljongs 4kyi/ /mdo smad cang shes chol kha'i mdzes rgyan mdzod dge gling dkar stod kyi char/ / phan bde bye ba'i rtsa lag bskrun mdzad mi dbang a klum la — 3 —
sogs kyi/ /mnga' thang rta gdong me ri 'bar ba'i grags snyan nam yang nyams pa med/ /de ltar mi dbang rim byon gyi/ /mdzad rjes rgya mtsho'i klung yangs las/ /cha tsam phyi rabs gzhon nu yi/ /thos 'dzin dga' ba'i dpyid du 'bebs/ /yin lugs phu thag gcod byed yig cha nyung / /mes po'i che ba dran pa'i rgan po nyung / /de'i phyir kho bo'i rnam dpyod me khyer gyis/ /phyogs kun ma gsal gzur gnas spyan sngar 'chags/ /zhes tshigs su bcad pa'i me tog gi phreng bas mdun bsus te 'dir mdzod dge gling pa'i mi dbang rim byon gyis chos srid skyong spel byas tshul brjod pa la bdun/dang bo/ rdze gnya' khri btsan po nas blon chen dga' ye shes dar rgyas bar gyi byung ba mdor bsdus/gnyis pa/ blon chen dga' ye shes dar rgyas kyi rgyud pa mdzod dge'i dpon khag sosor gyes tshul/— 4 —
gsum pa/ dpon a klum gyis gling ba stod smad bar gsum du phyes tshul/bzhi ba/ dpon sbra rgan tshang ste smad ma'i dpon khag gi lo rgyus/lnga ba/ stod ma'i dpon khag gi lo rgyus/drug pa/ bar ma'i dpon khrag gi lo rgyus/bdun pa/ zhar byung 'phel rgyas 'gro bzhin pa gling ba dgon grong gi rnam pa bcas so/ /[ 1 ] rje gnya' khri btsan po nas blon chen dga' ye shes dar rgyas bar gyi byung ba mdor bsdus/'dzam gling go la chen po'i sgal steng na chags pa'i gangs can bod kyi yul 'di'i phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang nang bcud kyi sems can chags nas yun ring 'gor rjes rkang gnyis mi'i 'a gro ba byung ste sngon gyi smon lam dang las skal gyis ma rmos pa'i lo tog spyod/rim gyis mi le lo can dag gis nang bar gyi skal ba de ring nas blangs te zos pa sogs kyis 'khrugs rtsod mang du byung pas rang byung gi lo tog med par gyur pas so nam dang ri dwags rngon pa'i las la gzhol/ de nas ma sang spun dgu sogs kyis dbang bsgyur te/— 5 —
rgyal phran nyi shu rtsa lnga dang sil ma bzhi bcu/ yang rgyal phran bcu gnyis sogs dbang bsgyur zhing gcig gi 'og la gcig ma sgur bar phan tshun mi mthun bar 'thab rtsod kyis dus 'da' bas 'bangs la dka' tshegs chen po byung ba na 'ang gsum bon bzhi la sogs shes pa mkhan bcu gnyis kyis mchid bgros mdzad nas bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal bo zhig 'tshol du phyin pas/ rgya gar mang bos bkur pa'i rgyal rgyud dmag brgya ba'i bu ( 'di la bshad tshul sna tshogs yod kyang bod kyi yig cha khungs dag rnams dang lo rgyus kun dga'i me long rang lugs su bzung ba'o/ / ) mtshan rtags sogs ya mtshan can byung ba rim gyis yul gyar ste bod kyi sa cha btsan thang sgo bzhir slebs pa dang 'phrad pas gzugs byad lta bas chog mi shes par mthong nas ngo mtshar skyes te khyed rang gang nas 'ongs dris kyang/ khong 'khor dang bcas pas bod skad mi go stabs/ gnam la mdzub mo ker bas/ 'di ni gnam las babs pa'i lha red do zer zhing / 'di ni bod kyi rgyal por 'os zer nas shing gis khyogs shig bzos te gnya' bar khur nas gdan drangs/ bod 'bangs thams cad kyis lha las chad pa'i ngo mtshar can du bzung ste thams cad kyi bkur sti zhus shing rgyal bor bkur bas dbang thang cher gyur te rgyal phran bcu — 6 —
gnyis dbang du bsdus/ thog mar gnya' bar khri bcas nas gdan drangs pas/ mtshan la gnya' khri btsan por gsol/gnya' khri btsan po nas gnam gyi khri bdun dang / bar gyi steng gnyis/ sa'i legs drug lde brgyad/ 'og gi btsan bzhi ste chab srid bon gyis bskyangs ba'i rgyal rabs nyer bdun/ de nas rgyal rabs nyer brgyad pa lha tho tho ri nas lhas lung bstan pa'i rgyal rabs lnga/ de rjes rgyal rabs so gsum pa srong btsan sgam po nas rgyal rabs zhe gcig pa mu tig btsan po'i bar rim par byon te bod kyi chos srid lugs gnyis shin tu rgyas par mdzad/ mu tig btsan por sras lnga yod pa'i chung ba sprul ba'i chos rgyal mnga' bdag khri gtsug lde btsan ral ba can spyi lo (〈 66 ) lor 'khrungs/blon po dag gis bka' bgros mdzad de rgyal sar bskos/ bran kha dpal yon sogs kyis blon po byas te rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/paṇ+ḍita mang bo spyan drangs te lo paṇa rnams kyis mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang bo bsgyur/ rgya bod dbon zhang ma mthun par bod dmag khri tsho mang bo drangs te rgya yul gyi mkhar mang bo bcom pa'i skabs/ bod kyi dge 'dun pa rnams dang / rgya'i btsun pa rnams kyi bar byas nas bka' mol gyi mtshams spyar te dbon zhang — 7 —
mthun par mdzad/ rgya'i gung gu rme rur (ka ci'i mchod rten dkar bo yod sar ngos 'dzin ) rdo ring btsugs te rgya bod kyis mtshams su bcad nas/ phan tshun gnyis gas sa mtshams las phyi rol tu brgal te dmag gi g.yul bshams pa sogs mi byed pa'i dpang lha klu gnyan po bzhag ste bro bor ba'i yi ge lha sa dang rgya rje'i pho brang /gung gu rme ru gsum gyi rdo ring la bris/ dus der rgya bod gnyis mthun zhing 'brel ba bzang bas/ gnam la nyi zla zung gcig dang /sa la btsan po dbon zhang zhes gleng / de ltar sprul ba'i chos rgyal chen po mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyis mtha' dbus yul gru thams cad dbang du bsdus pa na blon po mang bo phyogs yas mas su 'go 'dzin dang khral bsdu ru mngags/ chos srid lugs gnyis la mkhyen dpyod nyi ma ltar 'bar ba'i blon chen dga' yi shes dar rgyas ( rigs 'di la dga' rigs zer don 〈bod mi bu gdong drung gi rus mdzod me tog bskyed tshal 〉 las na( sngon bod kyi yul dbus su bod rgyal bo'i gdung rgyud rgyal sa ma thob pa zhig la bu med par/ thang lha sogs yul lha rnams la gsol ba btab/ bur smon skabs su nam mkha' nas mdun du 'ja' sna zug pa'i sne na bu chung ba zhig byung bar bu skal byas te shin tu dga' bas/mi rigs de la dga' rigs zer/ phyis su dga' ye shes dar rgyas bya ba mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyi blon po zhig bod srung ba'i phyir shar phyogs rgya — 8 —
bod kyi sa mtshams su bzhag ji zhes gsal bor bstan pas blon chen 'di'i gdung rigs bod kyi rus chen bzhi'i nang gses kyi sga min par 'dug )mchog mdo khams smad kyi ljongs su 'go 'dzin dang khral bsdu ru mngags pa yin te/ mkhas dbang dmu dge bsam gtan mchog gis mdzad pa'i 〈 lo rgyus kun dga'i me long 〉 las/ 66 mdzod dge'i sa 'di mdo smad kyi sa gzhan dag ltar/ gna' snga mor bod chags pa'i yul yin mod/ sngar bshad pa ltar thang gi rgyal bo dar ba'i skabs/ yul 'di dag thang gis bzung ste/ kru'u mang bo btsugs/ de rjes srong btsan sogs bod kyi btsan po stobs ldan dag gi dus su/ rgya mi mtha' skyod byas rjes sa 'di sa stong du gyur/mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyi dus su ka ci'i mchod rten dkar bo yan chod bod kyi mnga' 'og yin stabs/ dga' ye shes dar rgyas zer ba'i bod blon zhig khral bsdu ru 'ongs/ des sa 'dir chu bo chen po gsum 'bab cing / rtswa chu shin tu bzang pas/ sa stong du bskyur mi bra/ sa 'dir 'brog sde 'dzugs dgos zer nas sa 'dir gzhi bzung / / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ blon chen dga' ye shes dar rgyas kyis yul 'dir gzhi bzung bas 'brog sde chen po chags te stobs 'byor mnga' thang shin tu dar zhing 'bangs su gyur — 9 —
geba mtha' dag gi dpon du gyur bas bkur gzos che/ de nas rigs bzang zhing khungs btsun pa'i bud med cig blangs ba la bu lnga skyes/ bu che bas yab kyi srid dbang rgya cher bskyangs so/ /sngon gyi thugs bskyed rgya mtsho gting zab pas/ /sngon byon sprul ba'i chos rgyal zhe gcig gis/ /sngon tshe chos srid nyi zla bskrun pa'i tshul/ /sngon dang phyi ma'i mkhas rnams dgongs pa gcig/bstod na bstod rin ldan pa'i mdzad rjes yod/ /dpag na dpag par dka' ba'i lo rgyus yod/ /khongs na khengs kyang chog pa'i mes bo yod/ /zhum nas bsdad na lha sgrung tsam las med/ /stobs 'byor mnga' thang dar ba thang gi srid/ /yan lag bzhi ldan dpung gis pham byas te/ /rdzegser gyi khri 'phang la yang dbang bsgyur ba/ /gas bsnyon med lo rgyus mthong pas yid ches rnyed/ /bsil ldan zhing la rgyal khrims yug gcig gis/ /— ༷rnyi spras spra /(lha (sna( spras shāsta ts+tsha /snag/ sa pas/ / zhig sha/ji
mdzod dge sman ljongs zhes pa'i snyan pa 'bar/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ / [2 ]blon chen dga' ye shes dar rgyas kyi rgyud pa mdzod dge'i dpon khrag so khor rgyas tshul/dga' ye shes dar rgyas kyi bu che ba'i rgyud du/ che ba dga' stag thul can dang chung ba dga' spyang thul can gnyis yin/ de nas mdzod dge zhes pa'i ming thog tshul ni/ dga' stag ris can nam stag thul can gyi mi rgyud du bla ma dge 'dun zer pa der dpon dang bod kyi bla ma chen po dag rgya nag tu 'gro pa'i phyag mdzod byas bas phyag mdzod dge 'dug nam mdzod pa dge 'dun zhes ming can zhig byung / de'i mi rgyud ru sde bcas la mdzod dge zhes pa'i ming thogs ( gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i rnam thar du/ 66khri srong gis mdzod pa'am phyag mdzod dga' ye shes dar rgyas bod kyi kha 'dzin la gling yul du mngags pa dge slong gi cha byad du yod pas mdzod dger grags ji zhes pa'ang 'dug ) dga' stag ris can nam stag thul can dang dga' spyang thul can gnyis blo rno zhing shes rab che bas mdzod dge stod smad kyi sa cha phyugs skyong sar bzang yang / zhing sa dang ldan pa'i gnas gzhi bzang po zhig btsal bar 'dod nas/ dga' spyang thul can — 11 —
re zhig co ne sa phyogs rta mgo phug zer ba zhig tu shing gi spyil bu phub te bsdad/ kho rang blo rno zhing dpal rtsal che ba/ dge ba la dga' zhing dman par brtse ba sogs yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i stobs kyis phyogs 'di'i skye bo thams cad kyis rang gi dpon por bskos te ci gsungs dang du len par gyur/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan hor se chen rgyal pos rgya nag tu gdan drangs skabs da lta'i co ni'i lung der byon/ gnas 'di nyid sa bkra legs shing dgon pa btab na bstan par phan thog yod gsungs/nyid kyi zhal slob sa skya'i dge bshes shes rab ye shes la gnas gzhi 'ding du bcug rten bzhings sogs kyi zhal bkod dang dgos chas sogs bstsal/ dge bshes des 'phags pa'i bka' bzhin rab byung lnga ba'i shing mo lug (1 2 45 ) lor 'go brtsams te lha khang dang sku gsung thugs rten rgya cher bzhengs/ spyang thul dgon par mjal tu byon skabs chu chen po 'gro ba'i sne dang thug pas 'phags pa'i dngos slob dge bshes shes rab ye shes kyis chu sne la thug pa'i rten 'brel gyis khyed kyi mi rgyud chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyun ltar ring la/ 'khor 'dabs kyang rgyas pa zhig 'ong gsungs pas dgon pa gtad/ de nas bzung co ne dpon zhes grags/ bod kyi 'tsho ba — 12 —
la ja mar rtsam gsum med mi rung bas 'bru rigs kyi 'gan co rna'i dpon po dang / mar chur sha sogs kyi 'gan mdzod pa dge 'dug gyis bzhes te phu nu lag 'brel dang rong 'brog mnyam 'brel gyis 'tsho ba rol bar grags/ nu bo dga' stag thul can ( dngo khri )gyis srid ma bskyangs par la lung zhes pa'i sa khul du mi rgyud dar zhing zhi bzhin zhes tsho ba'i mi khyim du ma yod cing / dpon spyang bī dang g.yog dngo bī zer ba'i gtam rgyud kyang byung / mdzod dge 'dir bod kyi 'brog sde chags nas yun ring 'gor rjes/ rab byung ma tshugs gong gi drug cu skor de'i nang gling seng chen byung nas/hor gling 'khrug pa'i skabs/ thog mar hor 'di phyogs su slebs nas sa mang bo bzung mod/ gling gis hor dmag pham par byas te rma stod smad bar gsum gling gi mnga' 'og tu gyur/ rma stod smad bar gsum dbang du bsdus zhes ba ni/ mkhas dbang dmu dge rin po ches mdzad pa'i 〈 gling seng chen gyi byung ba mdor bsdus 〉las/ 66 rma chu'i chu mgo nas bzung ste/ za lar khog yar mar ni dbang bsgyur yul rma chu'i rgyud yin 'dug de la phyis su gling gis sa char cha bgos nas srung dmag 'jog yul ni/ mdzod dge stod yan chad rma stod du brtsi ba yin te/ gling dkar stod dang rma stod — 13 —
du brtsis pas/ stod zer ba yin 'dug ra rgya dgon yar mar la rma sked du brtsi/ za lar yar mar la rma smad du brtsi/ 〉〉 zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang nas mdzod dge gling dkar stod 'dir gling gis dbang bsgyur rjes/ yul 'dir bod mi bu gdong drug gi nang tshan smug po ldong gi rigs rgyud kyi dmag sde zhig gzhis chags pa la mdzod dge gling ba zhes pa'i ming thogs/r+sā ba 'di gling seng chen gyi dmag dpon tsha zhang 'dan ma'i dmag ru zhig lhag pa yin tshul rgan rabs mang bo'i ngag rgyun du gsal la/〈 gling seng chen kyi byung ba mdor bsdus 〉 las/ hor gling 'khrugasanas gling gis dbang bsgyur bas/ mdzod dge gling dkar stod kyi sa cha/ zhes ba'i ming de chags/ gling gi sde lhag zhig yod pa'i sde ba del 66 gling ba ji zhes smrung ma 'gyur bar yod/ zhes gsal bor gsungs so/ / gling gi srid nyams —rjes gling dkar stod 'di'i ru sde rnams ris gyis 'bos bo tshang / mdzod dge stod ma/ 4 byams me/ ban yus/ rkyang tsha/ tshong ru/ gza' ru bcas 'brog sde brgyad dang rong sde bzhi ste mdzod dge shog bcu gnyis su gyur/ shog kha so so'i 'bangs kyi nang du smug po ldong — 14 —
rgyud gtso gyur ba'i rigs rgyud mang du yod mi ser la nges pa med de dper na/ mgo tsha stag tsha phur tsha ste ldong tsha chen bco brgyad kyi nang tshan gyi rigs yod pa'i/ dpon po rnams ni sngon gyi blon chen dga' ye shes dar rgyas kyi rigs rgyud ma nyams par phyogs so sor gyes ba yin te/ bod blon dga' ye shes dar rgyas kyis bu che ba'i rgyud du byung ba'i dga' stag thul can nam stag res can gyi mi rgyud zhig gis reb bza' stag ring bza' / 'bal bza' gsum blangs/ gsum kur bu gsum skyes/ pha 'bal gyi sa char shi/bu che 'bring gnyis kyis sa mkhan la rang rang dar sa zhig tu pha dur —'debs dgos kyi 'dod btsong / de 'dra'i sa dka' yang thams cad dar sa zhig tu 'jog byas/ bu chung bas ci yang ma bshad pas chung rgyud lhag par dar ba byung / che ba reb bza'i bus rme stod bzung ba'i rgyud pa deng sang mdzod dge stod mar grags pa yin/skabs shig stod ma'i a tse zer ba'i longs sbyon can zhig byung /des dbus bu rgyal ba yab sras la rta chen rtser son mang bo phul ba chibs chen gyi gras su song / 'bring bo stag ring bza'i bus rma rme rka gsum gyi bar nas sa bzung ba'i rgyud pa mdzod dge byams me dang / mtshams shig thang bza' zhig blangs pa'i rgyud pa gyes pas — 15 —
9thang skor thogs/ 'di'i dpon bkra shis dbang dang sog tshang dpon pos rka rma 'dres mtshams su ri khrod btab ste khri chen mchog sprul blo bzang rgyan seng la phul/ khong gis rgyud stod grwa tshang btsugs nas 'chad nyan pa rim par gtong / rka chu rka stag rtse nas 'bab pa'i stod du a mchog smra seng gling gi mchod bzhis rwa rikhog tsho ba brgyad kyi 'brog sde yod / 'bal bza'i bu rgyud du dpon blo gros bzang bo zer ba byung zhing / khos paṇa chen chos rgyan gyi sku tshe smad la mjal/ kho bo'i sa char sku tshab bla ma zhig dgos zhus par/ nyid kyi gzigs dpe brgyad stong gser bris ba —shig gnang ste re zhig 'di la mchod bkur gyis dang / rjes sor 'di'i bdag po zhig 'ong bas des khyed kyi bla ma byed gsungs/riphyis rje de nyid dag zhing du dgongs pa gtad rjes sku mdun pa sangs rgyas bzang bo zhu bas sku 'bum phyogs su gnas mjal du 'gro pa'i yar lam 'di tshang la phebs/ phyag dpe brgyad stong ngos bzung / lung bstan dang mthun par byung bas bla mar bkur/brgyad stong glegs bam da lta rkyang tsha'i rgyal dge ri khrod du bzhugs/de nas bzung bkra shis lhun po'i bla ma zam ma chad par byon bzhin yod/ 'bos dpon po/ gling ba'i dpon po/ bzhag ldom — 16 —
dpon po/ mdzod dge smad kyi shog kha lnga'i dpon po rnams kyang dpon blo gros bzang gi rgyud pa yin/gling ba'i dpon po rab brtan gyis kun mkhyen gong ma gdan drangs/ su rug thebs su rta rgod ma brgya phrag mang bo phul/rigs rgyud kyi don du kun mkhyen mchog nas dngul bum la ri gter bcug bas mi rabs mang bo dar/ de dus dud kha tshig stong lnga brgya lhag tu 'phel zhing ( mdo smad chos 'byung du chung rgyud lhag par dar gsungs ba de dus yin par grags/ ) bla brang bkra shis 'khyil dang chos 'brel zab mo yod/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me sogs skyes chen dam pa mang bo gdan drangs shing zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi bstsal/bla brang nas dge rgan mngags pa'i srol kyang yod/ kun mkhyen mchog gi zhal nas rjes sor rang re mchod yon gyi bar la ser 'jug cig byung / zhes lung bstan pa dang / 'phan chu bstan rgan zer ba'i lha ba zhig gis kyang lung bstan du rdo a mo gcig la zur kha brgyad 'bab pa'i dus shig gling ba la chag 'jig nyam nga chen po 'byung zer ba'i dus la babs nas/ dpon dbang rgyal gyi dus su ru sde la nang 'khrugs tshabs chen byung / ru sde thor nas phyogs nges med su 'khyams dgos byung / bar skabs shig la dam — 17 —
sri sel 'jig gi gnod pa yin pa shes te the bo lung bzang nang sprul skus lhag bsam zol med kyis bar 'dum byas nas mthun sgril dam zab yod pa'i lam la bzhag ste dpa' re sprul ba'i sku bsko bzhag gnang ba nas bzung sngon srol ltar chos 'brel yon mchod kyi bdag po ra gyur nas bla ma dam pa rnams gyis 'gro phan sngar las lhag pa bskyangs shing bshags pa bzod gsol dang mang 'gyed gtong sgo sogs gong na med pa byas/ gling ba'i dpon po rab brtan dang dus thog mnyam pa dpon tshe brtan bzang gi rgyud pa mtsho skor kha ba sogs so/ / rab brtan gyi bu che ba a 'brug ( 'brug thar rgyal yang zer ) gis rma rme 'dres mtshams su sa bzung / mda' la shin tu 'phong skyen pa zhig yin zhing lo brgya lhag la bsdad/ kho'i ring la dgra rkun dang gyod zer ba rna bas thos ma myong bar grags/ a 'brug la bu bdun byung ba'i rgyud pa so sor gyes/ thams cad kyi spyi nas gser dngul spel mas bka' 'gyur bzhengs/mi rabs phyi ma rnams la yang yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/bskal bzang / thar mdo rnams gser dngul gyis bzhengs mkhan byung zhes 〈mdo smad chos 'byung / 〉du gsal/ a 'brug gi bu che ba blo bzang dar rgyas sam yongs grags la mdzod dge a bu — 18 —
zer ( deng sang yang a bu tshang zer pa'i sde ba zhig yod ) kho sde dger gan mang bo song ste dpon chen dang 'dres cha byas/ co ne dpon dang phu nu sgrig a rnam dang a don zer ba'ang a 'brug gi bu yin par snang la/ bu gsum pa phyag rdor skyabs yin/ de'i rgyud pa 'og tu brjod/ glu 'brug gi chun ma ho bza' la bu che ba gzungs phyug rgyal dang / 'bring ba tshul khrims/ chung ba ban de sgom bcas bu gsum yod pa'i rgyud par ho bza'i bu rgyud zer/ 'di kun mkhyen 'jigaha med dbang po'i sbyin bdag gi gtso bo yin/ho bza'i bu tshul khrims shi ba'i gshin sngas su rje 'jigs med dbang bo lcags 'brug ste spyi lo ( 1760 ) lor phyogs 'dir dang bor phebs/ rta rgod ma brgya dang dngul srang sum brgya phul/ de nas nam phebs res kyis 'di ba'i mtha' nas gzhi 'dzin/ a ma tshang zhes thugs mnyes mdzad/ me bya lo ( 176 0 ) lor kun mkhyen mchog gis mdzod dge a ma tshang gi rtsar rta brgya tsam dang /rta rdzi gnyis bzhag rim gyis rta dzi gnyis gas khyim re bzung /shar ba rnam rgyal/ rgya tshang / a wo byams pa sogs khyim sgo nyi shu tsam byung / de'i steng du bsang kho tshe gnyis nas khyim tshang nyi shu bsnan/ ru sde je mang la song / dpon po lha rgod dang / mgon — 19 —
tshe/ bsod nams la bcol nan mdzad de dngul rwa la sa 'dzin du bcug pas dngul rwa lha sde zhes ming thogs/ 'di gling ba nas chad pa yin/ mdzod dge blo bzang dar rgyas sam a bu tshang la a bu'i bla ma zer ba zhig 'khrungs/ khong gis lha mo'i dgon gsar tshugs kyi skabs dge bskos dang dbu mdzad bstud mar byas te bka' drin shin tu che bar gleng / lha ldan du phebs te tsan dan jo sku rtse khri gang ba zhig dang co ne nas bka' 'gyur gdan drangs ba gnyis tsha gan pe shing dgon du phul ba 〈mdo smad chos 'byung / 〉 du gsal /a bu'i bu gsum pa phyag rdor skyabs kyi bu 'gyur med rdo dze ni dran tshad lag tu len mkhan zhig yin pas gling pa'i dpon po dbang rgyal dang nang 'khrugs byung bas chu 'brug ste spyi lo ( 1〈 2 2 ) lor byams me dang bzhag ldom dag gis gling ba'i dbang rgyal la dpung rogs byas/ 'gyur med kyi dpung dngul rwas mnan kyang ma thub par ru sde dang bcas ba yul phud btang ba nyin ma nas gzhi bzung /mdzod dge gling ba'i g.yul las bskrad pa'i ru sde zhig yin slad mdzod dge nyin ma zer/deng sang gi mdzod dge dme bo dang byams me'i bum skor sogs kyang skabs de dus gling ba nas chad do/ ji/ nang 'khrugs — 20 —
des mi rta mang bo shi rmas su btang bas chu sbrul te spyi lo ( 17 2 2 )lo'i sa ga zla bar nyin ma dang gling pa'i gyon don chod yig bla brang phyag mdzod mkhan po'i gsung ltar kirti rin po ches bzhag pas rtsod med mthun sgril gyi 'tsho ba rol/ rab brtan gyi bu che 'og lcags rgyal gyi sde khrod du the bo bum pa'i ru ba mang bas bum skor zer/'bring bo a snying la yang rgyud pa yod pa 〈bod kyi lo rgyus kun dga'i me long 〉 du gsal lo/ /ka dag gdod nas bsod nams stobs dang sngon gyi bag chags kyis/ /kha ba'i ljongs kyi sprul rgyal rim pa'i mdzad bzang srid na 'bar/ /ga sa gang du 'thor sdod gcig bsdus mtha' bzhi'i dgra dpung pham/ /nga cag mgon du dga' rigs blon chen ye shes dar rgyas phebs/ /gang gi rgyud rnams phyogs su gyes tshul las/ /rim byon chos srid skyong ba'i snyan pa che/ /chol gsum bod mi'i yul gru kun la khyab/ /
mdo smad dbu 'dzin gzhan gyi kha gnon dngos/ /dpa' rtsal dgu 'gyur 'gran bral dbang thang can/ /rma klung yul gru'i rgya khyon bdag gir bzhes/ /shog chen bcu gnyis me tog sa bon bkram/ /rong 'brog mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa phyi rabs gsos/ /zhes bya ba'ang par skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /[3 ] dpon a klum gyis gling ba stod smad bar gsum gyi dpon khrag phyes tshul/rab brtan gyi bu bzhi ba a klum yin zhing kho pha khyim du bsdad/kho dang phu bo a 'brug sogs rma rme 'dres mtshams nas ru spor te mdzod dge mda' dmar gzhung du gozhi bzung / ( deng sang gi gling ba stod smad bar gsum gnas yul yin/ ) a 'brug sogs mi rabs de dag mda' rtsal shin tu che bas mda' dmar gzhung zhes ming thogs par bshad/ a klum gyis mda' dmar gzhung du gzhi bzung ste mdzod dge'i 'brog chen gyi nang gses gling ba 'brog sde'i spyi dpon byas nas chos srid lugs gnyis kyi rim pa legs par bskyangs shing 'bangs la byams pa dang chos la dad pa sogs rnam dkar kyi bya ba mang bo la brtson/ rim gyis ru sde ji rgyas ji dar la — 27 —
song / kho'i bu 'bring ba a bkra chos dad che zhing dpa' rtsal dgu yongs su rdzogs pa zhig yin pas stod du mngags te gzhi bzung ba la hu ra stod ma zer/ bu che ba bkra shis rnam rgyal bar nas bsdad de gzhi bzung ba la hu ra bar ma zer/ a klum kho rang smad nas bsdad pas hu ra smad ma zhes hu ra stod smad bar gsum du phyes/a klum gyi khyim gzhi hu ra smad na yod pas kho tshang la dpon sbra rgan tshang zer a klum gyi bu chung ba'i rgyud du ( rgan po dag gi ngag rgyun la brtags na bu chung ba'i ming la a 'bum zer ram snyam/ da dung dpyad pa gtong dgos ) mdzod dge bla ma tshul khrims rin chen 'khrungs/khong stag tshang dpal gyi lha mo'i chos sgor zhugs tsam dang / gdan sa chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs te dge bshes kyi mtshan btags blangs/ phyir rang yul du phebs te gsang sngags rig pa 'dzin pa'i chos sde chen po ri bong dgon bkra shis byang chub chos 'phel gling gsar du btabs shing mdzad 'phrin rgyas tshul sogs 〈ri bong dgon bkra shis byang chub chos 'phel gling gi gdan rabs bshad sgrub bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan 〉 du gsal/ de ltar lha rigs dga'i rgyud pa ma nyams pa dpon a klum gyis hu ra stod smad bar 9gsum du phyes te chos srid lugs gnyis kyi cha nas phyag rjes bla med — 23 —
bzhag ( khri chen gung thang drug pa chen mo spyi lo 198 9lor gling bar phebs skabs gsung bshad du 66 gling ba'i yul 'di ni mgon po 'od dpag med kyi 'ing khams dngos yin/ sngon 'di nas ri bong dgon ma tshugs gong 'cham zhig btsugs pa'i lo rgyus yod 〉〉 ces gsungs te 'cham tshugs dus dpon a klum gyi dus yin par snang / ) kho'i ring la phyi nang gi 'khrugs rtsod med par ru sde thams cad kyis mthun sgril za ba mo'i ngang 'tsho ba skyel du bcugs/ lo na mthon por son rjes tshe yi 'du byed bta nga ba na rma klung sngon mo'i 'gram du rgyal dur zhig yod pa der bang so btsugs shing hu ra stod smad par gsum gyis 'das mchod du dge rtsa rgya chen po bsgrubs so/ mi dbang rab brtan rgyud kyi gangs ri las/ /a klum la sogs stag shar chu bdun babs/ /mdzod dge sman ljongs stod smad thig le ru/ /ru sde tshang tshing nags kyi dga' tshal bskrun/ /a 'brug a tsam mda' la skyen drags pas/ / rgyal bo ra tshom ṇa yi snyan pa 'phrog/ — mda' rtsal 'bum phrag 'gran pa'i spang thang la/ /mdzod dge mda' dmar gzhung gi cho lo bstsal/ / — 24 —
mtha' klas chu gter chen po'i 'jug ngogs las/ /chu phran mang bo phyogs su gyes pa ltar/ /mi dbang chen po a klum sbra rgan las/ /phyi nang 'khrugs rtsod char sprin nag po med/ /rkang bzhi'i phyugs kyi 'phel kha nyin bzhin rgyas/ /skyes chen du mas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dus kyi 'tsho bar rol/ /ces bya ba'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /[4dpon sbra rgan tshang ste smad ma'i dpon khag gi lo rgyus/dpon rabs gnyis pa a 'bum lha mo gser khri dgon dga' ldan bshad sgrub pad dkar grol ba'i gling gi spyin bdag gi gtso bor gyur bas khri chen rgyal mtshan seng ge mchog gis thugs tsis chen po gnang ste/ a klum tshang gi chos srid lugs gnyis kyi bya ba legs po yong phyir mgon po phyag drug pa la gnyer du gtad/ dus de nas bzung lha mo gser khri cadagon nas dpon sbra rgan tshang la gsol kha ba mngags nas mgon4po'i cho ga ba dang gur bcas gnang bas mgon po'i lha gur zer/ ( gzhan yang gser khri nas hu ra bla ma zhes 'bul — 25 —
sdud kyi tshul du gling bar mngags pa kho tshang gi zur du 'dug dgos la lo rer lha dar re dang sha phyi nang bcas dpon tshang la sprod dgos/ da rung khā shi'i su rug dang lha sde yod pa'i rgyu mtshan zur du bshad/ ) a 'bum gyi khyim gzhi de nas bu zhig skyes pa la kho tshang gi lhag pa'i lha ni mgon po phyag drug pa yin pas/ mgon po la 'phrin bcol dang bsangs mchod rgya cher byas nas ming la mgon po skyabs btags/ ( de nas bzung dpon tshang gi dpon rabs rim byon gyi ming zur la mgon po re 'dogs srol chags/ ) nar son skabs mgon po skyabs la a 'bum gyi dpon sa sprad/ kho rang gshis rgyud 'jam la ngang rgyud ring zhing / lhag par phyugs zog skyong bar ha cang dga'/ khos ru sde la mthun sgril bzung bo'i sgo nas mnar gcod dang gnya' gnon mi byed par rgyu 'bras dpang du bzhag ste chos srid legs par bskyangs/ nye gnas kyi ru sde rnams la'ang btsan 'dzul dang 'khrugs rtsod med par tshod thug sems chung gi sgo nas 66 mtsho bde na nya skyid ga ces pa'i dpe ltar ru sde phyi nang gang yin gyi longs spyod yar tshes zla ba dkar bo'i 'phel khar 'gran bzhin sna gsum phyugs rigs 'tsho skyong legs po byas nas bde skyed kyi 'tsho ba rol to/ /mgon po skyabs kyi bu rta mgrin mgon po yin/ pha shul bus — 26 —
'dzin pa'i dpe ltar sbra rgan tshang gi chos srid kyi dbang cha tshang ma sprad/ khos 'khor ru sde byams kyis bskyangs shing nang phu nu 'khrig mthun byas te bsdad kyang brtse med 'chi bdag nag po'i bsu ma slebs pas yun ring la dpon byed khom ma byung bar tshe las 'das/kho la bu mo sgrol ma 'tsho ma gtogs dpon shul 'dzin pa'i bu med pas bya thabs bral te/ sde ba'i mi sna song nas lha mo gser khri dgon na bzhugs pa'i rta mgrin mgon po'i spun snyan grags zer ba'i dge slong zhig yod pa la phyir yong ste dpon sa skyong dgos pa'i re ba bton/ dge slong snyan grags ni 'jigs rten 'di snang la zhen pa log ba zhig yin yang / sde mi rnams kyi re ba stong zad du ma btang bar dpon sa skyong du yong ste re zhig bsdad/ 'on kyang khos 'jig rten sun 'byin gyi bya ba la skyo snang skyes shing dam tshig dang sdom pa dor nas 'khor ba'i 'ching rgya ru 'dzul gtan nas ma 'dod pas khyim thabs ma bzung bar/ hu ra stod ma'i dpon po mdzod tshe la sde ba stod smad gnyis ka mnyam du skyong rgyu'i re ba yang yang bcol bas/ dpon mdzod tshe la yang dge slong snyan grags kyi nges 'byung la ngo mtshar skyes shing mes po gong ma nas brgyud pa'i nye 'brel la bsam ste hu ra stod smad gnyis ka khyad med bskyangs/ rta mgrin — 27 —
mgon po'i bu rtsomo sgrol ma 'tsho cher skyes pa na dpon tshang dge slong snyan grags dang mdzod tshe gnyis kyis gros byas nas bzhag ldom dpon po tshang gi blo bzang rgya mtsho'i bu skar ma mag par bzhag de nas skar ma la smad ma'i dpon tshang gi thob thang dang dbang cha yongs rdzogs sprad de dpon por bskos/khos kyang khrims srol thams cad bzung nas ru sde bskyangs/kho rang ni lhan skyes kyi gshis ka rtsub la dpa' rtsal dang ldan pa/dmag thabs la shin tu mkhas shing rku jag 'khrugs rtsod la dga' ba zhig yin pas nam yin yang ru sde nas dmag dum re'i sna khrid byas nas sde ba gzhan btsan shed kyis cham la phabs pa dang / gzhan gyi jag pa mang bos dpon tshang skar ma la mgo 'bul lus 'bul byas nas bran du bkol/ khos dpa' rtsal dang dmag thabs la 'gran zla bral ba'i dpon tshang skar ma zhes mdzod dge shog bcu gnyis kyis dus 'khrugs skabs su 'go 'dzin lta bur gyur/skabs shig 'bring ba nas bros bshol ba zhig ste a mgon zer ba'i mi g.yo can zhig yong nas dpon skar tshang nas yun ring la bsdad/bros mgon nam a mgon gyis 'dre lag brkyangs te skar ma'i ru sde'i aṅgā tshang la g.yag gcig brkus/ khyim bdag tshang gis rtsad — 28 —
gcod byung bas dpon skar gyis bar 'dum byas nas g.yag 'jal byin rgyu byas kyang bros mgon gyis 'jal yag po zhig ma byin pas aṅgā'i bo lo dag gis bros mgon mi rta gnyis ka bsad/ rkyen des skar ma dpon 'bangs kyi nang la'ang 'thab rtsod chen po byung ste phan tshun la mi rta mang bo bsad pas 'jig rten gtam dpe la 8( myi mchu thur cig gis sde dgu gtor/ shing rtse thur cig gis snod dgu ral/ / 〉〉 zer ba ltar mes po gong ma'i mdza' mthun gyi rmang rdo rtsa ba nas bshig pa dang / 'khrugs rtsod mi 'dod pa'i sprin nag 'khrugs te nyen tshabs chen po'i skabs su mdzod dge shog yas mas kyi dpon po dang dgon pa g.yas g.yon gyi las g+ne sogs kyis bar 'dum byas nas mi 'dod nang gyod kyi 'thab rtsod zhi ba'i gnas su bzhag dpon rta mgrin mgon po'i bu mo sgrol ma 'tsho dang skar ma gnyis la mgon po bsod nams dang mgon po dgra 'dul/dga' rdo bcas ming sring gsum skyes/ phyis su skar ma'i chung ma sgrol ma mtsho tshe las 'das/ dpon tshang skar mas slar yang mdzod dge stod ma'i ngag bkra'i bu mo mna' mar blangs bas/ bu lha yas dang —gsung rab nam kho gsum skyes/ de nas yun ring ma 'gor bar mang tshogs bcos sgyur ram dus 'khrugs kyi me lce gang sar mched — 29 —
pas/ kho'i bu mgon po bsod nams dang dpa' rgod mang bo khrid de 'thab 'dzing drag po'i g.yul la zhugs nas mi bsad rta rmas kyi 'khor lo bskor bas dpon tshang skar ma'i dmag 'thab dang snying cistobs zhes bstod bsngags dang yi rangs byed pa'i gnas su gyur/spyi lo 1959lor bla ma myi dpon dang phyug bdag gral rim sogs rim gyis 'dzin bzung byas skabs/ rgyal khab kyis dpon tshang skar ma'ang mi nag nyes chen po'i gras su bzhag ste 'dzin bzung byas nas srog chad bcad do/ /dpon tshang skar ma'i bu mgon po bsod nams la dpon sa sprod khom ma yod par bcos bsgyur dang thug kho la bu nam kho sogs rigs rgyud yod/ mgon po bsod nams rang gi pha'i rjes shul du 'brang ste zing 'khrugs kyi g.yu/la sa la song nas 'thab 'dzing mang bo'i nang du lhung ba ma zad dpa' rtags mang bo bstan pa dang de'i dus kha las ha cang dge par bshad/ g.yul 'khrugs chen po de phyogs so so nas langs pas kho rang rgyal khab la mgo ma sgur bar dmag 'thab skabs su g.yul las 'das so/ /mgon po bsod nams kyi bu nam kho sogs dus dbang gi da lta chu nag phyugs ra (tsho mdzo1436 )na yod/ khos nam yang dpon — 30 —
rabs gong ma'i srol ltar rang gi ru sde la phyi mig bltas te nus ba ci yod kyis rogs ram byas/ khyad par tang gi mi rigs srid jus ngos 'beb dang chos lugs dad mos rang dbang gi srid jus lag tu bstar te rang dgon byang chub chos 'phel gling nyams gso byed skabs su khos rgyu 'byor ci mang gi mthun rkyen sbyar ba dang rang gi ru sde dang phu nu sogs la skul slong byas nas kha sems dkar po'i bsam pa bzang bo bzung / ri bong dgon gyi tshogs chen 'du khang chen mo legs 'grub kyi skabs kho rang gdan 'dren byas te ston pa'i gser sku byin can zhig rten skal du gnang zhing dpon rabs snga ma bzhin bkur bzos thob/ mang tshogs dang gling ba dgon grong gis mes po gong ma'i khyim shul du yod pa/ pha shul gyi bu dang khu shul gyi tsha bo 'di yin zer nas don gal chen gyi gras su bzhag ste blo 'dri gros gsum byed pa dang kho la re ba chen po bcangs yod do/ /'di las 'phros te/ hu ra smad ma'i khā sog ru sde byung 'phel gyi skor tsam brjod na/khā shu dpon slob ngag dbang phun tshogs mchog gling ba'i mes gong ma rnams dang chos 'brel ha cang zab pas mchod yon gyi nang ma la gyur/ thengs mang bor gang 'dod kyi re ba bskangs pas dad — 31 —
ldan mang bos nam yang 'bral bar med par rjes su 'dzin pa'i gsol ba btabs pas/nyid kyi zhal nas dge bcu dpal kun 'dzoms shing rang byung khor yug mdzes pa'i gling sa mthong ba kun smon 'di la thugs smon gtad chog la bla slob lhan 'dzoms 'byung ba'i smon lam 'debs sogs 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan mang bo dang 'brel zhal bzhes yod pa ltar/a bu'i bu gsum pa phyag rdor skyabs kyi bu 'gyur med rdo je (kho ni gling ba'i dpon dbang rgyal gyis dus su nang 'khrugs byung ste yul gzhan du bskrad pa mdzod dge nyin mar bsdad/ rjes su gyod bshad nas phyir yong /kha cig gi sog po la yun ring bsdad de phyir yong rabs yang bshad/ ) dang thang bza' gnyis la rab byung bcu gsum pa lcags sbrel te (12 0 0 ) lor khā shu sku 'phreng dang bo'i lung bstan ltar khā shu sku 'phreng gnyis pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rnam rgyal 'khrungs/ byis pa de'i lus la lhan skyes kyi khra thig dang ya mtshar gyi ri mo mang bo dod 'dug pas yab yum sogs la ngo mtshar skyes nas grub thob mang bor zhus par gang zag khyad 'phags can zhig yin pa'i lung bstan thob/ bar skabs shig la dkar mo'i dgon — 32 —
thog nas khri chen sku 'phreng gnyis pas byis pa 'di ni mthu stobs nus pa'i dbang phyug khro rgyal mi g.yo ba'i rnam sprul du ngos 'dzin mdzad/ phyis su lha mo gser khri'i tshogs grwar zhugs/ sngon byis pa'i dus kyi khra thig dang ri mo sogs stag gi spu risari ltar du gyur nas khā shu grub chen stag sham can zhes mdo smad yul gru kun la snyan pa'i grags pa 'bar zhing dam pa'i chos kyis bu slob grangs las 'das pa bskyangs/ rnga ba'i khā shu dgon dang lha mo gser khri dgon pa'i ri khrod gnyis re mos kyis thugs skyong gnang ba dang khyad par gling ba'i chos srid thams cad la thugs khur bla med mdzad/ khong la khā shu'i su rug dang lha gur mchod gzhis srid sde sogs mang bo yod do/ /khā shu sku 'phreng gsum pa sog por 'khrungs pas khong dang lhan du sog ru mang bo yul 'dir yong zhing khā shu'i su rug dang mnyam du bsdad de khā shu sku 'phreng rim byon gyi sku rtsa gdung bdag dang mchod gzhis kyi nang mar gyur bas ru sde de la khā sog zhes ming 'di thogs/de ltar khā shu sku 'phreng rim byon gyis sde 'di la gzigs skyong gnang zhing khyad par du khā shu bla ma blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog gis sngon byon dam pa'i phyag srol ltar gling bar phebs bzhugs gnang skabs khā sog la phyag yul gyi 'du shes bzung ste — 33 —
thugs rtsis chen po byed pa dang gling ba smad mar sku dngos kyis lo rer rim gro dang / gter sgrub/ dbang lung bstsal ba sogs bka' drin shin tu che'o/ / cagangs dkar bu mo 'bum gyis yongs bskor ba'i/ /bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs kyi yul gru 'dir/ /mi dbang bye bas bstan srid spel ba'i mtha'/ /gtsug lag rtsisakyi drang srong yin yang rol/seng ge mjing bsnol btegs pa gser gyi khrir/ /stobs kyi 'khor los snyems pa a klum bus/ /sum gnyis sa yi khyon la dbang bsgyur bas/ /mtha' bzhi'i rgyal phran mang bos ngang gis btud/ /pho rtsal sna dgu 'dzoms pa gling gi rgyud/ /lugs gnyis bya par mkhas ba dga' yi rgyud/ /rigs rus mthon po'i brag la 'gying nyams kyis/ /dgra jag nam mkha'i pad mo'i grogs su phul/ /pha shul bu yi zin pa'i lo rgyus yod/ /nang gi phu nu dkrugs pa'i lo rgyus med/ /pha rol dgra mgo gnon tshe thogs las btsan/ /— 34 —
nang gi ru sder pha ma las kyang byams/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs rta'o/ /[5] stod ma'i dpon khrag gi lo rgyus/hu ra stod ma'i dpon thog ma ni a bkra yin/kho chung dus nas mi gzhan dang mi 'dra bar/ mthong ba tsam gyis ya mtshar skye zhing lhan skyes kyi bsod nams can zhig yin pa tshang mas gleng /kho rang lo bcu gsum steng du mdzod dge'i phyogs so sor rgya'i rta khral bsdu ba zhig yong ste dpon tshang dang 'brel ba byas/ dpon tshang la mgon po'i srung rta 'dogs dang kha lo med pa zhig yod par khul bsdu ba rnams 'dod pa skyes nas rta de nga tshos 'khyer dgos pa bshad/ rgya mi zhig gis zhon pa na thang la 'phangs te rdabs 'gram gyis rmas skyon byung nas phan tshun bar 'khon bslangs bar a bkra lo na chung rung khyod tshor rta rtsal ma yod pas rkyen red/ ngas zhon zer te zhon pas rta'i gshis ka ha cang bzang la 'dur rgyugs byas pas/ rgya mi tshang ma ya mtshar zhing mi dbang thang bsod nams can zhig yin pa shes nas rgya yul du khrid de rig gnas sbyangs/ lo — 35 —
shas 'gor rjes rgya mi 'gas skyel ma byas nas phyir rang yul la yong /phyir 'gro khar kho tshos a bkra ni shes rig ldan zhing thabs la mkhas pas mdzod dge shog bcu gnyis kyi spyi dpon byas na 'os shing 'tshams zhes bstod bsngags mang bo byas te tham ka dang bka' shog mang bo bstsal/ de nas khos dpon sa bzung ste ru sde byams kyis bskyangs shing rgyu 'bras dpang du bzhag kho paṇa chen rin po che dang mjal/ kun gzigs mchog gis gang zag dbang thang can zhig yin par gzigs te shel gyi ral gri khri gang tsam zhig gnang /chos rje ra ba tshang gis sku 'gag gnang ste dgra lha can khyod kyis 'di lus la chongs dang mi rabs bdun la mtshon 'gog thub sogs gsungs/ de ltar kho ni bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang bo'i thugs la 'bab pa'i mi rgyu 'bras can dang bstan srid la phan pa'i dbang thang bsod nams can zhig yin par tshang mas mgrin gcig tu gleng /kho'i ma shi pa'i gshin sngas su khri chen rgyal mtshan seng ge gdan drangs nas rgod ma brgyad cu sogs 'bul ba sbam mtho ba btegs kyang khri chen mchog gis 'bul ba ma blangs bar ngas dgon pa zhig 'debs rtsis byed bzhin yod pas khyod kyis sa sbyin na de — 36 —
jibas bzang gsungs par dga' bzhin dang blangs zhus/ sa stag ste ( 1748 ) lor dga' ldan khri chen nga gsum pas stag tshang lha mo'i gser khri dgon phyag 'debs gnang skabs dpon a bkras dgon gnas kyi sbyin bdag byas shing mkho chas sna tshogs dang grwa rgyun gyi thog ma bzhag pa sogs gser khri dgon pa'i lo rgyus dang bca' yig tu gsal/de ltar a bkras mdo smad kyi ljongs 'dir bstan srid kyi bya ba mang bo zhig bsgrubs pa mdzod dge rong 'brog kun nas gleng /khyad par lha mo gser khri dgon dang 'brel ba zab mo tshugs shing khri chen nyid nas shangs khrag gi bzhengs pa'i mgon po phyag drug pa'i thugs ka la gser gyi rdo rje chung ba zhig btags te bcol nan mdzad nas dpon tshang la khyim rten du gnang / (bcos bsgyur skabs su ru sman rgan tshang gis mgon po'i thang ga bdag gnyer byas/ bar skabs shig tu kho tshang la me 'jig byung bas mgon thang mes tshig kyang rdo rje lhad med lag son byung ste da lta dpon mkhan pa thar gyi lag tu yod/) dus de nas bzung dpon tshang gis lo rer mgon por khri bskang re 'don srol chags/khos bya ba gang byas mgon po la gsol ba rtse gcig tu — 37 —
btabs te bsgrubs pas mi tshe hril bor snyan grags rgyas shing dbang thang dar/ dgra jag sogs mi 'dod 'tshe ba'i gnod pas ma tshugs par tshe lo mthar phyin/ 'das mchod skabs su rgya khag nas kho'i 'dra sku zhig 'jim bzo byas nas phul ba sogs rgan kha shas kyis dngos su mthong ngo / /a bkra'i bu dpal mgon gyis hu ra stod ma'i chos srid lugs gnyis kyi bya ba legs par bskyangs shing phyogs yas mas su song ste sa bdag dang chu bdag byas nas 'khrugs rtsod cung tsam byung bar grags/paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes rgya phebs kyi dus su rje 'jigs med dbang bo tshang la/ sngon gling rje ge sar rgyal bos sa bzung ba'i yul/ mdzod dge phyogs de mi rabs du mar 'dug kyang da phan chad gang 'dra yong mi shes/ de'i sa gnad zin sa zhig tu dgon pa zhig thob ces bka' gnang ba thugs la bzung ste tsha gan be shing nas dgon pa 'debs rtsis mdzad kyang dpal mgon gyis sa ma phul ba sogs 〈 mdo smad chos 'byung 〉 du gsal/ dpal mgon gyi rang sa gzhan la shor na mi legs snyam te ngo chen dang yar zhu gang byas kyang ma byin/— 38 —
de nas rje 'jigs me dbang bos brag lung gong mar gnas gzigs kyis sa brtag bslang ba dang bkra shis gso sbyong mdzad/lcags byi lo ( 178 0 ) lor 'du khang bzhengs te be shing dgon btabs/dpon a bkra'i ring nas lha mo gser khri dgon dang chos 'brel dam zab yod la dgon gnas kyi sbyin bdag bcas yin stabs dpon tshang dpal mgon gyis yul khams 'di la'ang chos sde zhig tshugs na bzang snyam te khri chen sku 'phreng gnyis pa'i zhabs la gtugs nas gling ba'i ser sde dngos su tshugs/ khri chen rgyal mtshan seng ge mchog gi dbu gdugs dang mgon po'i snang brnyan byin can/ tshogs dung zung gcig sogs rten gsum du ma gnang zhing dge tshul slong dang dge bsnyen bcu phrag kha shas kyi tshogs 'gor phebs te gsang sngags sgrub sde gsar ba 'di'i khrod na phyag rdor gos sngon can gyi sprul ba re yod gsungs pa dnge rim gyis dar rgyas su song tshul 〈 ri bong dgon bkra shis byang chub chos 'phel gling gi gdan rabs bshad sgrub bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan 〉 du gsal bas 'dir ched du ngal ba ma byas so/ /la mo zhabs drung dkar po'i ja thab steng paṇa chen rin po che — 39 —
phebs bzhugs mdzad skabs/ dpal mgon gyis rta ba nyis brgya tsam khrid de rta dngul gyi 'bul ba sbam mtho ba btegs pas mdzod dge'i phyogs der gtong phod can gyi dpon bzang bo zhes snyan pa rgyas tshul 〈 mdo smad chos 'byung 〉ru'ang gsal/ de ltar tshogs bsags mang bo byas pas/ dpal mgon gyi rgyud la bcos min nges 'byung dang sngar byas las la 'gyod sems skyes te/ de sngar ngas kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo tshang la dgon sa ma phul/da skabs lo na mthon por slebs tshe 'gyod sems che bas khyed tshos kun mkhyen mchog la zhus te dgon pa gang du 'debs na 'debs su chugs/ ces kha chems bzhag ste tshe las 'das/ de nas bsod rdor ( a rnam gyi bu bsod rnams dang de'i bu rdo rdze bkra shis gnyis la zer/ )’dang yum skyabs ( a bu'i bu klu 'bum thar gyi bu chung ba ) bla ma ( yum skyabs kyi phu bo ) sogs kyis khur len byas te/ brag lung nas dgon pa be shing du spos/ / paṇa chen thams can mkhyen pas bka' gnang ba ltar/ kun mkhyen mchog dang khri chen zam tsha sprul sku rnam gnyis nas gnas gzigs mdzad cing shis brjod gnang /gzim khang / grwa khang bcas bkod khyab zhib par bstsal te 'chad nyan spel gsum gyi bya ba la gzhol nas legs 'grub byung tshul 〈wawa 40 wawa
mdo smad chos 'byung 〉 du gsal/dpal mgon gyi bu lha kho'am mdzod lha yin la/ dpal mgon 'chi khar kho la dpon sa sprad/ lha khos dpon sa bzung nas yun ring tsam 'gor rjes nyin ma dang gling ba ru sde gnyis kyi bar la jag rkun gyis 'tshe ba mang bo byung / khos chos rje ra ba zer ba'i grub thob pa de gdan drang ca te gzhi bdag drag rtsal can gser sku bstod du bcugs/dgra rkun gyi ngo lon du dgra mnan bzhag dbang mtsher zer pa'i thang chen du hu ra stod ma gtsor byas kyi chos dad mang tshogs la tshe dbang sogs zab rgyas chos kyis tshim par mdzad/chos rje ra ba tshang la dbang yon du gzhi mo brgyad cu phul/ dus de nas chos rje sgar du gling pa'i dpon khrag la gdan dang / smon lam gyi skabs gling ba la ched du 'dug gnas yod bar grags/ lha mo'i gser khri dgon par yang zhabs tog gang legs sgrubs/ khri chen rin po che'i lung bstan bzhin lo rer gdugs dkar khri rdzogs re bsgrubs pas grub rtags mang bo thon/ de nas zla ba re la'ang gdugs dkar khri rdzogs re bsgrubs pa'i byin rlabs kyis ru sde la mi 'dod pa'i rkyen ngan bar chud gang yang ma byung bar yul khams la — 41 —
bkra shis bde skyed kyis khyab pa byung / dpon lha kho mi tshe ring bor ma bsdad par tshe las 'das pas yud tsam la dpon sa rgan po'am tsho mi spyis mnyam skyong byas par grags so/ /lha kho'i bu mdzod bkra'am a bkra yin/ kho'i pha 'chi snga bas lo bcu gsum steng du dpon tshang gi chos srid khrims srol thams cad skyong dgos byung / yin yang kho chung dus nas rnam dpyod 'bar zhing ngag rtsal gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i khyad chos can zhig yin/ rang lo bcu gsum steng nas dmag sna khrid de lha sde dngul rwa dang 'thab pas lha sde'i 'go ba smug res sogs bsad/ 'bos dang zam tsha gnyis dpung bsgrigs byas te gling ba'i hu ra stod la 'thab tshe/ mdzod bkra'i dmag thabs kyis kho tsho pham par bzos nas g.yul las rgyal te snyan grags phyogs kun khyab/ khos skad cha bshad skabs su/ 66 nga mi ngan rung smug po'i gdung rgyud yin/chu ngan rung rma chu'i chu lag yin/ nged gling ba'i dmag tshogs skar ma thang la bkram 'dra 'dis/ sngon lha sde dngul rwa la 'thab skabs 'go ba smug res bsad de 'brong bre ser gyi rwa dar rtsa nas bcad ni/dbal ban khro kho dang 'thab tshe stag smyon rdo ril bsad de stag dmar yag gi mche ba rtsa nas rdzogs ni/ btsan por ngo ya byas — 42 —
myong/ lci mor do ya byas myong nyag sogs 'jig rten gyi gtam dpe mang bo gsar gtod byas/ khos thang bza' dang khā bza' gnyis blangs kyang khā bza' la rigs rgyud ma yod/ thang bza' la yod/mdzod bkrar ngag rtsal ha cang che bas/ mdzod dge shog khag gi gyod che chung mang bo 'dum 'grig byas shing phyogs yas mas su phan mi nyung ba thogs par bshad/ bo rang gis chos srid gnyis kyi cha nas byas rjes mi dman pa bzhag ste bu tshe dpag skyabs la dpon sa sprad/tshe dpag skyabs kyi bsam par gtso bo chos gnyer na 'di phyi'i legs tshogs kyi gnad dam pa red snyam te gling ba spyi'i tshab byas nas kirti blo bzang 'phrin las mchog zla brgyad pa'i nang du yul 'dir gdan drangs te tshibs bsu dang bcas pho rog thang du bzhugs sgar btabs/ dkyil 'khor gyi gnas la gzigs nas stegs bu bzo ru bcugs/ zla brgyad pa'i tshes drug la sa chog gi dbu brtsams/ tshes dgur ser mang gis zhus ngor/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid dang / ( mi tra'i nang tshan thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi ba lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang gnang / ) tshes bcu bzhi nas sta gon byas te gling ba dgon grong la dus 'khor dbang mo che bskur/ gsung — 43 —
bshad kyi 'phros la/ sngar dus 'khor dbang bka' re gang du bgyis par dus 'khor rgyas bsdus ci rigs re tshugs yod pa bzhin phyogs 'dir yang ser mang gzhung nas sngon du 'jam dpal dgongs rgyan re tsam dang / rim gyis cho ga rgyas se re e tshugs blta dgos tshul/ yul khams so so nas rkun jag gi khrims bsdams dgos tshul/ thams cad kyis ma ṇi smyung gnas tshe thar ci mang khas blangs te grangs phul na de mthun bsngo smon gnang rgyu yin tshul/ lhag par rong 'brog rnams nas 'phyi ba mang du gsod pa mi legs tshul sogs gsungs/ thams cad dad gus kyis dang blangs byas te shog ka so so nas grangs phul bar/ ma ṇi dung phyur kha shas/ smyung gnas sum khri/ tshe thar lnga stong lhag byung zhing /dbang nyan pa phal cher nas bro lug re yod pa'ang tshe thar du phul/phyin chad yul khams de dag nas 'phyi ba mi gsod pa dang / rgyun par ma ṇi smyung gnas/ tshe thar mang bo byed rgyu'i rgyun btsugs pa dang / tha na tsig tshang mi bshigs pa sogs dam bcas te gzhan gnod las log pa'i srol bzang bo gtan chags pa byung / tshes bco brgyad la tshogs 'khor rgyas pa gnang gling ba'i dpon 'bangs nas dngul rdo tshad lnga bcur nye ba sogs dngos 'bul gtos che ba — 44 —
dang / na khri ba ma nges mtha' yas tshang nas brtan bzhugs kyi bshad pa rgyas bar zhus pa la dgyes pa'i zhal bzhes dang bka' lan yid 'phrog pa gnang ste thams cad dga' bdes tshim bar gyur/ ( de dus kirti'i sgar sar gyi tsho ba chags/ sa gling ba'i yin pas lo rer rta sar re dang phrugs bam re sa rin la sbyin dgos/ phyis su gling ba'i bstan chung zer ba kirti'i sgar sar du mag pa la bsdad/ kho rang gling ba yin pas nye byas stabs dus de nas sa rin byin mi dgos pa rgan po mang bo zhig gi ngag las thos)bzhugs khri'i shul du kirti tshang gi sman sku zhig bzhengs/dkyil 'khor gyi shul du rde'u 'bum btsugs/ phyis su de'i ming la bkra shis mchod rten thang zer/bzhag ldom gyi dpon rnam rgyal bkra shis kyi bu chos skyabs kyi bu mo 'jig 'tsho gser khri'i dbon po'i chung ma yin kyang kho lo na bgres stabs dpon mdzod tshe la chung mar byin/ phyis su a skyid 'go bza' zhig kyang blangs / rigs rgyud kyi don du sku rim mang bo sgrubs kyang chung ma gnyis la bu ma 'khrungs/ mdzod tshes dpon rabs gong ma rnams bzhin lha mo gser khri dgon gyi spyin bdag gi gtso bo byas/ khos sems can kun la phan pa'i dge ba chen po — 45 —
zhis bsgrub 'dun che tshul dze khri chen tshang la zhus pas/ khri chen rin po che'i zhal nas/ deng snyigs dus su sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i snyigs ma'i mgon po bde gshegs bdun te sman bla'i mdo chog gtsor bzhugs kyi lag 'khor zhig gi dpar brkos na 'gro ba la phan thogs pa'i bka' bstsal/ mdzod tshes man tan gyis khri rin po che la 'khor lo'i dkar chag gsung dgos pa'i gsol ba btabs pa bzhin zhal bzhes gnang ste gtso bor sman bla'i mdo chog mtshan bdun bdun dang bcas pa/ bskal bzang rgyan 'phreng /byams smon/ bzang spyod/ mna' bshags/ sdig bshags sogs gzungs sngags zab mo rnam grangs sum cu lha ga gzhugs pa'i 'khor lo'i dpar zhig brko ba'i zhal bkod gnang ste/ lha mo gser khri dgon nas dge bshes dang drung yig mang bo mngags pas legs 'grub byung / phyogs yas mas su 'grem spel byas pas bstod bsngags kyi me tog 'thor/mdo smad 'dir gling ba'i dpon tshang gi rta 'khor zhes yongs su grags pa'o/ / ( 'khor lo 'di'i dpar deng sang yang bzhugs la phyogs yas mas su 'grem spel byed bzhin yod/ ) dpon mdzod tshe lo na rgas te rigs rgyud med pa shes nas — 46 —
'jig 'tsho'i tsha bu a byang ngam byang chub bu skal du blangs/ (a byang ni bzhag ldom dpon po chos skyabs la bu bu mo gsum yod pas che ba rta mgrin mgon po'i bu yin ) byang chub bam mdzod byang gis byams bza' bkra shis skyed chung mar blangs pas bu mkhan pa thar dang / rta mgrin skyed/ bod gces bcas ming sring gsum yod/ mdzod byang gis hu ra stod ma'i tsho dpon byas nas khri chen rwa lo'i skye ming du grags pa khri chen sku 'phreng bzhi ba gdan drangs te gling ba spyi la rim gro bsgrubs/ skabs der rgya dmag mdzod dge'i sa phyogs la thon pas 'khrugs rtsod mang bo byas/ mdzod dge shog bcu gronyis kyis g.yul bshams te rgya dmag dang 'thab/ khri chen rin po ches rnamdzod byang gi ru dmag la rab gnas dang dgra lha dpung bstod/rlung rta yar bskyed kyi cho ga sogs sgrub nas g.yul tu chas/ mdzod byang gis dmag la nyes skyon ma byung bar bde legs ngang g.yul las rgyal/ de nas yun rang ma 'gor bar bcos bsgyur dang phrad pas/khos rgyal khab la mthun sgril dang / mang tshogs la slob gso gang mang btangs pas gling ba'i mang tshogs mang shas la zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob/ kho ( 1958 ) lo 'dzin bzung byas nas lo gcig tsam la khrims khang du 'dug dgos byung / phyis su rgyal khab kyis — 47 —
kho rang ni mes rgyal la dga' zhen dang / mi dmangs la sha tsha ba'i mi bzang po zhig yin pa shes te khrims khang nas btson grol thob pa ma zad mdzod dge rdzong chab srid gros mos tshogs pa'i tshogs mi la bdams/ lo 'ga'i rjes su rnga ba khul chab srid gros mol tshogs pa'i rgyun las u yon lhan khang du lo gsum tsam la bya ba byas mthar tshe las 'das so/da lta hu ra stod ma'i dpon shul du mdzod byang gi bu mkhan pa thar yod la/ spyi lo ( 1952 ) lor dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur byas rjes rnga ba khul dmag yan lag sa khul gyi phyugs gnyer 'brog ra zhig gsar 'dzug byed dgos pa'i bka' rim pa gong nas phabs tshe/ gling ba stod smad bar gsum nas phyug bdag gral rim khyim tshang nyi shu tsam logs su bkar/ dus dbang gis mkhan pa thar gyi khyim gzhi yang der 'gro dgos byung / khos byams me'i dpon bla'i tsha mo byams bza' bsod nams sgrol ma chung mar blangs/ (196 0 ) lo nas 192 2bar du rnga ba khul dmag yan lag sa khul gyi phyugs gnyer 'brog ra'i gzhung gi las ka sna tshogs kyi nang la zhugs/ ( 192 2 ) lo nas phyugs las kyi gtso 'gan khur zhing kung khran tang nang la'ang zhugs/ rim bzhin khrang tang kri pu'u — 48 —
hru'u ci gzhon pa dang mdzod dge rdzong mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi 'thus mi bcas kyi 'gan khur/ mkhan pa thar gyis nam yang mi rigs rang gi rig gnas dang goms srol la dga' zhen dang / chos lugs dad mos rang dbang gi srid jus gtsug tu bzung nas mes po gong ma'i phyag srol bzhin pha yul mi dmangs la bsam pa dkar bo'i sgo nas phyi rabs byis pa slob grwar mngags rgyu dang dgon ru sde tshang mas mthun sgril legs po byed dgos pa'i skul ma rgyun du byas/ lha mo gser khri dgon gyi 'du khang bskyar bzhengs byed skabs mes po gong ma nas brgyud pa'i chos 'brel la bsam te mang tshogs la skul slong btang nas gling ba ru sde lngas sgor khri nyi shu lhag zhal 'debs su phul/ yang ri bong dgon gyi tshogs chen 'du khang dang sku gsung thugs rten mang bo gsar skrun byed skabs/khos gling ba stod smad par gsum dang mo khrang sogs la skul slong gang thub byas nas dge pa'i las 'gan mang bo khur/ dgon pas kyang kho ni pha shul bu yis zin pa'i dpon bzang bo zhig red zer nas bkur bzos chen po'i ngang 'du khang dga' ston du gdan drangs te thub ba bcom ldan 'das kyi gser sku byin can zhig khyim rten du gnang / hu ra stod ma'i 'go 'dren dang sku tshab/ che ba — 49 —
rgan bgres sogs skul slong dang khri chen lnga ba chen po la zhus te ser mang 'dus sde nyams gso byed thub pa byung / sngon gling ba dpon rabs dang khri chen khri rabs bar la chos 'brel yon mchod kyi 'brel ba la bsam nas khri chen lnga ba chen mor zhus te gnyan sras kyi lab rtse bstod/ dus 'gyur chen po'i zhal zas su gyur ba'i tshe 'das ci yod la dge sgrub dang tshe ldan rnams kyi tshe bsod longs spyod 'phel phyir/ khri chen rin po che gtsor bzhugs kyis kun rig gi dbang dang / bskang gso rgyas pa/ rta mgrin/ seng gdong dgra lha dpung bstod sogs nyin bdun la bsgrubs/ de nas bzung lo rer gong gi sku rim rnams bsgrub pa'i srol gsar ba tshugs so/ /da lta gling ba dgon grong tshang mas kho la re ba chen po bcangs yod la khos kyang phyogs ris med par dgon grong drug la gang thub ci thub gyis nas pa 'don bzhin yod do/ /lhan skyes bsod nams gzi byin rab 'bar bas/ /ma hā tsi na'i mi chen yid sems bkug/sna mang rig pa'i gzhung la blo rtsal rgyas/ /shog chen bcu gnyis dpon por a bkra mdzes / /gdong lnga'i dbang bos gad rgyangs ma bsgrags kyang / /— 50 —
ri skyes gang yin ngang gis dul ba bzhin/ /sde bzhi'i dpal gyis mtho ba'i mi dbang mchog/ma bskul 'bangs mi phye ba'i gtsug tu bkur/ /na tshod khyung phrug gshog rtsal ma rdzogs kyang / /dmag 'thab brgyad cu'i las la shin tu mkhas/ /dngul rwa'i bre ser 'brong gi rwa dar bcad/ /khro kho'i dmar yag stag gi mche ba blangs/ /bu dang tsha bor ngag rtsal glog zhags 'khyug/rang rigs don du gces pa'i srog kyang gtong / /dpon rabs rim byon mdzad rjes rdo ring che/ /mdzod dge'i gling dkar stod na brtan por btsugs / /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /[6 ] bar ma'i dpon khas gi lo rgyus/dpon a klum gyi bu che ba bkra shis rnam rgyal stod smad gnyis kyi bar nas bsdad pas hu ra bar ma zer/khos ru sde de'i 'go 'dzin byas nas chos srid thams cad hu ra stod smad gnyis dang bstun pa'i sgo nas legs par bskyangs/'bangs mi ru sde las rig rgod dang thabs shes che ba sogs ya — 51 —
rabs kyi mi mang bo byung bar grags/ kho la rigs rgyud du bu zhig yod na phyi rabs rgyun 'dzin la bzang bar snyam ste bla ma dam pa mang bor zhus pas/ lung bstan du 82 khyod rang gi rigs las mched pa'i bu zhig yod na bzang mod kyang / gang ltar khyod kyis tshad ldan gyi lha bzo zhig la rlung rta'i dar bo che lha grangs tshang ba zhig bzhings su bcugs nas mchod bkur byos dang ru sde la dar ngo che〉〉 zer/ dpon bkra rnam gyis lung bstan ltar thang ga bzhengs nas hu ra bar ma'i dpon tshang gi khyim rten byas/ de nas kho la bu mo bkra shis skyid skyes/ bu mo de cher skyes pa na mdzod dge bzod pa zhes ba'i snyan grags can gyi pho rgod cig yod pa dpon tshang gi mag par bzhag bu mo bkra shis skyid dang mdzod dge bzod pa gnyis la me sbrul lor kirti kun dga' chos 'phags thub bstan nyi ma 'khrungs/ de rjes yab yum gnyis dang bcas rong bo la ru song /( kirti'i rnam thar na hu ra bar ma nas 'khrungs pa'i skor gsungs med kyang 〈mdo smad chos 'byung snya dang lo rgyus gzhan na dpon bkra rnam gyi bu mo bkra shis skyid dang mdzod dge bzod pa gnyis la 'khrungs tshul bshad pas 'di dag gong bsgrigs na khrigs se 'dug go/ )bar skabs shig tu hu ra bar mar chung ba dar shi byed pa'i sri — 52 —
kha ngan pa zhig byung bas/ dpon bkra rnam kyis khā shu sog bla tshang la zhus bas khong gi rta mgrin rde'u 'bum zhig sri mnan du bzhag pa dang rgya nag pa sku dngos kyis slob dpon snang srid zil gnon gyi si'u thang cig phyag bzo gnang ste tshwa khang zhig bzhengs/ dus de nas bzung ru sdes sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku brnyan 'bum re bzhengs pa'i srol tshugs shing sri kha ngan pa de rtsa ba nas chod song bar grags/ da lta yang tshwa tshwa'i sgur zhes grags pa de yin no/dpon bkra rnam gyis sa skya'i dbon po'i chung ma btsan 'phrog byas pas shog kha gnyis kyi bar la 'thab 'dzing drag po zhig langs pa dang sa skya'i dbon pos 'khon lan du hu ra bar ma'i rta zog mang bo 'phrog bcom byas pa na/ dpon bkra rnam gyis dmag dpung khrid de ra mda' la song bas rjes chod/ 'thab 'dzing yun ring byas mthar sa skya'i dbon po bsad cing ru dmag mang bo jag nyesasu btang nas pham par bzos/ phyis su sa skya'i dbon po'i khyim tshang gis dpon bkra rnam tshang la lkog tu mnan pa bzhag pas dka' ngal mang bo zhig dang phrad/dpon bkra rnam gyis khā shu blo bzang ngag dbang dge legs tshang gi zhabs la gtugs nas kho la gzhi bdag myur mgyogs can — 53 —
zhig bstod na 'dod pa che tshul snyan gsan du phul ba na/ khong thugs dgyes nyams chen pos khā shu sku thog dang bo dpon slob rin po che ngag dbang phun tshogs dbus 'gyur chos kyi zhing khams nas phyir phebs skabs 'bri chu'i tshun la bsu mar yong ba'i gzhi bdag khrag mtho de brag ra yin pas mdzod dge phyogs su 'di drag rtsal che ba'i gzhi bdag yin/ ngas khyed rnams la 'di bstod na chog gsungs nas ( gnyan rgod yid bzhin gyi nor bu ) zhes mtshan gsol gnang zhing bsang yig zhig kyang ljags rtsom gnang / dus de nas hu ra bar mas 66 gnyan rgod yid bzhin nor bu 〉〉 chags me du mchod bstod byas pas/ sa skya'i btsan 'dzul dang mthu byad kyi gnod pa la ngo lon byung zer/dpon bkra rnam gyis rang gi ru sde byams skyong gang legs gnang zhing / rigs rgyud 'phel zhing chung sri'i gnod pa las bzlog pa'i phyir bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang bo'i 'bas la gtugs nas tshogs bsags rgya cher byas/ kho'i ring la ru sde ba'i mdza' mthun dang nang phu nu'i 'brel ba sogs cha thams cad du bkra legs po 'grig pas hu ra stod smad gnyis kyis kyang yi rangs shor sa zhig yin par gleng / kho rang lo na rgas shing rigs rgyud kyi bu — 54 —
yang ma yod par 'du ba bshed du babs te tshe las 'das / ( hu ra bar ma'i dpon tshang la dpon a klum gyi rgyud pa dus de nas chad song zer/ )dpon bkra rnam shi rjes hu ra stod ma'i dpon tshang gi rnam rdor spun gnyis nang ma mthun par rnam rdor ru nag tu rtsis te yul skrad/bar skabs shig la ru nag khyim kha mdun/ hu ra bar ma nas bsdad pas kho tshor go thob chen po yod pa ma zad dpya khral dang tshegs khrims sogs med par btsan shed kyis bsdad pa dang hu ra stod ma'i dpon tshang gi khyim nas sgor 'bud skabs rten gsum rgyu nom sogs bgo bsha' byas tshe khri chen gnyis pa'i dbu zhwa dang gdugs dkar gyi lag 'khor/ phyag rdor 'khor chen/ gcod pa dung bris sogs khri chen sku dngos kyis gnang ba'i rten gsum grangs las 'das pa bgo skal du thob po/ / ( rten de rnams bcos bsgyur skabs su chag skyon ma byung bar da skabs yang dad rten du bzhugs yod/ )bar skabs shig nas bar ma'i dpon po bar 'jigs zer ba yin la/ spyir na lo rgyus dang ngag rgyun thams cad du gling ba ni gling gi sde lhag yin pa dang khyad par tsha zhang 'dan ma'i ru dmag gi lhag ma yin slad gling ba 'di nas 'bangs mi phal ba ste tsha zhang dar — 55 —
bar grags/ dpon bar 'jigs ni dpa' rtsal sna dgu tshang zhing 'gran rtsod zla med kyi dpa' rgod zhig yin phyir sus kyang bsko bzhag ma byas bar rang shugs kyi tsho dpon du gyur song ba yin pa 'dra/ (spyan ldan gyi lo rgyus smra ma rnams kyis da rung dpyad pa mang du gtong dgos )gang ltar bar 'jigs kyis hu ra bar ma'i dpon tshang gi chos srid khrims srol thams cad bdag skyong bzang bo byas shing sngon dpon bkra rnam gyis khyim rten rlung rta'i dar bo che byin can la mchod bkur byas pas dbang thang ches cher dar/ de dus hu ra bar ma la bu stag 'dra ba mang bo skyes par grags/ khos ru sde'i dpa' rgod mang bo la 'go 'dzin dang nyam chung can la gnya' gnon med par tshang ma 'grig mthun gyi lag gdang sprel pa'i ngang bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba skyel du bcugs/ kho'i ring la hu ra bar ma'i gser rin chen don grub tshang la rnam grol sku 'phreng dang bo blo bzang rnam grol rgya mtsho zhes pa 'khrungs/ byams me 'bras spungs thos bsam rnam rgyal gling du gzhung bka' pod lnga sogs la thos bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad pas mkhas pa'i mtshan blangs/ dgung grangs don lnga'i skabs su dgongs pa rdzogs so/ /( rnam grol sku 'phreng gsum pa rje blo bzang rnam grol 'phrin las rgya mtsho — 56 —
mchog gis sngon byon sku 'phreng dang bo'i 'khrungs yul 'di la thugs rtsis chen po gnang ste/ sde gzhung la dus srung mdzad pa dang / gter sgrub pa/nyam thag nad pa mang bo la sman gnang ba sogs kyi gzigs skyong gnang / spyi lo ( 1991 ) lor mang tshogs kyis skul dor sku 'bum bcu phrag kha shas bzhugs pa'i tshwa khang zhig gsar bskrun mdzad/ legs 'grub byung nas rab gnas mdzad skabs char babs pa dang/ 'ja' shar ba sogs dge ltas mang bo byung / )dpon bar 'jigs kyi dus su stag shar dpa' bo skyes shing skyes chen bla ma 'khrungs pa sogs yul khams la bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel 'dzoms/ kho'i bu mo tshe ring sgrol ma la mag par ngag bsod bzhag ste gnyen ston rgya cher bstar/ de nas yun ring ma bsdad par bar 'jigs tshe las 'das so/ /dpon bar 'jigs kyi bumo tshe ring sgrol ma dang ngag bsod gnyis la bu bu mo lnga yod pa las bu che ba bar 'jam la hu ra bar cima'i dpon tshang gi dbang thob thang thams cad sprad/ kho rang ni lhan skyes kyi gshis ka bzang la chos dad can zhig yin pas/ sde gzhung la ma ṇi tshogs pa'i srol tshugs/ rnga ba'i dme rgyal bo dang mna' mthun bsgrigs/ kho'i ru sde'i nang la g.yas khog gi tsho ba nas g.yas pa a liṃ zer ba yong ste khyim gzhi chags ( deng sang gi — 57 —
g.yas rgan tshang zer ba de yin ) a li re zhig gza' dge nas 'dug dgos byung / de'i stabs kyis g.yas ba khyim tshang dang gza' dge la phar 'gro tshur yong gi 'brel ba yod pas dpon bar 'jam gyis gza' dge sde ba dang hu ra bar ma sde ba gnyis kyi bar la mna' bzhag ste rong 'brog mnyam 'brel dang skyid sdug mnyam khur byas pas phan grogs su gyur ( gza' dge dang 'brel pa deng sangs nyams med la lo lnga re'i mtshams nas mna' kha gso ba'i srol yod do/ / )dpon bar 'jam kyi ring la bar ma'i nag tshang gi a dpal zer ba dang tshe ring sgrol ma bya ba gnyis la ngo mtshar ltas bzang dang bcas te byis pa zhig skyes/ skyes ma thag tu ngu ngag sogs byis pa —riphal ba'i las dang mi 'dra bar tsog pur 'dug shing lte ba stod du dkris ba sogs dam pa'i rang gshis mngon du gyur/ nar son pa na dpal stag tshang lha mo dga' ldan bshad sgrub pad dkar grol ba'i chos grwar zhugs/ tshad ldan gyi bshes gnyen du ma bsten nas mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob/ khri chen rin po ches nag tshang sprul sku zhes gser khri'i bla ma 'bring khrag gi go gnas bstsal/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las rab tu rgyas te nang chen su rug sogs yod kyang yun ring ma bzhugs par zhi bar gshegs/ bar ma'i bsod nams tshe — 58 —
ring dang bad kho gnyis la nag tshang bla ma'i yang sprul 'khrungs/dgung lo brgyad kyi steng du lha mo gser khri'i tshogs la zhugs/ shing bza' bskal bzang chos kyi rgya(la mtshan dang mnyam du a lags sman pa tshang zhes bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas spyi dang khyad par gso rig gi gzhung la mkhyen dpyod yangs ba bshes gnyen du bsten/ blo bzang bstan pa rgya mtsho zhes mtshan gsol gnang / bar skabs shig la yongs 'dzin gyis 66 khyed sprul sku rnam gnyis kyi bzhes phor cig shos la gas skyon byung 'dug pas thugs nyams 'jog dgos hagsungs/ yun ring ma 'gor bar nag tshang sprul skus rten skya bo'i rtul zhugs 'dzin dgos byung / de nas tshang mas sprul log zhes ngan smras dang log lta skye ba'i yul du bzhag lung dang rigs pa'i mnga' bdag mkhas grub gnyis mdzoms kyi bshes gnyen dam pa shing bza' bskal bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog gling ba la phebs nas dbang lung mang bo gnang skabs/ nag tshang sprul sku'am sprul log gis phyag dbang zhus par/ phyag dbang ma gnang bar dbu thug gnang ste mang tshogs la/ 'di gang zag khyad 'phags shig yin kyang tshur mthong sems ca na gyi snang ngor rten skya bo'i tshul 'dzin dgos pa dus dbang gis red/ phyis su khyed ru sde dang nye 'brel — 59 —
sogs nas khong gi yang sprul rtsad gcod byos dang yang sprul 'khrul bral zhig 'khrungs nges yin sogs lung bstan bstsal/ de nas tshang ma la yid ches kyi dad pa thob kyang yun ring ma bzhugs par ngo mtshar ltas bzang du ma dang bcas te zhi bar gshegs/ /dpon bar 'jam gyi dus su gzhan la mna' mthun sgrig pa dang nang gi phu nu skyong ba sogs chos mthun srid skyong bzang bo gnang / kho la bu dpal rgod dang bar tshe zhes ba'i bu gnyis skyes/bar tshe la khos dpon sa sprad/ bar 'jam pha bu gnyis ka dus 'gyur gyi skabs su 'dzin bzung byas/ bar 'jam lo na rgas la rnam 'gyur bzang bas rgyal khab kyis kho la lta tshul yag po bzung ste 'go 'dzin pa zhig gi ming bstsal kyang / khos 66 nga rang rgya zas ma zos bas pho ba gtsang ma dang / rgya gos ma gyon bas lus po gtsang ma yin ga zer nas kha bral rgyab 'gal gyi mkhregs gtam mang bo bshad/ cang ma 'gor bar khrims khang du tshe las 'das/ bar tshe yang mi ngan pa nag nyes can du rtsis te dmar gsod btang /da lta bar ma la dpon shul tu dpal rgod kyi bu paṇa chen skyabs dang khyi kho dang bkra kho bu spun gnyis sogs rigs rgyud yod/ da lta dpal rgod kyi bu paṇa chen skyabs la sngon gyi pha shul tu yod pa kho rang — 60 —
yin la/ spyi tshogs 'di'i nang du 'tshar longs byung ba yin/bar ma'i dpon tshang gi thob thang khrims srol sogs 'dzin khom ma yod par bcos bsgyur byas/ yin yang mes po gong ma'i shul tu lus pa ni kho rang yin/66 phan pa chung rung bsam pa dang / me tog chung rung mchod rdzas ltar ru sde la sha tsha spyi bsdus kyi yar bsam bzung ste nus ba ci yod kyis rogs skyor byas/ mang tshogs kyis kyang kho la re bzhag chen po bcangs te ru chen gyi 'go 'dren la bzhag khos lo mang bo'i ring la las 'gan khur nas mang tshogs la zhabs 'degs gang nus bsgrubs/ tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i dgongs don lag ltar byas nas chos lugs dad mos rang dbang gi srid jus shar ba na lha sde zhal 'dzoms te rang dgon gyi gtsug lag khang thams cad skyar bzhengs byas pas legs 'grub kyi dga' ston skabs su kho rang bar mi'i dpon shul yin phyir thub pa'i snang brnyan gser las grub pa'i byin can zhig rten skal du gnang / da skabs ru sde'i skyid sdug gang yin gyi nang la zhugs nas sbyi phan la nus pa 'don bzhin pa'o/ /gakra shis dge mtshan bzhad pa'i sman ljongs su/ /— 61 —
'tshe bral ru sde zhi bde'i bdud rtsir rol/ /phyogs las rna ma par rnal ba'i mi dbang mchog/stobs kyi 'khor lo'i khri la brtan cing brjid/ /mi rigs gzhan gyi 'og na gnya' mi sgur/ /thob dang tham ba'i ched du 'khon mi slong / /ma bcos gshis rgyud 'jam pa'i ru sde la/ /bde skyed rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dga' ston byin/ /pha la bu skye 'jigs rten rang gshis te/ /pha shul bu yis zin pa khyed nyid tsam/pha dang mes po'i lugs bzang skyong phyir dang /pha yul mi dmangs ched du yod tshad phul/ /'khor 'bangs longs spyod yar tshes zla bar 'gran/ /nang mi phu nu'i mthun sgril mtsho las zab/dus rabs gsar ba'i cong sgra snyan mo yis/ /gdod ma'i gnyid las dkrogs te mdun du skyod/ /ces pa'ang bar skabs smyu gu'i rol rtsed las byung ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /[ 7 ] zhar phyung 'phel rgyas 'gro bzhin pa gling ba — 62 —
dgon grong gi rnam pa/dus rabs gsar ba'i skya rengs kyi 'dzum mdangs gsal ba dang chabs cig phyogs ris med kyi yul gru kun tu sngar med kyi 'pho 'gyur gnam sa bla 'og bsgyur ba bzhin byung bas mdzod dge rdzong gling ba 'ang dang rnga ba khul phyugs gnyer 'brog ra sogs kyang rjes lus kyi mun nag las bud de nam yang mdun nas mdun du skyod bzhin pa lags te/ lo rabs drug cu ba'i nang du gling ba zhang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang zhang 'phrod bsten sman khang / yid brtan mnyam las khang / phyugs nad sman bcos sa tshigs/mkho sprod mnyam las khang zhang lte ba'i slob grwa khang sogs rim par btsugs nas rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi 'go 'dren byas te mi rigs mthun sgril dang phyugs 'gyur gyi lam la brtson dgos pa sogs kyi slob gso mang du btang bas char rjes kyi myu gu bzhin phyogs thams cad nas 'phel rgyas byung / tshan rig dang mthun pa'i sgo nas phyugs rigs 'tsho skyong byas ba las gzhan/ rang sger gyi sna 'dzoms tshong khang lnga dang / sger btsugs brnyan 'phrin khang /sger gnyer gsol ja khang sogs btsugs te deng rabs kyi rnam pa gsar ba mtho sgang du slebs/ bu phrug slob grwar mi skyel ba'i lo — 63 —
rgyus mjug rdzogs te da lta gling ba zhang lte ba'i slob chung du dngos yod slob ma bdun cu lhag gis rgya bod zung 'brel gyi yig rigs slob te ma 'ongs gangs ljongs gsar ba bskrun pa'i dpung khrag cig bskyed sring byed bzhin yod/ zhang 'phrod bsten sman khang dang phyugs nad sman bcos khang gnyis kyis kyang nyin mtshan g.yel med du mtho sgang mi dmangs la zhabs phyi gang legs bsgrubs pas bsngags brjod kyi me tog yang yang thob/ gling ba zhang la stod ma ru chen/ smad ma ru chen/ bar ma ru chen/ mtha' ba ru chen bcas ru chen bzhi ru phyes yod/ stod ma ru chen la da lta dud khyim brgya dang don brgyad dang mi grangs dgu brgya lhag yod thams cad las la brtson zhing gzhung drang ba / ngag rtsal la mkhas shing spyi sems che ba/ yab mes gong ma nas brgyud pa'i chos lugs bcas la dad gus rtse gcig tu byed/ rgyal bstan yang dar gyi rdzogs ldan shar ba nas ri bong dgon dang ser mang 'dus sde nyams gso byed pa la rgyu tshegs gnyis kyi 'gro song bla na med pa byas shing skyes chen dam pa mang po gdan drangs nas zab chos dpag med zhus/ ru chen gyi 'go 'dren rnams kyis nam yang mi dmangs kyi sne khrid de phyug 'gyur dang mthun sgril gyi lam la brtson par byed/ khyad par — 64 —
du lhag bsam dang snying stobs zung du 'brel zhing ngeg rtsal yongs su rdzogs pa/ mi dmangs mthun sgril gyi las la mkhas pa'i stod ma ru chen gyi tang kri phu'u hru'u ci ma phun gyis mi bsad gyod chen lnga dang gyod sna che chung bzhi bcu lhag gi bshad dka' ba'i gyod don mi nyung ba rtsod med mthun sgril gyi lam la bzhag pa yin te/ dper na/hu ra stod ma'i nang gi khyim tshang gnyis la nang 'khrugs byung ste mi gcig bsad pa'i rkyen gyis tsho ba bzhi tsam 'khrugs rtsod kyi lam du 'gro nyen che ba'i skabs ma phun gyis nyin mtshan bcu phrag lhag la ngal ba khyad bsad kyis gyod bshad pas rjes su thams cad mthun sgril gyi lam du bzhag gzhan yang gshis rgyud drang zhing spyi sems che ba'i gling ba mi dmangs kyi sku tshab dang drung yig pa ba ba skyabs kyis kyang mi dmangs kyi bde sdug khur du blangs te spyi phan gyi don mi nyung ba zhig bsgrubs pas tshang mas kho'i lhag bsam dang ngag rtsal la bstod pa yang yang thob po/ /da lta stod ma ru chen la 'go 'dren gtso bo tang kru'u phu'u hru'u cu ma phun dang / tshun krang khyi phrug hre krang sog rgan sogs kyis rgya che mi dmangs la 'go 'dzin dang zhabs 'degs gang legs bsgrub bzhin yod do/ /— 65 —
smad ma ru chen la da skabs dud khyim brgya dang bzhi bcu mi grangs bdun brgya la nye ba yod cing thams cad kyis mthun sgril zab mo'i ngang phyug 'gyur gyi lam la gicig tu 'bungs pas 'byor ldan gyi khyim tshang shin tu mang pas gling ba zhang lte ba'i slob chung gsar tshugs kyi ma dngul phul zhing / ri bong dgon sogs chos sde mang por mang ja dang 'gyed gtong bzhag 'jog bcas bla na med pa byas/mi dmangs kyi nang du yag skya'i dar rgyas sogs spyi phan che zhing ngag rtsal la mkhas pa rnams kyis phyi nang gi 'khrugs rtsod thams cad zhi par byed pa la gcig tu gzhol/ da lta smad ma ru chen gyi 'go 'dren pa khyung kho dang bad rdo yi kho gsum yin la nus ba ci yod kyis mi dmangs la zhabs phyi bsgrub bzhin pa'o/ /bar ma ru chen la da skabs dud khyim drug cu tsam dang mi grangs sum brgya lhag yod/ 'jig rten gyi kha dper skyid kyi rta bo mnyam zhon dang / sdug gi khur bo mnyam khur zer ba ltar nam yin yang nang mi mthun sgril zab mo'i ngang phan tshun la rogs skyor dang / dbul bo thams kyis skyong ba sogs thams cad kyis yid smon dang mig ltos byed sa'i ru sde kha mthun zhig yin/ hu ra bar ma'i nang na tshang mas bsngags brjod dang re ltos byed sa yon tan wawa 66 wawa —
rgya mtsho yin la/ khos nam yang gzhung drang dang lhag bsam dkar pos phyogs ris med par spyi phan gyi don rkyang rkyang bsgrubs/ da lta kho tsho'i hru'u ci sbyin pa dang tshun krang yon tan rgya mtsho hre krang mgon po tshe ring gsum yin pas nam yang rang don rgyab tu bor zhing spyi don phrag tu blangs dang len bzhin yod do/ /mtha' ba ru chen la khyim tshang bzhi bcu lhag dang mi grangs brgya dang lnga bcu tsam yod la/ 'jig rten gsar rnying gnyis kur ri bong dgon dang skyed sdug mnyam gshib yin pas/ dgon par las ka ci yod ma skul dang blangs kyis bsgrubs shing 'du khang nyams gso sogs la'ang zhal 'debs mi nyung ba phul/ da skabs hru'u ci 'jam dpal rdo rje dang tshun krang 'phags pa skyabs gnyis mtha' ba ru chen gyi 'go 'dren yin pas lhag bsam zol med kyis spyi don kho na gnyer bzhin 'dug go/ /rnga ba khul dmag yan lag sa khul phyugs gnyer 'brog rar da lta dud khyim brgyud cu lhag yod la/ dpon mkhan pa thar dang khams gcod pa skyabs gnyis kyis 'go 'dren byas te phyug 'gyur chen po'i lam la bskyod pas phyug lde gling ba mo khrang zhes phyogs so sor grags snyan shin tu che/ phyugs gnyer 'brog ra 'di ni sngon — 67 —
mang tshogs bcos —bsgyur skabs su gling ba stod smad bar gsum nas 'byor phyug can gyi khyim tshang nyi shu tsam bkar te rnga ba khul dmag yan lag sa khul gyi phyugs zog 'tsho skyong byed du bcugs pa rim gyis 'phel ba yin pas ri bong dgon gyi lha sde sha stag yin/kho tsho rang dgon la kha thag ring yang / 'jig rten gyi kha dper sa nag po 'dom la 'jal te/ sprin dkar po thod la bzung / zer ba ltar/ rang dgon la phog mang 'gyed dpag tu med pa byas shing 'cham gsar tshugs kyi skabs su 'cham gos/rus rgyan/ zhal 'bag sogs mkho chas gya nom pa'i bzhag 'jog byas/ ri bong dgon gyis kyang lha sde gtso bor rtsis te lo rer dge 'dun pa bzhi re mngags nas nyin nyi shu lhag la so so'i 'dod mos ltar sku rim ci 'dod bsgrubs/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin smyung gnas dbu 'dzin pa dang / shi chad skabs su bla 'tshab mngags pa sogs kyi srol yang gsar du btsugs/de ltar gling ba stod smad bar gsum dang gling ba mo khrang /mtha' ba yul tsho lnga ni dgon pa gcig gi lha sde dang zhang khrag gcig gi ru sde yin pas phan tshun la mthun sgril zab cing dge phyogs la gcig tu 'bungs ba yin te/ tang gis mi rigs srid jus dngos — 68 —
'beb byas te bstan pa yang dar gyi rdzogs ldan skyed pa'i nyi ma shar bas ri bong dgon bkra shis byang chub chos 'phel gling gi tshogs chen 'du khang chen mo skyar bzhengs byed skabs dgon pa'i las sne a khu brtson 'grus dang a khu bzod pa/a khu dgon pa/ hu ra smad nas mgo log zla ba tshe ring /bad rdo/ tshe dbang thar/ tshe dbang skyabs/ tshe ring dmar tho/smon lam/ bkra rgyam/ rab phrug sogs dang hu ra stod nas gser bu lo/ rgya paṇa chen skyabs/ thabs mkhas/ ri tshang 'bring mo/ ma phun/ thar bzod/ rwa lo skyabs/ hu ra bar ma nas sbyin pa mgo che/ rgya tshe dpag skyabs/ 'brig mkhar/tshe dpag skyabs/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ gdugs dkar don 'grub/ mtha' ba nas ngag dpal/ 'phrin las/ phul kho/gling ba mo khung nas khams bkra shis don 'grub/ chos phrug sogs dgon grong drug gi mi nyer brgyad gyis khur len mtha' 'khyol pa byas nas sgor khri phrag mang bo'i dngul bun 'phel skyed sogs byas te tshangs chen lha yi dbang bos sprul ba las thon pa lta bu'i tshogs chen 'du khang chen mo dad ldan 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi dpal du bzhengs so/ /— 69 —
mdor na mdo smad mdzod dge gling dkar mthong ba kun smon/gling lha sde dkar bo'i sde lhag rtsod bral kun la ngom pa'i yul gru 'di ru rje gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyug mchog dang khri chen lnga ba chen po shing bza' bskal bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ stag tsha yab sras/rgya nag pa/ seng sang tshang / gro tshang paṇ+ḍita'i sprul sku/ gnas gzhi tshang / khā shu sgang ma/ rnam grol sprul pa'i sku sogs kyis dbang lung zab chos kyi bdud rtsi'i bgo bsha' thob po/ / spyir na mdzod dge gling ba'i dpon sbra khrag gsum ni phu nu lag sbrel dang tsho ba mthun 'dus kyi 'brog chen zhig yin zhing kha 'cham gros 'grig dang gzu sgo khrims gsum drang ba/ las rgyu 'bras rtsi ba/ mthon po'i mgo nas gnon zhing dma' ba byams kyis bskyangs nas chos srid khrims srol thams cad gcig mthun ngang 'tshe bral zhi bde'i 'tsho ba skyel bzhin ba lags so / /[snyospras ba/cabskal ba bskal ba'i bgrang bya'i khur brtsegs phal cher ming gi lhag mar lus/ / 'ga' re'i byung ba zab zab snang yang dpyad gsum gtsang bo'i ngogs nas yal/ /— 70 —
kha cig phyag rjes rdzogs mtha' bral mod ji bzhin brjod pa'i ljags rtsal zhan/ /rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa'i lo rgyus 'di ko lhag bsam ngal ba zung gis bskrun/ /lhung lhung 'bab pa gtsang bo'i rgyun bzhin du/ /ljongs 'dir dpyod ldan grangs med byon gyur kyang / /rang gi mes po'i ngo mtshar phyag rjes la/ /ljags rtse bskyod pa med pa'i tshul 'di mtshar/ /shes rig me tog rtsi bcud ma 'thungs ba'i/ /sbrang chung nga rang ci dgar rtsen pa las/'di 'dra brjod pa'i khur chen ga la thegs/ /'on kyang gling dkar stod kyi sman ljongs 'dir/ /rang gi lte khrag bor ba'i gnas yin zhing /chos grogs 'ga' yis bka' nan ma bzlog par/ /ci nus lhag bsam dkar bo'i gshog rtser drangs/ /rnam dpyod mtshungs bral smug po ldong gi rgyud/ /bshes gnyen dam pa yon tan rgya mtsho yi/ /thugs skyong tshad med gnang ba'i bka' drin dag/ /— 71 —
bsam tshe dga' dad mtsho mo dgong du 'gyur/ /mang mang lo grangs thal bas ma nges dang / /yang yang rtogs dpyod zhib mo ma zhugs pa/ /mang mang gzur gnas mkhas dbang spyan sngar 'chags/ /yang yang phyogs ston bka' slob yod par re/ /tshul 'dir lus sems ngal ba brgya phrag gis/ /'bad brtson bla med byas pas rnam dkar dges/ /sngon byon mes po gong ma'i lugs bzang bo/ /mi nyams dus kyi mthar yang 'dzin gyur cig/bdag kyang deng nas tshe rab phreng ba ru/ /mtshan ldan bshes gnyen dam pas rjes bzung ste/ /tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ /sa bcu lam lnga'i dpal yon 'thob par shog/ / /ces mdzod dge gling ba'i mi dbang rim byon gyis chos srid skyong spel byas tshul phyi rabs thos pa dga' skyed ces bya ba 'di ni rje bla ma bskal bzang dam chos rgya mtsho mchog gi bka' yi cod pan spyi bor phabs pa dang dpon mkhan pa thar dang zhang srid gzhung / ru chen khag gi 'go 'dren pa sogs nas 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes — 72 —
skul ma byas par bdag la lo rgyus shig rtsom pa'i yon tshad med kyang bshes gnyen dam pa ldong yon tan rgya mtsho mchog la zhus tshe ngas khyod la rogs byed chog gsungs pas phran gyis spobs pa chen pos khur du blangs te/ sngar chos grogs ba ba skyabs nged gnyis kyis bris pa'i 〈gling ba'i lo rgyus rags bsdus 〉 la kha gsab du 〈mdo smad chos 'byung /〉 dang 〈bod mi bu gdong drug gi rus mdzod me tog skyed tshal 〉 〈gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i rnam thar 〉gser khri dgon pa'i lo rgyus 〉 〈co ne dgon pa'i lo rgyus 〉 gyidzod dge bhams me'i lo rgyus 〉 〈kirti blo bzang 'phrin las kyi rnam thar 〉〈lha sde dngul ra'i 'brog sde chags tshul 〉〈bod kyi lo rgyus kun dga'i me long /〉sogs zur lta'i dpyad gzhir byas shing ldong yon tan rgya —mtshos mgo mjug bar gsum la rgyab skyor bla med gnang bar brten rab gnas sa stag ( 1998 ) lo'i mchu zla ba'i dmar phyogs bzang bo gnyis par sa steng 'tsho byed yongs kyi tha shal ba bo lha'am byang rig khos rang gi lte khrag 'thor sa'i mdzod dge gling dkar stod du mjug rdzogs par bris so/ / sarba maṅgā laṃ/ /
